===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/worker_source.rs (343 lines) =====
    1| //! Web Worker chunk source — the multithreaded [`ChunkSourcePort`].
    2| //!
    3| //! Each worker (`static/worker.js`) is a second instance of this same wasm
    4| //! module running on its own OS thread. The main thread posts small
    5| //! `{gen, requestId, ox, oz, level, lod, artifacts, reality}` messages
    6| //! round-robin. Workers always generate, bake, build the collision SVO, and
    7| //! extract collision; the artifact bitfield requests only the active
    8| //! renderer's mesh, face, or serialized-node products. One encoded byte
    9| //! buffer returns through `adapters::chunk_codec`; GPU resources remain owned
   10| //! by the main-thread render driver. Healthy pools keep generation off the
   11| //! frame loop. If every worker fatally fails, the driver uses its same-thread
   12| //! source as a correctness fallback instead of leaving the world pending.
   13| //!
   14| //! Stale-result rejection lives in the engine (`install_completed`), keyed
   15| //! by the echoed request. This driver owns transport failure detection and
   16| //! reports exact failed requests through the same application port.
   17| 
   18| use std::cell::RefCell;
   19| use std::rc::Rc;
   20| 
   21| use js_sys::{ArrayBuffer, Reflect, Uint8Array};
   22| use wasm_bindgen::prelude::*;
   23| use web_sys::{MessageEvent, Worker, WorkerOptions, WorkerType};
   24| 
   25| use crate::adapters::chunk_codec::decode_chunk_payload;
   26| use crate::adapters::local_chunk_source::LocalChunkSource;
   27| use crate::application::generation_worker_policy::MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS;
   28| use crate::application::ports::{
   29|     ChunkPayload, ChunkRequest, ChunkSourcePort, CompletedChunk, RenderArtifactNeeds,
   30| };
   31| use crate::application::streaming::chunk_key;
   32| use crate::drivers::generation_worker_requests::GenerationWorkerRequests;
   33| use vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::RealitySnapshot;
   34| use vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider;
   35| 
   36| pub struct WorkerChunkSource {
   37|     workers: Vec<Worker>,
   38|     completed: Rc<RefCell<Vec<CompletedChunk>>>,
   39|     failed: Rc<RefCell<Vec<ChunkRequest>>>,
   40|     requests: Rc<RefCell<GenerationWorkerRequests>>,
   41|     /// Keeps browser callbacks alive for the workers' lifetime.
   42|     _message_handlers: Vec<Closure<dyn FnMut(MessageEvent)>>,
   43|     _error_handlers: Vec<Closure<dyn FnMut(web_sys::Event)>>,
   44|     /// Same-thread source for the synchronous [`ChunkSourcePort::load`]
   45|     /// contract and as a last-resort recovery if every worker has failed.
   46|     fallback: LocalChunkSource<SimpleNoiseProvider>,
   47|     reported_emergency_fallback: bool,
   48| }
   49| 
   50| impl WorkerChunkSource {
   51|     /// Spawns the pool and hands every worker the URL query, so main thread
   52|     /// and workers derive the identical generator configuration.
   53|     pub fn new(query: &str, default_seed: u32, pool_size: usize) -> Result<Self, JsValue> {
   54|         if !(1..=usize::from(MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS)).contains(&pool_size) {
   55|             return Err(JsValue::from_str(
   56|                 "generation worker pool size must be 1..=32",
   57|             ));
   58|         }
   59| 
   60|         let completed: Rc<RefCell<Vec<CompletedChunk>>> = Rc::new(RefCell::new(Vec::new()));
   61|         let failed: Rc<RefCell<Vec<ChunkRequest>>> = Rc::new(RefCell::new(Vec::new()));
   62|         let requests = Rc::new(RefCell::new(GenerationWorkerRequests::new(pool_size)));
   63|         // The single-file bundle (scripts/build-single-file.mjs) has no
   64|         // sibling worker.js on disk; it publishes a blob: URL for the inlined
   65|         // worker script on the global scope instead.
   66|         let script_url = Reflect::get(&js_sys::global(), &"__VACKROOMS_WORKER_URL__".into())
   67|             .ok()
   68|             .and_then(|value| value.as_string())
   69|             .unwrap_or_else(|| "worker.js".to_string());
   70|         let mut workers = Vec::with_capacity(pool_size);
   71|         let mut message_handlers = Vec::with_capacity(pool_size);
   72|         let mut error_handlers = Vec::with_capacity(pool_size);
   73|         for worker_index in 0..pool_size {
   74|             let options = WorkerOptions::new();
   75|             options.set_type(WorkerType::Module);
   76|             // Relative (not `/worker.js`): resolved against the document's
   77|             // URL, so this still finds the sibling file when the site is
   78|             // served from a subpath (e.g. a GitHub Pages project page at
   79|             // `<user>.github.io/<repo>/`) instead of the domain root.
   80|             let worker = Worker::new_with_options(&script_url, &options)?;
   81| 
   82|             let completed_sink = completed.clone();
   83|             let failed_sink = failed.clone();
   84|             let message_requests = requests.clone();
   85|             let worker_for_fatal_reply = worker.clone();
   86|             let handler = Closure::<dyn FnMut(MessageEvent)>::new(move |event: MessageEvent| {
   87|                 match parse_worker_reply(&event) {
   88|                     WorkerReply::Completed(done) => {
   89|                         if message_requests
   90|                             .borrow_mut()
   91|                             .finish_exact(worker_index, &done.request)
   92|                         {
   93|                             completed_sink.borrow_mut().push(done);
   94|                         }
   95|                     }
   96|                     WorkerReply::Failed(echoed) => {
   97|                         if let Some(failed_request) = message_requests
   98|                             .borrow_mut()
   99|                             .fail_exact(worker_index, &echoed)
  100|                         {
  101|                             failed_sink.borrow_mut().push(failed_request);
  102|                         }
  103|                     }
  104|                     WorkerReply::Fatal => {
  105|                         let abandoned = message_requests
  106|                             .borrow_mut()
  107|                             .disable_and_drain(worker_index);
  108|                         failed_sink.borrow_mut().extend(abandoned);
  109|                         worker_for_fatal_reply.terminate();
  110|                     }
  111|                     WorkerReply::Malformed => {
  112|                         if let Some(failed_request) =
  113|                             message_requests.borrow_mut().fail_oldest(worker_index)
  114|                         {
  115|                             failed_sink.borrow_mut().push(failed_request);
  116|                         }
  117|                     }
  118|                 }
  119|             });
  120|             worker.set_onmessage(Some(handler.as_ref().unchecked_ref()));
  121| 
  122|             let failed_sink = failed.clone();
  123|             let error_requests = requests.clone();
  124|             let worker_for_error = worker.clone();
  125|             let error_handler = Closure::<dyn FnMut(web_sys::Event)>::new(move |_event| {
  126|                 let abandoned = error_requests.borrow_mut().disable_and_drain(worker_index);
  127|                 failed_sink.borrow_mut().extend(abandoned);
  128|                 worker_for_error.terminate();
  129|             });
  130|             worker.set_onerror(Some(error_handler.as_ref().unchecked_ref()));
  131| 
  132|             let init = js_sys::Object::new();
  133|             Reflect::set(&init, &"type".into(), &"init".into())?;
  134|             Reflect::set(&init, &"query".into(), &query.into())?;
  135|             Reflect::set(&init, &"seed".into(), &(default_seed as f64).into())?;
  136|             worker.post_message(&init)?;
  137| 
  138|             workers.push(worker);
  139|             message_handlers.push(handler);
  140|             error_handlers.push(error_handler);
  141|         }
  142| 
  143|         let (seed, config) =
  144|             crate::adapters::query_config::generator_setup_from_query(query, default_seed);
  145|         Ok(Self {
  146|             workers,
  147|             completed,
  148|             failed,
  149|             requests,
  150|             _message_handlers: message_handlers,
  151|             _error_handlers: error_handlers,
  152|             fallback: LocalChunkSource::new(SimpleNoiseProvider::new(), seed, config),
  153|             reported_emergency_fallback: false,
  154|         })
  155|     }
  156| 
  157|     pub fn pool_size(&self) -> usize {
  158|         self.workers.len()
  159|     }
  160| }
  161| 
  162| impl ChunkSourcePort for WorkerChunkSource {
  163|     fn load(&self, origin_x: f32, origin_z: f32, level: u32, lod: u8) -> ChunkPayload {
  164|         self.fallback.load(origin_x, origin_z, level, lod)
  165|     }
  166|

  175|         self.fallback
  176|             .load_with_reality(origin_x, origin_z, level, lod, reality)
  177|     }

  186|         artifacts: RenderArtifactNeeds,

  189|             .load_with_artifacts(origin_x, origin_z, level, lod, reality, artifacts)
  190|     }

  192|     fn is_async(&self) -> bool {

  194|     }
  195| 
  196|     fn max_concurrent_requests(&self) -> usize {
  197|         self.pool_size()
  198|     }
  199| 
  200|     fn request(&mut self, request: ChunkRequest) {
  201|         // Route by chunk, not round-robin: each worker archives what it
  202|         // generates, so a chunk evicted from the rolling window and later
  203|         // wanted again must come back to the worker already holding it.
  204|         // `next_accepting` still falls through to any healthy worker, so
  205|         // affinity is a preference and never a way to strand a request on a
  206|         // dead worker.
  207|         let preferred = GenerationWorkerRequests::preferred_worker(
  208|             chunk_key(request.origin_x, request.origin_z),
  209|             self.workers.len(),
  210|         );
  211|         let worker_index = self.requests.borrow().next_accepting(preferred);
  212|         let Some(worker_index) = worker_index else {
  213|             // Fatal worker startup/runtime failures must not strand streaming.
  214|             // This path is deliberately exceptional: the healthy path always
  215|             // generates off-thread, while an exhausted pool favors a complete
  216|             // world over a permanently pending chunk.
  217|             if !self.reported_emergency_fallback {
  218|                 web_sys::console::warn_1(
  219|                     &"generation worker pool failed; using same-thread recovery".into(),
  220|                 );
  221|                 self.reported_emergency_fallback = true;
  222|             }
  223|             let payload = self.fallback.load_with_artifacts(
  224|                 request.origin_x,
  225|                 request.origin_z,
  226|                 request.level,
  227|                 request.lod,
  228|                 &request.reality,
  229|                 request.artifacts,
  230|             );
  231|             self.completed
  232|                 .borrow_mut()
  233|                 .push(CompletedChunk { request, payload });
  234|             return;
  235|         };
  236| 
  237|         let message = js_sys::Object::new();
  238|         let set = |k: &str, v: JsValue| {
  239|             let _ = Reflect::set(&message, &k.into(), &v);
  240|         };
  241|         set("type", "gen".into());
  242|         set("requestId", (request.request_id as f64).into());
  243|         set("ox", (request.origin_x as f64).into());
  244|         set("oz", (request.origin_z as f64).into());
  245|         set("level", (request.level as f64).into());
  246|         set("lod", (request.lod as f64).into());
  247|         set("artifacts", (request.artifacts.bits() as f64).into());
  248|         let reality_words = request.reality.to_words();
  249|         let reality = js_sys::Uint32Array::from(reality_words.as_slice());
  250|         set("reality", reality.into());
  251|         let worker = &self.workers[worker_index];
  252|         self.requests
  253|             .borrow_mut()
  254|             .assign(worker_index, request.clone());
  255|         if let Err(error) = worker.post_message(&message) {
  256|             // A synchronous send failure means this worker can no longer be
  257|             // trusted with its already queued requests. Retire all of them;
  258|             // the engine will validate their ids and retry on healthy slots.
  259|             let abandoned = self.requests.borrow_mut().disable_and_drain(worker_index);
  260|             self.failed.borrow_mut().extend(abandoned);
  261|             worker.terminate();
  262|             web_sys::console::warn_2(
  263|                 &"generation worker postMessage failed; disabling worker:".into(),
  264|                 &error,
  265|             );
  266|         }
  267|     }
  268| 
  269|     fn poll_completed(&mut self) -> Vec<CompletedChunk> {
  270|         std::mem::take(&mut *self.completed.borrow_mut())
  271|     }
  272| 
  273|     fn poll_failed_requests(&mut self) -> Vec<ChunkRequest> {
  274|         std::mem::take(&mut *self.failed.borrow_mut())
  275|     }
  276| }
  277| 
  278| enum WorkerReply {
  279|     Completed(CompletedChunk),
  280|     Failed(ChunkRequest),
  281|     Fatal,
  282|     Malformed,
  283| }
  284| 
  285| /// Decodes the deliberately small worker protocol. Malformed replies are a
  286| /// first-class outcome: the worker queue is serial, so the caller can fail its
  287| /// oldest assigned request instead of leaving that chunk pending forever.
  288| fn parse_worker_reply(event: &MessageEvent) -> WorkerReply {
  289|     let data = event.data();
  290|     let message_type = Reflect::get(&data, &"type".into())
  291|         .ok()
  292|         .and_then(|value| value.as_string());
  293|     match message_type.as_deref() {
  294|         Some("done") => parse_request(&data)
  295|             .and_then(|request| {
  296|                 parse_payload(&data).map(|payload| CompletedChunk { request, payload })
  297|             })
  298|             .map(WorkerReply::Completed)
  299|             .unwrap_or(WorkerReply::Malformed),
  300|         Some("failed") => parse_request(&data)
  301|             .map(WorkerReply::Failed)
  302|             .unwrap_or(WorkerReply::Malformed),
  303|         Some("fatal") => WorkerReply::Fatal,
  304|         _ => WorkerReply::Malformed,
  305|     }
  306| }
  307| 
  308| fn parse_request(data: &JsValue) -> Option<ChunkRequest> {
  309|     let field = |name: &str| Reflect::get(data, &name.into()).ok();
  310|     Some(ChunkRequest {
  311|         request_id: exact_u32(field("requestId")?)?,
  312|         origin_x: finite_f32(field("ox")?)?,
  313|         origin_z: finite_f32(field("oz")?)?,
  314|         level: exact_u32(field("level")?)?,
  315|         lod: u8::try_from(exact_u32(field("lod")?)?).ok()?,
  316|         artifacts: RenderArtifactNeeds::from_bits(
  317|             u8::try_from(exact_u32(field("artifacts")?)?).ok()?,
  318|         )?,
  319|         reality: {
  320|             let encoded = field("reality")?;
  321|             let words = encoded.dyn_into::<js_sys::Uint32Array>().ok()?.to_vec();
  322|             RealitySnapshot::from_words(&words).ok()?
  323|         },
  324|     })
  325| }
  326| 
  327| fn parse_payload(data: &JsValue) -> Option<ChunkPayload> {
  328|     let buffer: ArrayBuffer = Reflect::get(data, &"buf".into()).ok()?.dyn_into().ok()?;
  329|     let bytes = Uint8Array::new(&buffer).to_vec();
  330|     decode_chunk_payload(&bytes)
  331| }
  332| 
  333| fn exact_u32(value: JsValue) -> Option<u32> {
  334|     let number = value.as_f64()?;
  335|     (number.is_finite() && number.fract() == 0.0 && (0.0..=f64::from(u32::MAX)).contains(&number))
  336|         .then_some(number as u32)
  337| }
  338| 
  339| fn finite_f32(value: JsValue) -> Option<f32> {
  340|     let number = value.as_f64()?;
  341|     let narrowed = number as f32;
  342|     (number.is_finite() && narrowed.is_finite()).then_some(narrowed)
  343| }

===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/generation_worker_requests.rs (254 lines) =====
    1| //! Exact in-flight request bookkeeping for the generation-worker pool.
    2| //!
    3| //! Browser callbacks can arrive after a worker has failed or after the engine
    4| //! has already retried a chunk. This small ledger gives every callback one
    5| //! deterministic operation: finish the exact request it echoes, fail the
    6| //! oldest request after a malformed reply, or drain a failed worker.
    7| 
    8| use std::collections::VecDeque;
    9| 
   10| use crate::application::ports::ChunkRequest;
   11| use crate::application::streaming::ChunkKey;
   12| 
   13| #[derive(Debug)]
   14| struct WorkerRequests {
   15|     accepting_work: bool,
   16|     in_flight: VecDeque<ChunkRequest>,
   17| }
   18| 
   19| /// Per-worker request ownership. Request identity is always checked through
   20| /// [`ChunkRequest::is_same_request`], never by chunk coordinates alone.
   21| #[derive(Debug)]
   22| pub(crate) struct GenerationWorkerRequests {
   23|     workers: Vec<WorkerRequests>,
   24| }
   25| 
   26| impl GenerationWorkerRequests {
   27|     pub(crate) fn new(worker_count: usize) -> Self {
   28|         assert!(
   29|             worker_count > 0,
   30|             "a worker ledger needs at least one worker"
   31|         );
   32|         Self {
   33|             workers: (0..worker_count)
   34|                 .map(|_| WorkerRequests {
   35|                     accepting_work: true,
   36|                     in_flight: VecDeque::new(),
   37|                 })
   38|                 .collect(),
   39|         }
   40|     }
   41| 
   42|     /// Which worker owns a chunk.
   43|     ///
   44|     /// Deliberately not round-robin. Each worker keeps its own archive of
   45|     /// what it has generated, and an archive only pays off if the chunk comes
   46|     /// back to the worker holding it — round-robin would scatter a chunk
   47|     /// across the pool and turn a 0.46 ms read into a 42 ms regeneration on
   48|     /// (n-1)/n of re-requests.
   49|     ///
   50|     /// Hashing the coordinates rather than slicing the world into contiguous
   51|     /// blocks is what keeps the pool balanced: a player standing anywhere has
   52|     /// their surrounding chunks spread evenly across workers, where a
   53|     /// block-per-worker split would leave one worker generating everything
   54|     /// while the rest idled.
   55|     pub(crate) fn preferred_worker(chunk: ChunkKey, worker_count: usize) -> usize {
   56|         if worker_count <= 1 {
   57|             return 0;
   58|         }
   59|         let mut h: u64 = 0xcbf2_9ce4_8422_2325;
   60|         for word in [chunk.0 as u64, chunk.1 as u64] {
   61|             for byte in word.to_le_bytes() {
   62|                 h ^= byte as u64;
   63|                 h = h.wrapping_mul(0x1000_0000_01b3);
   64|             }
   65|         }
   66|         (h % worker_count as u64) as usize
   67|     }
   68| 
   69|     /// Finds the next healthy worker, wrapping once from `start`.
   70|     pub(crate) fn next_accepting(&self, start: usize) -> Option<usize> {
   71|         (0..self.workers.len())
   72|             .map(|offset| (start + offset) % self.workers.len())
   73|             .find(|&index| self.workers[index].accepting_work)
   74|     }
   75| 
   76|     pub(crate) fn assign(&mut self, worker_index: usize, request: ChunkRequest) {
   77|         let worker = &mut self.workers[worker_index];
   78|         debug_assert!(worker.accepting_work);
   79|         worker.in_flight.push_back(request);
   80|     }
   81| 
   82|     /// Retires only the exact request echoed by a well-formed worker reply.
   83|     /// Unknown and stale replies leave all current work untouched.
   84|     pub(crate) fn finish_exact(&mut self, worker_index: usize, echoed: &ChunkRequest) -> bool {
   85|         self.take_exact(worker_index, echoed).is_some()
   86|     }
   87| 
   88|     /// Retires an exact request reported as failed by the worker protocol.
   89|     pub(crate) fn fail_exact(
   90|         &mut self,
   91|         worker_index: usize,
   92|         echoed: &ChunkRequest,
   93|     ) -> Option<ChunkRequest> {
   94|         self.take_exact(worker_index, echoed)
   95|     }
   96| 
   97|     /// A worker processes its queue serially, so a malformed response belongs
   98|     /// to its oldest outstanding request even when its envelope cannot be
   99|     /// decoded far enough to recover an id.
  100|     pub(crate) fn fail_oldest(&mut self, worker_index: usize) -> Option<ChunkRequest> {
  101|         self.workers[worker_index].in_flight.pop_front()
  102|     }
  103| 
  104|     /// Stops scheduling to a broken worker and returns all work the engine
  105|     /// must retry. Calling this more than once is harmless.
  106|     pub(crate) fn disable_and_drain(&mut self, worker_index: usize) -> Vec<ChunkRequest> {
  107|         let worker = &mut self.workers[worker_index];
  108|         worker.accepting_work = false;
  109|         worker.in_flight.drain(..).collect()
  110|     }
  111| 
  112|     fn take_exact(&mut self, worker_index: usize, echoed: &ChunkRequest) -> Option<ChunkRequest> {
  113|         let queue = &mut self.workers[worker_index].in_flight;
  114|         let position = queue
  115|             .iter()
  116|             .position(|request| request.is_same_request(echoed))?;
  117|         queue.remove(position)
  118|     }
  119| }

   52| /// Every start explores a fresh world; `--seed=N` reproduces one. The
   53| /// std hasher is randomly keyed per process, which is all the entropy a
   54| /// world seed needs without pulling in a rand dependency.
   55| fn random_seed() -> u32 {
   56|     use std::hash::{BuildHasher, Hasher};
   57|     std::collections::hash_map::RandomState::new()
   58|         .build_hasher()
   59|         .finish() as u32
   60| }
   61| 
   62| struct Options {
   63|     renderer: RendererKind,
   64|     quality: GpuQualityProfile,
   65|     seed: u32,
   66|     toggles: RenderToggles,
   67| }
   68| 
   69| /// The compatibility preset every run starts from: all load-*reducing*
   70| /// switches stay on, all load-*adding* effect passes stay off. `--preset=full`
   71| /// restores the browser's default switchboard for parity testing.
   72| fn compat_toggles() -> RenderToggles {
   73|     RenderToggles {
   74|         shadow_pass: false,
   75|         ambient_occlusion: false,
   76|         deferred_shading: false,
   77|         flashlight_occlusion: false,
   78|         ..RenderToggles::default()
   79|     }
   80| }
   81| 
   82| fn parse_options() -> Options {
   83|     let mut options = Options {
   84|         renderer: RendererKind::Surface,
   85|         quality: GpuQualityProfile::default(),
   86|         seed: random_seed(),
   87|         toggles: compat_toggles(),
   88|     };
   89|     for argument in std::env::args().skip(1) {
   90|         if let Some(value) = argument.strip_prefix("--renderer=") {
   91|             options.renderer = value.parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| {
   92|                 panic!("unknown renderer {value:?}; use surface|splat|raymarch|cpu")
   93|             });
   94|         } else if let Some(value) = argument.strip_prefix("--preset=") {
   95|             options.toggles = match value {
   96|                 "compat" => compat_toggles(),
   97|                 "full" => RenderToggles::default(),
   98|                 other => panic!("unknown preset {other:?}; use compat|full"),
   99|             };
  100|         } else if let Some(value) = argument.strip_prefix("--quality=") {
  101|             options.quality = value
  102|                 .parse()
  103|                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("unknown quality {value:?}; use low|high"));
  104|         } else if let Some(value) = argument.strip_prefix("--seed=") {
  105|             options.seed = value
  106|                 .parse()
  107|                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("seed must be a number, got {value:?}"));
  108|         } else {
  109|             panic!(
  110|                 "unknown flag {argument:?}; supported: --renderer= --preset= --quality= --seed="
  111|             );
  112|         }
  113|     }
  114|     options
  115| }
  116| 
  117| pub fn run() {
  118|     let options = parse_options();
  119|     let event_loop = EventLoop::new().expect("create winit event loop");
  120|     event_loop.set_control_flow(ControlFlow::Poll);
  121|     let mut app = App {
  122|         options,
  123|         state: None,
  124|     };
  125|     event_loop.run_app(&mut app).expect("run event loop");
  126| }
  127| 
  128| struct App {
  129|     options: Options,
  130|     state: Option<State>,
  131| }
  132| 
  133| /// Everything alive once the window exists.
  134| struct State {
  135|     window: Arc<Window>,
  136|     renderer: SharedNativeRenderer,
  137|     engine: Engine,
  138|     input: InputState,
  139|     locator: SectionLocator,
  140|     toggles: RenderToggles,
  141|     seed: u32,
  142|     last_frame: Instant,
  143|     hud_window_start: Instant,
  144|     hud_frames: u32,
  145|     fps: f32,
  146|     section: String,
  147|     show_config: bool,
  148| }
  149| 
  150| #[derive(Default)]
  151| struct InputState {
  152|     forward: bool,
  153|     backward: bool,
  154|     left: bool,
  155|     right: bool,
  156|     flashlight: bool,
  157|     drop_flare: bool,
  158|     drink: bool,
  159|     eat: bool,
  160|     look_dx: f32,
  161|     look_dy: f32,
  162|     captured: bool,
  163| }
  164| 
  165| impl InputState {
  166|     fn take_frame(&mut self) -> InputFrame {
  167|         let frame = InputFrame {
  168|             intent: MoveIntent {
  169|                 forward: self.forward,
  170|                 backward: self.backward,
  171|                 left: self.left,
  172|                 right: self.right,
  173|                 turn_left: false,
  174|                 turn_right: false,
  175|             },
  176|             look_dx: self.look_dx,
  177|             look_dy: self.look_dy,
  178|             locked: self.captured,
  179|             flashlight: self.flashlight,
  180|             drop_flare: self.drop_flare,
  181|             drink: self.drink,
  182|             eat: self.eat,
  183|         };
  184|         self.look_dx = 0.0;
  185|         self.look_dy = 0.0;
  186|         self.drop_flare = false;
  187|         self.drink = false;
  188|         self.eat = false;
  189|         frame
  190|     }
  191| }
  192| 
  193| impl ApplicationHandler for App {
  194|     fn resumed(&mut self, event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop) {
  195|         if self.state.is_some() {
  196|             return;
  197|         }
  198|         let window = Arc::new(
  199|             event_loop
  200|                 .create_window(
  201|                     Window::default_attributes()
  202|                         .with_title("Vackrooms")
  203|                         .with_inner_size(winit::dpi::LogicalSize::new(1280.0, 720.0)),
  204|                 )
  205|                 .expect("create window"),
  206|         );
  207|         let renderer = SharedNativeRenderer::new(NativeRenderer::new(
  208|             Arc::clone(&window),
  209|             RendererProfile::for_renderer(self.options.renderer, self.options.quality),
  210|             self.options.toggles,
  211|         ));
  212| 
  213|         // Same world assembly as the browser composition root, minus the
  214|         // query string: low-spec generator profile, spawn on the main
  215|         // corridor of region (0,0), facing east down its west leg.
  216|         let generator = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
  217|         let spawn = spawn_point(self.options.seed);
  218|         let engine_config = EngineConfig {
  219|             chunk_size: generator.chunk_size,
  220|             seed: self.options.seed,
  221|             spawn: [spawn.x, 1.7, spawn.z],
  222|             spawn_yaw: -std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2,
  223|             ..EngineConfig::default()
  224|         };
  225|         let source =
  226|             LocalChunkSource::new(SimpleNoiseProvider::new(), self.options.seed, generator);
  227|         let engine = Engine::new(engine_config, Box::new(renderer.clone()), Box::new(source));
  228| 
  229|         eprintln!(
  230|             "renderer: {} | seed {} (reproduce with --seed={}) | click to capture the mouse; Esc releases",
  231|             self.options.renderer.label(),
  232|             self.options.seed,
  233|             self.options.seed,
  234|         );
  235|         window.request_redraw();
  236|         self.state = Some(State {
  237|             window,
  238|             renderer,
  239|             engine,
  240|             input: InputState::default(),
  241|             locator: SectionLocator::new(self.options.seed, generator),
  242|             toggles: self.options.toggles,
  243|             seed: self.options.seed,
  244|             last_frame: Instant::now(),
  245|             hud_window_start: Instant::now(),
  246|             hud_frames: 0,
  247|             fps: 0.0,
  248|             section: String::new(),
  249|             show_config: false,
  250|         });
  251|     }
  252| 
  253|     fn window_event(&mut self, event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop, _id: WindowId, event: WindowEvent) {
  254|         let Some(state) = &mut self.state else {
  255|             return;
  256|         };
  257|         match event {
  258|             WindowEvent::CloseRequested => event_loop.exit(),
  259|             WindowEvent::Resized(size) => {
  260|                 state.renderer.resize(size.width, size.height);
  261|             }
  262|             WindowEvent::MouseInput {
  263|                 state: ElementState::Pressed,
  264|                 button: MouseButton::Left,
  265|                 ..
  266|             } => {
  267|                 if !state.input.captured {
  268|                     let grabbed = state
  269|                         .window
  270|                         .set_cursor_grab(CursorGrabMode::Confined)
  271|                         .or_else(|_| state.window.set_cursor_grab(CursorGrabMode::Locked))
  272|                         .is_ok();
  273|                     state.window.set_cursor_visible(!grabbed);
  274|                     state.input.captured = grabbed;
  275|                 }
  276|             }
  277|             WindowEvent::KeyboardInput { event, .. } => {
  278|                 let pressed = event.state == ElementState::Pressed;
  279|                 match event.physical_key {
  280|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyW | KeyCode::ArrowUp) => {
  281|                         state.input.forward = pressed;
  282|                     }
  283|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyS | KeyCode::ArrowDown) => {
  284|                         state.input.backward = pressed;
  285|                     }
  286|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyA | KeyCode::ArrowLeft) => {
  287|                         state.input.left = pressed;
  288|                     }
  289|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyD | KeyCode::ArrowRight) => {
  290|                         state.input.right = pressed;
  291|                     }
  292|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyF) if pressed => {
  293|                         state.input.flashlight = !state.input.flashlight;
  294|                     }
  295|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyG) if pressed => {
  296|                         state.input.drop_flare = true;
  297|                     }
  298|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyR) if pressed => {
  299|                         state.input.drink = true;
  300|                     }
  301|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyT) if pressed => {
  302|                         state.input.eat = true;
  303|                     }
  304|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F1) if pressed => {
  305|                         state.show_config = !state.show_config;
  306|                     }
  307|                     // Live effect-pass switches (the terminal's F1 panel
  308|                     // documents them). These are per-frame parameters, so
  309|                     // flipping them needs no pipeline rebuild.
  310|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F5) if pressed => {
  311|                         state.toggles.shadow_pass = !state.toggles.shadow_pass;
  312|                         state.renderer.set_toggles(state.toggles);
  313|                     }
  314|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F6) if pressed => {
  315|                         state.toggles.ambient_occlusion = !state.toggles.ambient_occlusion;
  316|                         state.renderer.set_toggles(state.toggles);
  317|                     }
  318|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F7) if pressed => {
  319|                         state.toggles.deferred_shading = !state.toggles.deferred_shading;
  320|                         state.renderer.set_toggles(state.toggles);
  321|                     }
  322|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F8) if pressed => {
  323|                         state.toggles.flashlight_occlusion = !state.toggles.flashlight_occlusion;
  324|                         state.renderer.set_toggles(state.toggles);
  325|                     }
  326|                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::Escape) if pressed => {
  327|                         let _ = state.window.set_cursor_grab(CursorGrabMode::None);
  328|                         state.window.set_cursor_visible(true);
  329|                         state.input.captured = false;
  330|                     }
  331|                     _ => {}
  332|                 }
  333|             }
  334|             WindowEvent::RedrawRequested => {
  335|                 let now = Instant::now();
  336|                 let dt = (now - state.last_frame).as_secs_f32().min(0.1);
  337|                 state.last_frame = now;
  338| 
  339|                 // Slow channels (fps, section locator) refresh once a second.
  340|                 state.hud_frames += 1;
  341|                 let elapsed = now - state.hud_window_start;
  342|                 if elapsed.as_secs_f32() >= 1.0 {
  343|                     state.fps = state.hud_frames as f32 / elapsed.as_secs_f32();
  344|                     state.hud_frames = 0;
  345|                     state.hud_window_start = now;
  346|                     let (level, pos) = {
  347|                         let player = state.engine.player();
  348|                         (state.engine.level(), player.position)
  349|                     };
  350|                     state.section = state.locator.describe(level, pos[0], pos[2]);
  351|                 }
  352| 
  353|                 // Last frame's stats feed this frame's terminal: the engine
  354|                 // draws (and presents) inside tick, so the snapshot must be
  355|                 // staged before it runs. One frame of latency is invisible.
  356|                 let stats = state.engine.stats();
  357|                 state.renderer.set_hud(HudSnapshot {
  358|                     hydration: stats.hydration,
  359|                     satiety: stats.satiety,
  360|                     condition: stats.condition,
  361|                     almond_bottles: stats.almond_bottles,
  362|                     rations: stats.rations,
  363|                     ready: stats.ready,
  364|                     flashlight: state.input.flashlight,
  365|                     fps: state.fps,
  366|                     fine_chunks: stats.fine_chunks,
  367|                     resident_chunks: stats.resident_chunks,
  368|                     atlas_nodes: stats.atlas_nodes,
  369|                     bpm: stats.body.bpm,
  370|                     signal: stats.body.signal,
  371|                     section: state.section.clone(),
  372|                     distance_m: stats.distance_m,
  373|                     ambient_c: stats.ambient_c,
  374|                     deaths: stats.deaths,
  375|                     seed: state.seed,
  376|                     show_config: state.show_config,
  377|                     toggles: state.toggles,
  378|                 });
  379|                 let frame_input = state.input.take_frame();
  380|                 state.engine.tick(dt, &frame_input);
  381|                 state.window.request_redraw();
  382|             }
  383|             _ => {}
  384|         }
  385|     }
  386| 
  387|     fn device_event(&mut self, _loop: &ActiveEventLoop, _id: DeviceId, event: DeviceEvent) {
  388|         let Some(state) = &mut self.state else {
  389|             return;
  390|         };
  391|         if let DeviceEvent::MouseMotion { delta: (dx, dy) } = event {
  392|             if state.input.captured {
  393|                 state.input.look_dx += dx as f32;
  394|                 state.input.look_dy += dy as f32;
  395|             }
  396|         }
  397|     }
  398| }
  399| 
  400| // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  401| // Native renderer: the desktop twin of `WebGpuRenderer`, presenting to a
  402| // winit surface instead of a canvas. Pipelines and strategies are shared.
  403| // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  404| 
  405| enum Strategy {
  406|     Surface(SurfacePipeline),
  407|     Splat(SplatPipeline),
  408|     Raymarch(RaymarchPipeline),
  409|     Cpu(CpuPresentPipeline),
  410| }
  411| 
  412| /// Presenter-side terminal state, staged once per frame by the event loop.
  413| #[derive(Clone)]
  414| struct HudSnapshot {
  415|     hydration: f32,
  416|     satiety: f32,
  417|     condition: f32,
  418|     almond_bottles: u32,
  419|     rations: u32,
  420|     ready: bool,
  421|     flashlight: bool,
  422|     fps: f32,
  423|     fine_chunks: usize,
  424|     resident_chunks: usize,
  425|     atlas_nodes: usize,
  426|     bpm: f32,
  427|     signal: PulseSignal,
  428|     section: String,
  429|     distance_m: f32,
  430|     ambient_c: f32,
  431|     deaths: u32,
  432|     seed: u32,
  433|     show_config: bool,
  434|     toggles: RenderToggles,
  435| }
  436| 
  437| impl Default for HudSnapshot {
  438|     fn default() -> Self {
  439|         Self {
  440|             hydration: 0.0,
  441|             satiety: 0.0,
  442|             condition: 0.0,
  443|             almond_bottles: 0,
  444|             rations: 0,
  445|             ready: false,
  446|             flashlight: false,
  447|             fps: 0.0,
  448|             fine_chunks: 0,
  449|             resident_chunks: 0,
  450|             atlas_nodes: 0,
  451|             bpm: 0.0,
  452|             signal: PulseSignal::Quiet,
  453|             section: String::new(),
  454|             distance_m: 0.0,
  455|             ambient_c: 0.0,
  456|             deaths: 0,
  457|             seed: 0,
  458|             show_config: false,
  459|             toggles: RenderToggles::default(),
  460|         }
  461|     }
  462| }
  463| 
  464| struct NativeRenderer {
  465|     _instance: wgpu::Instance,
  466|     surface: wgpu::Surface<'static>,
  467|     device: wgpu::Device,
  468|     queue: wgpu::Queue,
  469|     config: wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration,
  470|     frame_resources: FrameResources,
  471|     strategy: Strategy,
  472|     supply_labels: SupplyLabelPipeline,
  473|     profile: RendererProfile,
  474|     toggles: RenderToggles,
  475|     depth_view: wgpu::TextureView,
  476|     terminal: crate::terminal::FieldTerminal,
  477|     hud_snapshot: HudSnapshot,
  478| }
  479| 
  480| impl NativeRenderer {
  481|     fn new(window: Arc<Window>, profile: RendererProfile, toggles: RenderToggles) -> Self {
  482|         let mut descriptor =
  483|             wgpu::InstanceDescriptor::new_with_display_handle(Box::new(window.clone()));
  484|         descriptor.backends = wgpu::Backends::VULKAN;
  485|         let instance = wgpu::Instance::new(descriptor);
  486|         let surface = instance
  487|             .create_surface(window.clone())
  488|             .expect("create window surface");
  489|         let adapter = pollster::block_on(instance.request_adapter(&wgpu::RequestAdapterOptions {
  490|             power_preference: wgpu::PowerPreference::None,
  491|             force_fallback_adapter: false,
  492|             compatible_surface: Some(&surface),
  493|             apply_limit_buckets: false,
  494|         }))
  495|         .expect("no Vulkan adapter; install Mesa (Lavapipe works) or expose a Vulkan GPU");
  496|         let info = adapter.get_info();
  497|         eprintln!(
  498|             "Vulkan adapter: {} ({}, {})",
  499|             info.name, info.driver, info.driver_info
  500|         );
  501|         let limits = wgpu::Limits::default().or_worse_values_from(&adapter.limits());
  502|         let (device, queue) = pollster::block_on(adapter.request_device(&wgpu::DeviceDescriptor {
  503|             label: Some("vackrooms.native-play"),
  504|             required_features: wgpu::Features::empty(),
  505|             required_limits: limits,
  506|             ..Default::default()
  507|         }))
  508|         .expect("create Vulkan device");
  509| 
  510|         // Mirror the browser context: the shaders encode display color
  511|         // themselves, so present through a non-sRGB view of the swapchain.
  512|         let capabilities = surface.get_capabilities(&adapter);
  513|         let format = capabilities
  514|             .formats
  515|             .iter()
  516|             .copied()
  517|             .find(|format| !format.is_srgb())
  518|             .expect("surface exposes a linear color format");
  519|         let size = window.inner_size();
  520|         let config = wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration {
  521|             usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
  522|             format,
  523|             color_space: wgpu::SurfaceColorSpace::Auto,
  524|             width: size.width.max(1),
  525|             height: size.height.max(1),
  526|             desired_maximum_frame_latency: 2,
  527|             present_mode: wgpu::PresentMode::AutoVsync,
  528|             alpha_mode: wgpu::CompositeAlphaMode::Auto,
  529|             view_formats: vec![],
  530|         };
  531|         surface.configure(&device, &config);
  532| 
  533|         let frame_resources = FrameResources::new(&device);
  534|         let strategy = match profile {
  535|             RendererProfile::Surface(settings) => {
  536|                 Strategy::Surface(SurfacePipeline::new_with_shadow_options(
  537|                     &device,
  538|                     format,
  539|                     frame_resources.layout(),
  540|                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
  541|                     HeroShadowOptions::new(
  542|                         settings.shadow_map,
  543|                         settings.optimizations.hero_light_shadow_map,
  544|                     ),
  545|                 ))
  546|             }
  547|             RendererProfile::Splat(settings) => {
  548|                 Strategy::Splat(SplatPipeline::new_with_shadow_options(
  549|                     &device,
  550|                     format,
  551|                     frame_resources.layout(),
  552|                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
  553|                     settings.face_budget,
  554|                     HeroShadowOptions::new(
  555|                         settings.shadow_map,
  556|                         settings.optimizations.hero_light_shadow_map,
  557|                     ),
  558|                 ))
  559|             }
  560|             RendererProfile::Raymarch(settings) => {
  561|                 let mut pipeline = RaymarchPipeline::new(
  562|                     &device,
  563|                     format,
  564|                     frame_resources.layout(),
  565|                     settings.maximum_resident_chunks as usize,
  566|                 );
  567|                 pipeline.configure(RaymarchRuntimeOptions::new(
  568|                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
  569|                     settings.optimizations.direct_light_visibility,
  570|                     settings.area_light_visibility_samples,
  571|                 ));
  572|                 Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline)
  573|             }
  574|             RendererProfile::Cpu(_) => Strategy::Cpu(CpuPresentPipeline::new(
  575|                 &device,
  576|                 format,
  577|                 config.width,
  578|                 config.height,
  579|             )),
  580|         };
  581|         let supply_labels = SupplyLabelPipeline::new(&device, format, frame_resources.layout());
  582|         let depth_view = create_depth_view(&device, config.width, config.height);
  583|         let terminal = crate::terminal::FieldTerminal::new(&device, &queue, format);
  584|         Self {
  585|             _instance: instance,
  586|             surface,
  587|             device,
  588|             queue,
  589|             config,
  590|             frame_resources,
  591|             strategy,
  592|             supply_labels,
  593|             profile,
  594|             toggles,
  595|             depth_view,
  596|             terminal,
  597|             hud_snapshot: HudSnapshot::default(),
  598|         }
  599|     }
  600| 
  601|     fn resize(&mut self, width: u32, height: u32) {
  602|         let width = width.max(1);
  603|         let height = height.max(1);
  604|         if width == self.config.width && height == self.config.height {
  605|             return;
  606|         }
  607|         self.config.width = width;
  608|         self.config.height = height;
  609|         self.surface.configure(&self.device, &self.config);
  610|         if let Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) = &mut self.strategy {
  611|             pipeline.resize(&self.device, width, height);
  612|         }
  613|         self.depth_view = create_depth_view(&self.device, width, height);
  614|     }
  615| 
  616|     fn trace_budget(&self) -> u32 {
  617|         match self.profile {
  618|             RendererProfile::Raymarch(profile) => profile.maximum_trace_steps,
  619|             _ => 1,
  620|         }
  621|     }
  622| 
  623|     fn render(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
  624|         let lights = collect_frame_lights(frame);
  625|         let toggles = self.profile.apply_runtime_toggles(self.toggles);
  626|         let common = self.profile.common();
  627|         let uniforms = GpuFrameUniforms::from_frame(
  628|             frame,
  629|             self.config.width,
  630|             self.config.height,
  631|             camera_state::fov_tan(),
  632|             common.maximum_draw_distance,
  633|             self.trace_budget(),
  634|             lights.len(),
  635|             toggles,
  636|         );
  637|         self.frame_resources
  638|             .write(&self.device, &self.queue, &uniforms, &lights);
  639| 
  640|         let surface_texture = match self.surface.get_current_texture() {
  641|             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Success(texture)
  642|             | wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Suboptimal(texture) => texture,
  643|             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Outdated | wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Lost => {
  644|                 self.surface.configure(&self.device, &self.config);
  645|                 return;
  646|             }
  647|             _ => return,
  648|         };
  649|         let view = surface_texture.texture.create_view(&Default::default());
  650|         let mut encoder = self
  651|             .device
  652|             .create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
  653|                 label: Some("vackrooms.native.frame"),
  654|             });
  655|         let aspect = self.config.width as f32 / (self.config.height.max(1)) as f32;
  656|         let fov_tan = camera_state::fov_tan();
  657|         match &mut self.strategy {
  658|             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
  659|                 &self.queue,
  660|                 &mut encoder,
  661|                 &view,
  662|                 &self.depth_view,
  663|                 &self.frame_resources,
  664|                 frame,
  665|                 toggles,
  666|                 lights.len().min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
  667|                 fov_tan,
  668|                 aspect,
  669|             ),
  670|             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
  671|                 &self.queue,
  672|                 &mut encoder,
  673|                 &view,
  674|                 &self.depth_view,
  675|                 &self.frame_resources,
  676|                 frame,
  677|                 toggles,
  678|                 lights.len().min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
  679|                 fov_tan,
  680|                 aspect,
  681|             ),
  682|             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
  683|                 &self.queue,
  684|                 &mut encoder,
  685|                 &view,
  686|                 &self.frame_resources,
  687|                 frame,
  688|                 chunks,
  689|                 toggles,
  690|             ),
  691|             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => {
  692|                 let mut settings = CpuRenderSettings::default();
  693|                 settings.fov_tan = camera_state::fov_tan();
  694|                 settings.toggles = toggles;
  695|                 pipeline.draw(&self.queue, &mut encoder, &view, frame, chunks, settings);
  696|             }
  697|         }
  698|         if matches!(&self.strategy, Strategy::Surface(_) | Strategy::Splat(_)) {
  699|             self.supply_labels.draw(
  700|                 &self.queue,
  701|                 &mut encoder,
  702|                 &view,
  703|                 &self.depth_view,
  704|                 &self.frame_resources,
  705|                 frame,
  706|             );
  707|         }
  708|         let renderer_label = self.profile.renderer().label();
  709|         draw_field_terminal(
  710|             &mut self.terminal,
  711|             &self.hud_snapshot,
  712|             renderer_label,
  713|             self.config.width,
  714|             self.config.height,
  715|         );
  716|         self.terminal.draw(&self.queue, &mut encoder, &view);
  717|         self.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
  718|         self.queue.present(surface_texture);
  719|     }
  720| }
  721| 
  722| fn create_depth_view(device: &wgpu::Device, width: u32, height: u32) -> wgpu::TextureView {
  723|     device
  724|         .create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
  725|             label: Some("vackrooms.native.depth"),
  726|             size: wgpu::Extent3d {
  727|                 width: width.max(1),
  728|                 height: height.max(1),
  729|                 depth_or_array_layers: 1,
  730|             },
  731|             mip_level_count: 1,
  732|             sample_count: 1,
  733|             dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
  734|             format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
  735|             usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
  736|             view_formats: &[],
  737|         })
  738|         .create_view(&Default::default())
  739| }

  741| /// The engine owns its renderer as a boxed port while the event loop still
  742| /// needs resize access, so the native renderer is shared the same way the
  743| /// browser shares its canvas renderer.
  744| #[derive(Clone)]
  745| struct SharedNativeRenderer(std::rc::Rc<std::cell::RefCell<NativeRenderer>>);
  746| 
  747| impl SharedNativeRenderer {

  750|     }

  772| fn draw_field_terminal(
  773|     terminal: &mut crate::terminal::FieldTerminal,
  774|     snapshot: &HudSnapshot,
  775|     renderer_label: &str,
  776|     width: u32,
  777|     height: u32,
  778| ) {
  779|     use crate::terminal::{CRITICAL, HAZARD, INK, LOADING_PLATE, PANEL, QUIET, ROUTE, SYSTEM};
  780|     terminal.begin(width, height);
  781|     let w = width.max(1) as f32;
  782|     let h = height.max(1) as f32;
  783|     let px = 16.0;
  784|     let margin = 18.0;
  785| 
  786|     if !snapshot.ready {
  787|         terminal.rect(0.0, 0.0, w, h, LOADING_PLATE);
  788|         let line = "GENERATING WORLD IN WEBASSEMBLY'S ABSENCE...";
  789|         let lw = terminal.measure(line, 24.0);
  790|         terminal.text(line, (w - lw) * 0.5, h * 0.5, 24.0, INK);
  791|         let seed_line = format!("SEED {}", snapshot.seed);
  792|         let sw = terminal.measure(&seed_line, px);
  793|         terminal.text(&seed_line, (w - sw) * 0.5, h * 0.5 + 28.0, px, QUIET);
  794|         return;
  795|     }
  796| 
  797|     // Top-left: renderer / frame channels, key in quiet, value in ink.
  798|     let mut y = margin + px;
  799|     let pen = terminal.text("renderer ", margin, y, px, QUIET);
  800|     let pen = terminal.text(renderer_label, pen, y, px, INK);
  801|     let pen = terminal.text("   fps ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
  802|     let pen = terminal.text(&format!("{:.0}", snapshot.fps), pen, y, px, INK);
  803|     let pen = terminal.text("   frame ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
  804|     terminal.text("Vulkan", pen, y, px, INK);
  805|     y += terminal.line_height(px);
  806|     let pen = terminal.text("chunks ", margin, y, px, QUIET);
  807|     let pen = terminal.text(
  808|         &format!("{}/{}", snapshot.fine_chunks, snapshot.resident_chunks),
  809|         pen,
  810|         y,
  811|         px,
  812|         INK,
  813|     );
  814|     let pen = terminal.text("   nodes ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
  815|     let pen = terminal.text(&format!("{}", snapshot.atlas_nodes), pen, y, px, INK);
  816|     let pen = terminal.text("   dist ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
  817|     let pen = terminal.text(&format!("{:.0} m", snapshot.distance_m), pen, y, px, INK);
  818|     let pen = terminal.text("   amb ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
  819|     terminal.text(&format!("{:.0} C", snapshot.ambient_c), pen, y, px, INK);
  820| 
  821|     // Top-right: section locator, right-aligned (the web terminal's
  822|     // top-right channel).
  823|     if !snapshot.section.is_empty() {
  824|         let sw = terminal.measure(&snapshot.section, px);
  825|         terminal.text(&snapshot.section, w - margin - sw, margin + px, px, QUIET);
  826|     }
  827| 
  828|     // Bottom-left: body trace, vitals bars, supply pips.
  829|     let bar_w = 220.0;
  830|     let bar_h = 12.0;
  831|     let gap = 7.0;
  832|     let bars_top = h - margin - 3.0 * (bar_h + gap) + gap;
  833|     let signal_color = match snapshot.signal {
  834|         PulseSignal::Quiet => QUIET,
  835|         PulseSignal::Active => INK,
  836|         PulseSignal::Strained => ROUTE,
  837|         PulseSignal::Critical => HAZARD,
  838|     };
  839|     if snapshot.signal != PulseSignal::Quiet {
  840|         terminal.text(
  841|             &format!("{:.0} bpm", snapshot.bpm),
  842|             margin,
  843|             bars_top - 14.0,
  844|             px,
  845|             signal_color,
  846|         );
  847|     }
  848|     let bars = [
  849|         (snapshot.hydration, SYSTEM, "H2O"),
  850|         (snapshot.satiety, ROUTE, "RAT"),
  851|         (snapshot.condition, HAZARD, "BOD"),
  852|     ];
  853|     for (index, (value, color, tag)) in bars.iter().enumerate() {
  854|         let by = bars_top + index as f32 * (bar_h + gap);
  855|         terminal.text(tag, margin, by + bar_h - 1.0, 16.0, QUIET);
  856|         let bx = margin + 46.0;
  857|         terminal.rect(bx - 2.0, by - 2.0, bar_w + 4.0, bar_h + 4.0, PANEL);
  858|         terminal.rect(bx, by, bar_w * value.clamp(0.0, 1.0), bar_h, *color);
  859|     }
  860|     // Discrete supply ticks above the bars, water then rations, like
  861|     // #supply-rack.
  862|     let pip = 9.0;
  863|     let pip_gap = 5.0;
  864|     let pip_y = bars_top - 34.0;
  865|     for index in 0..snapshot.almond_bottles.min(12) {
  866|         terminal.rect(
  867|             margin + 46.0 + index as f32 * (pip + pip_gap),
  868|             pip_y,
  869|             pip,
  870|             pip,
  871|             SYSTEM,
  872|         );
  873|     }
  874|     for index in 0..snapshot.rations.min(12) {
  875|         terminal.rect(
  876|             margin + 46.0 + index as f32 * (pip + pip_gap),
  877|             pip_y - pip - pip_gap,
  878|             pip,
  879|             pip,
  880|             ROUTE,
  881|         );
  882|     }
  883| 
  884|     // Bottom-right: torch state and the config-panel hint.
  885|     let mut right_y = h - margin;
  886|     let hint = "F1 CONFIG";
  887|     let hw = terminal.measure(hint, px);
  888|     terminal.text(hint, w - margin - hw, right_y, px, QUIET);
  889|     right_y -= terminal.line_height(px);
  890|     if snapshot.flashlight {
  891|         let torch = "TORCH ON";
  892|         let tw = terminal.measure(torch, px);
  893|         terminal.text(torch, w - margin - tw, right_y, px, ROUTE);
  894|     }
  895|     if snapshot.deaths > 0 {
  896|         let text = format!("SUCCUMBED x{}", snapshot.deaths);
  897|         let tw = terminal.measure(&text, px);
  898|         terminal.text(
  899|             &text,
  900|             w - margin - tw,
  901|             right_y - terminal.line_height(px),
  902|             px,
  903|             HAZARD,
  904|         );
  905|     }
  906| 
  907|     // Center mark: single restrained fixation point (see #reticle).
  908|     terminal.rect(
  909|         w * 0.5 - 2.0,
  910|         h * 0.5 - 2.0,
  911|         4.0,
  912|         4.0,
  913|         [0.9, 0.9, 0.85, 0.55],
  914|     );
  915| 
  916|     // F1: configuration panel — the native stand-in for the settings menu,
  917|     // documenting the flags and live switches.
  918|     if snapshot.show_config {
  919|         let pw = 560.0_f32.min(w - 2.0 * margin);
  920|         let ph = 330.0_f32.min(h - 2.0 * margin);
  921|         let px0 = (w - pw) * 0.5;
  922|         let py0 = (h - ph) * 0.5;
  923|         terminal.rect(px0, py0, pw, ph, [0.027, 0.039, 0.031, 0.92]);
  924|         let mut ly = py0 + 34.0;
  925|         let lx = px0 + 24.0;
  926|         terminal.text("CONFIGURATION - FIELD TERMINAL", lx, ly, px, CRITICAL);
  927|         ly += terminal.line_height(px) * 1.5;
  928|         let on_off = |on: bool| if on { "ON" } else { "OFF" };
  929|         let rows: Vec<(String, [f32; 4])> = vec![
  930|             (
  931|                 format!("RENDERER   {renderer_label}   (--renderer=surface|splat|raymarch|cpu)"),
  932|                 INK,
  933|             ),
  934|             (
  935|                 format!(
  936|                     "SEED       {}   (--seed=N reproduces this world)",
  937|                     snapshot.seed
  938|                 ),
  939|                 INK,
  940|             ),
  941|             (
  942|                 format!(
  943|                     "F5 SHADOWS          {}",
  944|                     on_off(snapshot.toggles.shadow_pass)
  945|                 ),
  946|                 SYSTEM,
  947|             ),
  948|             (
  949|                 format!(
  950|                     "F6 AMBIENT OCCL.    {}",

  955|             (
  956|                 format!(
  957|                     "F7 DEFERRED SHADING {}",
  958|                     on_off(snapshot.toggles.deferred_shading)
  959|                 ),
  960|                 SYSTEM,
  961|             ),
  962|             (

  985| impl RendererPort for SharedNativeRenderer {
  986|     fn artifact_needs(&self) -> RenderArtifactNeeds {

  988|     }

  990|     fn uses_surface_meshes(&self) -> bool {
  991|         self.artifact_needs().needs_surface_extraction()
  992|     }

  994|     fn upload_surfaces(&mut self, chunks: &[SurfaceChunk<'_>]) {
  995|         let renderer = &mut *self.0.borrow_mut();
  996|         match &mut renderer.strategy {
  997|             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.upload(&renderer.device, chunks),
  998|             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.upload(&renderer.device, chunks),
  999|             _ => {}
 1000|         }
 1001|     }

 1004|         match &mut self.0.borrow_mut().strategy {
 1005|             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.remove(keys),
 1006|             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.remove(keys),
 1007|             _ => {}
 1008|         }
 1009|     }
 1010| 
 1011|     fn clear_surfaces(&mut self) {
 1012|         match &mut self.0.borrow_mut().strategy {
 1013|             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.clear(),
 1014|             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.clear(),
 1015|             _ => {}
 1016|         }
 1017|     }
 1018| 
 1019|     fn upload_atlas(&mut self, texels: &[u32]) {
 1020|         let renderer = &mut *self.0.borrow_mut();
 1021|         match &mut renderer.strategy {
 1022|             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas(&renderer.device, texels),
 1023|             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas(texels),
 1024|             _ => {}
 1025|         }
 1026|     }
 1027| 
 1028|     fn upload_atlas_rows(&mut self, first_row: u32, texels: &[u32]) -> bool {
 1029|         let renderer = &mut *self.0.borrow_mut();
 1030|         match &mut renderer.strategy {
 1031|             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => {
 1032|                 pipeline.upload_atlas_rows(&renderer.queue, first_row, texels)
 1033|             }
 1034|             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas_rows(first_row, texels),

 1040|         let renderer = &mut *self.0.borrow_mut();
 1041|         renderer
 1042|             .supply_labels
 1043|             .upload_atlas(&renderer.device, &renderer.queue, rgba, width, height);
 1044|     }

 1046|     fn draw(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
 1047|         self.0.borrow_mut().render(frame, chunks);
 1048|     }
 1049| }

Noted. app.rs uses `std::rc::Rc<RefCell<NativeRenderer>>` (single-threaded) — the Arc<Window> is only for wgpu instance display handle. Engine tick runs on main thread. So no real threading issue in app.rs except potential RefCell borrow panic (re-entrancy: engine.tick calls renderer.draw → borrow_mut; window_event handles resize via state.renderer.resize → borrow_mut; both sequential, not re-entrant since engine.tick happens inside RedrawRequested, and resize happens in separate event). Note: engine.tick → draw → borrow_mut on Rc<RefCell> — but `set_hud` happens before tick. There could be a RefCell double-borrow if RendererPort::draw re-entered. It's fine.

   48| /// The dual-backend renderer set. WebGL2 is the boot default — it runs on
   49| /// every browser this project targets, including Firefox ESR and mobile —
   50| /// while the WebGPU stack is an explicit opt-in (`?backend=webgpu` or the
   51| /// Settings > Backend switch) until its reach catches up.
   52| enum DriverRenderer {
   53|     Surface(SurfaceRenderer),
   54|     Splat(SplatRenderer),
   55|     Surfel(SurfelRenderer),
   56|     Raymarch(WebGl2Renderer),
   57|     Cpu(CpuCanvasRenderer),
   58|     WebGpu(WebGpuRenderer),
   59| }
   60| 
   61| impl DriverRenderer {
   62|     fn resize(&mut self, width: u32, height: u32) {
   63|         match self {
   64|             DriverRenderer::Surface(r) => r.resize(width, height),
   65|             DriverRenderer::Splat(r) => r.resize(width, height),
   66|             DriverRenderer::Surfel(r) => r.resize(width, height),
   67|             DriverRenderer::Raymarch(r) => r.resize(width, height),
   68|             DriverRenderer::Cpu(r) => r.resize(width, height),
   69|             DriverRenderer::WebGpu(r) => r.resize(width, height),
   70|         }
   71|     }
   72| 
   73|     /// Internal-resolution multiplier (further scaled by the adaptive
   74|     /// governor). The CPU quality model owns its bounded fraction so the
   75|     /// canvas and software framebuffer always have identical dimensions.
   76|     fn resolution_factor(&self) -> f64 {
   77|         match self {
   78|             DriverRenderer::Surface(_)
   79|             | DriverRenderer::Splat(_)
   80|             | DriverRenderer::Surfel(_)
   81|             | DriverRenderer::Raymarch(_) => 1.0,
   82|             DriverRenderer::Cpu(_) => crate::get_cpu_settings().canvas_resolution_factor(),
   83|             DriverRenderer::WebGpu(r) => r.resolution_factor(),
   84|         }
   85|     }
   86| 
   87|     fn label(&self) -> &'static str {
   88|         match self {
   89|             DriverRenderer::Surface(_) => "WebGL2 surfaces",
   90|             DriverRenderer::Splat(_) => "WebGL2 face splats",
   91|             DriverRenderer::Surfel(_) => "WebGL2 surfels",
   92|             DriverRenderer::Raymarch(_) => "WebGL2 raymarch (debug)",
   93|             DriverRenderer::Cpu(_) => "CPU splat",
   94|             DriverRenderer::WebGpu(r) => r.label(),
   95|         }
   96|     }
   97| 
   98|     /// HUD backend chip ("frame" column) when no CPU telemetry applies.
   99|     fn backend_label(&self) -> &'static str {
  100|         match self {
  101|             DriverRenderer::WebGpu(_) => "WebGPU",
  102|             DriverRenderer::Cpu(_) => "Canvas2D",
  103|             _ => "WebGL2",
  104|         }
  105|     }
  106| }
  107| 
  108| impl RendererPort for DriverRenderer {
  109|     fn artifact_needs(&self) -> RenderArtifactNeeds {
  110|         match self {
  111|             DriverRenderer::Surface(_) => RenderArtifactNeeds::SURFACE,
  112|             // The splat driver expands compact face pages, but its hero
  113|             // shadow pass still rasterizes the indexed mesh.
  114|             DriverRenderer::Splat(_) => {
  115|                 RenderArtifactNeeds::SPLAT.union(RenderArtifactNeeds::SURFACE)
  116|             }
  117|             // Discs only. The surfel driver has no shadow pass, so unlike
  118|             // the splat driver it never needs the indexed mesh alongside.
  119|             DriverRenderer::Surfel(_) => RenderArtifactNeeds::SURFEL,
  120|             // WebGL2's fullscreen marcher reads the bricked hierarchy by
  121|             // default, matching the WebGPU strategy below -- see
  122|             // `drivers/webgl::atlas::BrickVoxelTexture`. `?bricks=0` puts it
  123|             // back on the plain SVDAG for comparison.
  124|             DriverRenderer::Raymarch(r) => r.artifact_needs(),
  125|             DriverRenderer::Cpu(_) => RenderArtifactNeeds::CPU,
  126|             DriverRenderer::WebGpu(r) => r.artifact_needs(),
  127|         }
  128|     }
  129| 
  130|     fn uses_surface_meshes(&self) -> bool {
  131|         self.artifact_needs().needs_surface_extraction()
  132|     }
  133| 
  134|     fn upload_surfaces(&mut self, chunks: &[SurfaceChunk<'_>]) {
  135|         match self {
  136|             DriverRenderer::Surface(r) => r.upload_surfaces(chunks),
  137|             DriverRenderer::Splat(r) => r.upload_surfaces(chunks),
  138|             DriverRenderer::Surfel(r) => r.upload_surfaces(chunks),
  139|             DriverRenderer::WebGpu(r) => r.upload_surfaces(chunks),
  140|             _ => {}
  141|         }
  142|     }
  143| 
  144|     fn remove_surfaces(&mut self, keys: &[SurfaceChunkKey]) {
  145|         match self {
  146|             DriverRenderer::Surface(r) => r.remove_surfaces(keys),
  147|             DriverRenderer::Splat(r) => r.remove_surfaces(keys),
  148|             DriverRenderer::Surfel(r) => r.remove_surfaces(keys),
  149|             DriverRenderer::WebGpu(r) => r.remove_surfaces(keys),
  150|             _ => {}
  151|         }
  152|     }
  153| 
  154|     fn clear_surfaces(&mut self) {
  155|         match self {
  156|             DriverRenderer::Surface(r) => r.clear_surfaces(),
  157|             DriverRenderer::Splat(r) => r.clear_surfaces(),
  158|             DriverRenderer::Surfel(r) => r.clear_surfaces(),
  159|             DriverRenderer::WebGpu(r) => r.clear_surfaces(),
  160|             _ => {}
  161|         }
  162|     }

  166|             DriverRenderer::Surface(r) => r.cpu_telemetry_string(),
  167|             DriverRenderer::Splat(r) => r.cpu_telemetry_string(),
  168|             DriverRenderer::Surfel(r) => r.cpu_telemetry_string(),
  169|             DriverRenderer::Raymarch(r) => r.cpu_telemetry_string(),
  170|             DriverRenderer::Cpu(r) => r.cpu_telemetry_string(),
  171|             DriverRenderer::WebGpu(r) => r.cpu_telemetry_string(),
  172|         }
  173|     }

  220|             DriverRenderer::Surfel(r) => r.draw(frame, chunks),
  221|             DriverRenderer::Raymarch(r) => r.draw(frame, chunks),
