  111| /// World-hash and interleaved-gradient-noise helpers.
  112| ///
  113| /// OPTIMIZATION: IGN is two `fract`s and a `dot` — far cheaper than a
  114| /// sin-hash — and is used to break up 8-bit banding in fog gradients,
  115| /// which is especially visible at reduced internal resolutions.
  116| pub const NOISE_GLSL: &str = r#"
  117| float hash3D(vec3 p) {
  118|     return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(12.9898, 78.233, 45.164))) * 43758.5453);
  119| }
  120| 
  121| float ign(vec2 p) {
  122|     vec3 magic = vec3(0.06711056, 0.00583715, 52.9829189);
  123|     return fract(magic.z * fract(dot(p, magic.xy)));
  124| }
  125| "#;
  126| 
  127| /// World-locked procedural finishes shared by WebGL surface and splat paths.
  128| /// The wallpaper motif is generated geometry, not a copied texture asset.
  129| pub const MATERIAL_PATTERN_GLSL: &str = r#"
  130| float materialNoise2D(vec2 p) {
  131|     vec2 cell = floor(p);
  132|     vec2 f = fract(p);
  133|     vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
  134|     float a = hash3D(vec3(cell, 17.0));
  135|     float b = hash3D(vec3(cell + vec2(1.0, 0.0), 17.0));
  136|     float c = hash3D(vec3(cell + vec2(0.0, 1.0), 17.0));
  137|     float d = hash3D(vec3(cell + vec2(1.0, 1.0), 17.0));
  138|     return mix(mix(a, b, u.x), mix(c, d, u.x), u.y);
  139| }
  140| 
  141| vec3 applyMaterialPattern(
  142|     float material,
  143|     vec3 albedo,
  144|     vec3 world,
  145|     vec3 normal,
  146|     float sampleFootprint
  147| ) {
  148|     bool carpet = material > 1.5 && material < 2.5
  149|         || material > 11.5 && material < 14.5
  150|         || material > 24.5 && material < 25.5;
  151|     if (carpet && normal.y > 0.5) {
  152|         float broad = materialNoise2D(world.xz * 0.18);
  153|         float fibers = materialNoise2D(world.xz * 1.15);
  154|         float detail = clamp(1.15 - sampleFootprint * 0.32, 0.20, 1.0);
  155|         float wear = 0.88 + 0.18 * broad + (fibers - 0.5) * 0.055 * detail;
  156|         return albedo * wear;
  157|     }
  158| 
  159|     bool wallpaper = material > 0.5 && material < 1.5
  160|         || material > 23.5 && material < 24.5;
  161|     if (wallpaper && abs(normal.y) < 0.5) {
  162|         float along = abs(normal.x) > 0.5 ? world.z : world.x;
  163|         float repeat = fract(along / 1.35);
  164|         float center = abs(repeat - 0.5);
  165|         float stem = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.035, 0.085, center);
  166|         float vine = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(world.y * 3.1 + sin(along * 2.4) * 0.8);
  167|         float medallion = pow(max(cos((repeat - 0.5) * 6.2831853), 0.0), 6.0)
  168|             * pow(max(cos((world.y - 0.35) * 3.1415926), 0.0), 4.0);
  169|         float age = material > 23.5 ? 1.0 : 0.0;
  170|         float stain = materialNoise2D(vec2(along * 0.09, world.y * 0.16));
  171|         float motif = stem * (0.45 + 0.55 * vine) + medallion * 0.55;
  172|         float factor = 1.025 - motif * (0.12 + age * 0.035) - age * stain * 0.07;
  173|         return albedo * factor;
  174|     }
  175|     return albedo;
  176| }
  177| "#;
  178| 
  179| /// Reinhard tone map + gamma, shared by the surface and splat fragments.
  180| pub const TONE_MAP_GLSL: &str = r#"
  181| vec3 toneMap(vec3 color) {
  182|     color = color / (color + vec3(1.0));
  183|     return pow(color, vec3(1.0 / 2.2));
  184| }
  185| "#;
  186| 
  187| /// Flare-core glow sprites: additive embers occluded by any surface nearer
  188| /// than the flare along the fragment's view ray — no x-ray dots. Shared by
  189| /// the surface and splat fragments; requires the `uCoreCount` / `uCores` /
  190| /// `uCoreColors` uniforms to be declared before this chunk is spliced in
  191| /// (both programs declare them identically).
  192| pub const FLARE_CORES_GLSL: &str = r#"
  193| vec3 flareCoresThroughMedium(
  194|     vec3 worldPos,
  195|     vec3 camPos,
  196|     float fogStart,
  197|     float sigmaExtinction
  198| ) {
  199|     vec3 toFrag = worldPos - camPos;
  200|     float fragDist = length(toFrag);
  201|     vec3 rd = toFrag / max(fragDist, 1e-4);
  202|     vec3 sum = vec3(0.0);
  203|     for (int i = 0; i < uCoreCount; i++) {
  204|         vec3 toLight = uCores[i].xyz - camPos;
  205|         float along = dot(toLight, rd);
  206|         if (along <= 0.05 || along >= fragDist) continue;
  207|         float perp = length(toLight - rd * along);
  208|         float coreSize = 0.06 + along * 0.004;
  209|         float core = 1.0 - smoothstep(coreSize * 0.4, coreSize, perp);
  210|         float mediumDistance = max(along - max(fogStart, 0.0), 0.0);
  211|         float transmittance = exp(-max(sigmaExtinction, 0.0) * mediumDistance);
  212|         sum += uCoreColors[i] * uCores[i].w * core * 1.4 * transmittance;
  213|     }
  214|     return sum;
  215| }
  216| 
  217| vec3 flareCores(vec3 worldPos, vec3 camPos) {
  218|     return flareCoresThroughMedium(worldPos, camPos, 0.0, 0.0);
  219| }
  220| "#;
===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/splat.rs (369 lines) =====
    1| //! Instanced face-splat program — the GPU microvoxel path.
    2| //!
    3| //! One instance is one axis-aligned surface rectangle (`PackedFaceInstance`);
    4| //! the vertex shader rebuilds the quad from center + extents + axis via
    5| //! `gl_VertexID` (4-vertex TRIANGLE_STRIP). Lighting is evaluated at those
    6| //! four corners and interpolated, avoiding the large, uniformly lit patches
    7| //! produced by one face-center sample without paying per-fragment light loops.
    8| 
    9| use super::{chunks, encode_display_color};
   10| 
   11| /// Preamble: version, attributes, uniforms, varyings.
   12| const VERTEX_HEADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
   13| precision highp float;
   14| precision highp sampler3D;
   15| 
   16| in vec3 aFacePos;      // face center, chunk-local fixed point (1/1024 u)
   17| in vec2 aFaceExtents;  // cells along the face's U/V axes
   18| in vec4 aFaceMeta;     // normal_axis, material, baked_light (0-15), ao
   19| in float aFaceFlags;   // bit 0: emissive
   20| 
   21| uniform mat4 uProjection;
   22| uniform mat4 uView;
   23| uniform vec3 uChunkOrigin;
   24| uniform vec3 uChunkSize;
   25| uniform float uVoxelScale;
   26| uniform vec3 uCameraPosition;
   27| // Camera forward axis for the flashlight cone.
   28| uniform vec3 uCamForward;
   29| uniform int uFlashlightEnabled;
   30| uniform sampler3D uLightVolume;
   31| 
   32| uniform int uLightCount;
   33| uniform vec3 uLightPositions[16];
   34| uniform vec3 uLightColors[16];
   35| uniform vec4 uLightParams[16];
   36| 
   37| uniform sampler2D uShadowMap;
   38| uniform mat4 uLightViewProjection;
   39| uniform int uShadowedLightIndex;
   40| uniform int uShadowTaps;
   41| 
   42| // Level atmosphere (see the surface shader).
   43| uniform int uOutdoor;
   44| uniform float uAmbientScale;
   45| 
   46| out vec3 vWorldPos;
   47| out vec3 vColor;
   48| flat out vec3 vNormal;
   49| flat out float vMaterial;
   50| flat out float vEmissive;
   51| flat out float vGrainAmp;
   52| flat out float vBeamPattern;
   53| "#;
   54| 
   55| /// Quad reconstruction + per-corner lighting body.
   56| const VERTEX_BODY: &str = r#"
   57| vec3 normalForAxis(float axis) {
   58|     if (axis < 0.5) return vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
   59|     if (axis < 1.5) return vec3(0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
   60|     if (axis < 2.5) return vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
   61|     if (axis < 3.5) return vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
   62|     if (axis < 4.5) return vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
   63|     return vec3(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
   64| }
   65| 
   66| // In-plane basis with U x V = outward normal, so the TRIANGLE_STRIP corner
   67| // order (-1,-1)(1,-1)(-1,1)(1,1) is counter-clockwise from the front.
   68| void faceBasis(float axis, out vec3 u, out vec3 v) {
   69|     if (axis < 0.5)      { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
   70|     else if (axis < 1.5) { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
   71|     else if (axis < 2.5) { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, -1.0, 0.0); }
   72|     else if (axis < 3.5) { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); }
   73|     else if (axis < 4.5) { u = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
   74|     else                 { u = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
   75| }
   76| 
   77| // Face-center shadow visibility. Vertex shaders have no derivatives or
   78| // gl_FragCoord, so this uses a fixed symmetric tap pattern; tap count is a
   79| // spec-profile knob (1 on Pi-class, 4 on high).
   80| float shadowVisibility(vec3 worldPos, vec3 normal, vec3 lightDir) {
   81|     vec4 lightClip = uLightViewProjection * vec4(worldPos + normal * 0.025, 1.0);
   82|     vec3 p = lightClip.xyz / lightClip.w;
   83|     vec2 uv = p.xy * 0.5 + 0.5;
   84|     float receiverDepth = p.z * 0.5 + 0.5;
   85|     if (any(lessThan(uv, vec2(0.0))) || any(greaterThan(uv, vec2(1.0))) || receiverDepth >= 1.0) {
   86|         return 1.0;
   87|     }
   88|     float bias = max(0.003 * (1.0 - dot(normal, lightDir)), 0.0008);
   89|     float compare = receiverDepth - bias;
   90|     if (uShadowTaps <= 1) {
   91|         float d = textureLod(uShadowMap, uv, 0.0).r;
   92|         return (compare > d) ? 0.0 : 1.0;
   93|     }
   94|     vec2 texelSize = 1.0 / vec2(textureSize(uShadowMap, 0));
   95|     vec2 offsets[4] = vec2[](
   96|         vec2(-0.5, -0.5), vec2(0.5, -0.5),
   97|         vec2(-0.5,  0.5), vec2(0.5,  0.5)
   98|     );
   99|     float shadow = 0.0;
  100|     for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
  101|         float d = textureLod(uShadowMap, uv + offsets[i] * texelSize, 0.0).r;
  102|         shadow += (compare > d) ? 0.0 : 1.0;
  103|     }
  104|     return shadow * 0.25;
  105| }
  106| 
  107| void main() {
  108|     vec2 corner = vec2(
  109|         (gl_VertexID == 1 || gl_VertexID == 3) ? 1.0 : -1.0,
  110|         (gl_VertexID >= 2) ? 1.0 : -1.0
  111|     );
  112|     vec3 N = normalForAxis(aFaceMeta.x);
  113|     vec3 U, V;
  114|     faceBasis(aFaceMeta.x, U, V);
  115| 
  116|     vec3 center = uChunkOrigin + aFacePos * (1.0 / 1024.0);
  117|     float halfU = aFaceExtents.x * uVoxelScale * 0.5;
  118|     float halfV = aFaceExtents.y * uVoxelScale * 0.5;
  119|     vec3 world = center + corner.x * halfU * U + corner.y * halfV * V;
  120|     vWorldPos = world;
  121|     vNormal = N;
  122|     vMaterial = aFaceMeta.y;
  123|     gl_Position = uProjection * uView * vec4(world, 1.0);
  124| 
  125|     vec3 albedo = srgbToLinear(materialColor(aFaceMeta.y));
  126|     bool emissive = aFaceFlags > 0.5;
  127|     vEmissive = emissive ? 1.0 : 0.0;
  128|     // Per-voxel grain amplitude: subtle on walls/floors, none on ceilings
  129|     // (a bright ceiling plane turns grain into salt-and-pepper noise) or
  130|     // emissive fixtures.
  131|     bool isCeiling = aFaceMeta.y > 2.5 && aFaceMeta.y < 3.5;
  132|     vGrainAmp = (emissive || isCeiling) ? 0.0 : 0.02;
  133|     // Coffer beams live in shading, not geometry: downward ceiling faces
  134|     // get a world-locked beam-grid darkening in the fragment shader.
  135|     vBeamPattern = (isCeiling && aFaceMeta.x > 0.5 && aFaceMeta.x < 1.5) ? 1.0 : 0.0;
  136|     if (emissive) {
  137|         vColor = albedo * 1.5;
  138|         return;
  139|     }
  140| 
  141|     vec3 toCamera = uCameraPosition - world;
  142|     float distanceToCamera = length(toCamera);
  143| 
  144|     // Sample the baked light volume half a voxel into the air so a face
  145|     // never reads the dark interior of its own wall.
  146|     vec3 samplePos = world + N * (0.5 * uVoxelScale);
  147|     vec3 uvw = (samplePos - uChunkOrigin) / uChunkSize;
  148|     vec3 irradiance = textureLod(uLightVolume, clamp(uvw, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0).rgb;
  149|     // The compact face record carries the scalar bake too. It is a robust
  150|     // floor at chunk borders and preserves the CPU splatter's light bands,
  151|     // while the 3D volume supplies the actual warm/red chroma.
  152|     vec3 roomAmbient = vec3(0.045, 0.040, 0.024);
  153|     vec3 bouncedLight = irradiance * 0.12;
  154|     irradiance = roomAmbient + bouncedLight;
  155|     if (uOutdoor == 1) {
  156|         irradiance = max(irradiance, vec3(0.30, 0.32, 0.36));
  157|     }
  158| 
  159|     float faceResponse = 0.8;
  160|     if (N.y > 0.5) {
  161|         faceResponse = 1.0;
  162|     } else if (N.y < -0.5) {
  163|         faceResponse = 0.35;
  164|     } else {
  165|         faceResponse = 0.65 + 0.1 * N.x + 0.05 * N.z;
  166|     }
  167| 
  168|     float ao = mix(1.0, 0.62, clamp(aFaceMeta.w, 0.0, 1.0));
  169| 
  170|     vec3 ambientUp = vec3(1.05, 1.0, 0.72) * irradiance;
  171|     vec3 ambientDown = vec3(0.58, 0.52, 0.30) * irradiance;
  172|     if (uOutdoor == 1) {
  173|         ambientUp = vec3(0.98, 1.02, 1.08) * irradiance;
  174|         ambientDown = vec3(0.56, 0.58, 0.55) * irradiance;
  175|     }
  176|     vec3 ambient = mix(ambientDown, ambientUp, N.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * ao * faceResponse * uAmbientScale;
  177| 
  178|     vec3 directDiffuse = vec3(0.0);
  179|     for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
  180|         if (i >= uLightCount) break;
  181|         vec3 toLight = uLightPositions[i] - world;
  182|         float d2 = dot(toLight, toLight);
  183|         float range = uLightParams[i].x;
  184|         float range2 = range * range;
  185|         if (d2 >= range2) continue;
  186| 
  187|         float d = sqrt(d2);
  188|         vec3 L = toLight / max(d, 0.001);
  189|         float ndotl = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
  190|         float x = clamp(d2 / range2, 0.0, 1.0);
  191|         float falloff = (1.0 - x) * (1.0 - x);
  192| 
  193|         float visible = 1.0;
  194|         if (i == uShadowedLightIndex) {
  195|             visible = shadowVisibility(world, N, L);
  196|         }
  197| 
  198|         float lightHash = hash3D(uLightPositions[i] * 10.0);
  199|         float directMod = 1.0 + 0.05 * (lightHash - 0.5);
  200|         vec3 lightColor = mix(uLightColors[i], vec3(1.0, 0.96, 0.85), 0.3);
  201|         directDiffuse += lightColor * uLightParams[i].y * falloff * visible * ndotl * directMod;
  202|     }
  203| 
  204|     // Flashlight: the shared spotlight cone (spec in the CPU splatter).
  205|     // Kept INSIDE the light sum: the material color is the immutable base
  206|     // and every light multiplies it, so the flashlight brightens yellow
  207|     // walls toward brighter yellow, never neutral grey.
  208|     vec3 flashlight = vec3(0.0);
  209|     if (uFlashlightEnabled == 1) {
  210|         flashlight = spotBeam(uCameraPosition, uCamForward, center, N);
  211|     }
  212| 
  213|     const float INV_PI = 0.3183098861837907;
  214|     vColor = albedo * ((ambient + directDiffuse) * INV_PI + flashlight);
  215| }
  216| "#;
  217| 
  218| /// Fragment preamble.
  219| const FRAGMENT_HEADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
  220| precision highp float;
  221| // Fragment ints default to mediump; the vertex stage declares uOutdoor at
  222| // its (highp) default, and linking demands the precisions match.
  223| precision highp int;
  224| 
  225| in vec3 vWorldPos;
  226| in vec3 vColor;
  227| flat in vec3 vNormal;
  228| flat in float vMaterial;
  229| flat in float vEmissive;
  230| flat in float vGrainAmp;
  231| flat in float vBeamPattern;
  232| 
  233| uniform vec3 uCameraPosition;
  234| uniform float uVoxelScale;
  235| // Optimization/effect toggle: grain + banding dither (RenderToggles).
  236| uniform int uDitherEnabled;
  237| 
  238| // Dropped-flare cores: xyz = world position, w = intensity (pre-flickered).
  239| uniform int uCoreCount;
  240| uniform vec4 uCores[4];
  241| uniform vec3 uCoreColors[4];
  242| 
  243| // Level atmosphere: outdoors the fog fades to a bright sky haze instead of
  244| // black (the framebuffer is cleared to the matching sky color).
  245| uniform int uOutdoor;
  246| uniform vec3 uFogColor;
  247| 
  248| out vec4 fragColor;
  249| "#;
  250| 
  251| /// The splat fragment body remains deliberately small: procedural finish,
  252| /// fog, voxel-lattice grain, ordered dither, and display encoding. Lighting
  253| /// arrives interpolated from the vertex shader.
  254| const FRAGMENT_BODY: &str = r#"
  255| void main() {
  256|     vec3 color = applyMaterialPattern(
  257|         vMaterial, vColor, vWorldPos, vNormal, uVoxelScale
  258|     );
  259|     float distanceToCamera = length(uCameraPosition - vWorldPos);
  260| 
  261|     if (vEmissive < 0.5) {
  262|         // World-locked per-voxel albedo grain: sample half a voxel inside
  263|         // the surface so faces lying exactly on lattice planes hash stably.
  264|         // Amplitude is per-face (zero on ceilings) so large bright planes
  265|         // read as solid construction, not noise.
  266|         vec3 lattice = floor((vWorldPos - vNormal * (0.5 * uVoxelScale)) / uVoxelScale);
  267|         float grain = 1.0 + (hash3D(lattice) - 0.5) * 2.0 * vGrainAmp * float(uDitherEnabled);
  268|         color *= grain;
  269| 
  270|         // Coffer beam grid on ceilings (matches the generator's
  271|         // COFFER_PERIOD): intentional construction lines, zero geometry.
  272|         if (vBeamPattern > 0.5) {
  273|             bool onBeam = mod(vWorldPos.x, 2.8) < 0.22 || mod(vWorldPos.z, 2.8) < 0.22;
  274|             if (onBeam) {
  275|                 color *= 0.86;
  276|             }
  277|         }
  278| 
  279|     }
  280| 
  281|     // Warm haze nearby, fading all the way to black before the draw limit.
  282|     // The framebuffer is cleared to the same black, so a not-yet-generated
  283|     // chunk reads as void instead of a brown rectangle.
  284|     float fogOnset = 14.0;
  285|     float fogDist = max(0.0, distanceToCamera - fogOnset);
  286|     float fogDensity = 0.032;
  287|     float heightFactor = 1.0 + 0.35 * smoothstep(0.0, 3.4, vWorldPos.y);
  288|     float fogAmount = 1.0 - exp(-fogDist * fogDensity * heightFactor);
  289|     fogAmount = max(fogAmount, smoothstep(34.0, 48.0, distanceToCamera));
  290| 
  291|     float hNorm = clamp(vWorldPos.y / 5.0, 0.0, 1.0);
  292|     vec3 heightFogColor = mix(
  293|         vec3(0.055, 0.040, 0.014),
  294|         vec3(0.055, 0.060, 0.020),
  295|         hNorm
  296|     );
  297|     float farFade = smoothstep(28.0, 48.0, distanceToCamera);
  298|     vec3 currentFogColor = mix(heightFogColor, vec3(0.0), farFade);
  299|     if (uOutdoor == 1) {
  300|         currentFogColor = uFogColor;
  301|     }
  302|     color = mix(color, currentFogColor, clamp(fogAmount, 0.0, 1.0));
  303| 
  304|     // Flare cores (shared chunk; occluded by nearer surfaces).
  305|     color += flareCores(vWorldPos, uCameraPosition);
  306| 
  307|     color = encodeDisplayColor(color);
  308|     color += (ign(gl_FragCoord.xy) - 0.5) * (1.0 / 128.0) * (1.0 - fogAmount) * float(uDitherEnabled);
  309| 
  310|     fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
  311| }
  312| "#;

  326|     source.push_str(&material_color);

===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/surfel.rs (332 lines) =====
    1| //! Instanced surfel program — the GPU disc splatter.
    2| //!
    3| //! One instance is one oriented disc (`PackedSurfel`). The vertex shader
    4| //! builds a square in the disc's own tangent plane from `gl_VertexID`
    5| //! (4-vertex TRIANGLE_STRIP) and the fragment shader discards everything
    6| //! outside the inscribed circle.
    7| //!
    8| //! ## Why the quad lies in the surface, not across the screen
    9| //!
   10| //! The obvious way to draw a disc is a camera-facing billboard. That is
   11| //! wrong here for a reason that only shows up in a corner: a billboard is
   12| //! perpendicular to the view, so where two walls meet, the two clouds'
   13| //! billboards interpenetrate and the seam crawls as the camera turns. A
   14| //! quad lying *in* the surface has the surface's own depth at every
   15| //! fragment, so two walls meet exactly along their true intersection and
   16| //! stay there.
   17| //!
   18| //! It also removes the CPU splatter's hardest problem for free. That
   19| //! implementation carries one depth per surfel and needs a per-pixel depth
   20| //! *window* to stop coplanar neighbours arbitrating for pixels; an
   21| //! in-surface quad gets depth interpolated per fragment, so neighbours
   22| //! agree exactly where they overlap and the ordinary depth test is enough.
   23| //!
   24| //! Lighting is the splat path's, minus the shadow map: a surfel cloud has
   25| //! no retained mesh to cast with, and inventing one would make the two
   26| //! representations disagree about the silhouette.
   27| 
   28| use super::{chunks, encode_display_color};
   29| 
   30| const VERTEX_HEADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
   31| precision highp float;
   32| precision highp sampler3D;
   33| 
   34| in vec3 aSurfelPos;    // disc centre, chunk-local fixed point (1/1024 u)
   35| in vec4 aSurfelMeta;   // radius (1/32 u steps), normal_axis, material, baked_light
   36| in vec2 aSurfelFlags;  // ao, flags (bit 0: emissive)
   37| 
   38| uniform mat4 uProjection;
   39| uniform mat4 uView;
   40| uniform vec3 uChunkOrigin;
   41| uniform vec3 uChunkSize;
   42| uniform float uVoxelScale;
   43| uniform vec3 uCameraPosition;
   44| uniform vec3 uCamForward;
   45| uniform int uFlashlightEnabled;
   46| uniform sampler3D uLightVolume;
   47| 
   48| uniform int uLightCount;
   49| uniform vec3 uLightPositions[16];
   50| uniform vec3 uLightColors[16];
   51| uniform vec4 uLightParams[16];
   52| 
   53| uniform int uOutdoor;
   54| uniform float uAmbientScale;
   55| 
   56| out vec3 vWorldPos;
   57| out vec3 vColor;
   58| out vec2 vDisc;        // position within the disc, unit circle
   59| flat out vec3 vNormal;
   60| flat out float vMaterial;
   61| flat out float vEmissive;
   62| flat out float vGrainAmp;
   63| "#;
   64| 
   65| const VERTEX_BODY: &str = r#"
   66| vec3 normalForAxis(float axis) {
   67|     if (axis < 0.5) return vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
   68|     if (axis < 1.5) return vec3(0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
   69|     if (axis < 2.5) return vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
   70|     if (axis < 3.5) return vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
   71|     if (axis < 4.5) return vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
   72|     return vec3(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
   73| }
   74| 
   75| // In-plane basis with U x V = outward normal, so the strip order
   76| // (-1,-1)(1,-1)(-1,1)(1,1) is counter-clockwise seen from the front.
   77| void faceBasis(float axis, out vec3 u, out vec3 v) {
   78|     if (axis < 0.5)      { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
   79|     else if (axis < 1.5) { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
   80|     else if (axis < 2.5) { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, -1.0, 0.0); }
   81|     else if (axis < 3.5) { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); }
   82|     else if (axis < 4.5) { u = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
   83|     else                 { u = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
   84| }
   85| 
   86| void main() {
   87|     vec2 corner = vec2(
   88|         (gl_VertexID == 1 || gl_VertexID == 3) ? 1.0 : -1.0,
   89|         (gl_VertexID >= 2) ? 1.0 : -1.0
   90|     );
   91|     vDisc = corner;
   92| 
   93|     float axis = aSurfelMeta.y;
   94|     vec3 N = normalForAxis(axis);
   95|     vec3 U, V;
   96|     faceBasis(axis, U, V);
   97| 
   98|     // RADIUS_QUANT, mirrored from adapters::surfel_cloud. The disc is
   99|     // inscribed in this square, so the square is the full diameter across.
  100|     float radius = aSurfelMeta.x * (1.0 / 32.0);
  101|     vec3 centre = uChunkOrigin + aSurfelPos * (1.0 / 1024.0);
  102|     // Lift the quad a hair off its own surface along the normal. Discs and
  103|     // the surface they sample are exactly coplanar, and on a depth buffer
  104|     // exact coplanarity is the one thing that reliably z-fights.
  105|     vec3 world = centre + N * (0.0015)
  106|         + corner.x * radius * U + corner.y * radius * V;
  107| 
  108|     vWorldPos = world;
  109|     vNormal = N;
  110|     vMaterial = aSurfelMeta.z;
  111|     gl_Position = uProjection * uView * vec4(world, 1.0);
  112| 
  113|     vec3 albedo = srgbToLinear(materialColor(aSurfelMeta.z));
  114|     bool emissive = aSurfelFlags.y > 0.5;
  115|     vEmissive = emissive ? 1.0 : 0.0;
  116|     bool isCeiling = aSurfelMeta.z > 2.5 && aSurfelMeta.z < 3.5;
  117|     vGrainAmp = (emissive || isCeiling) ? 0.0 : 0.02;
  118|     if (emissive) {
  119|         vColor = albedo * 1.5;
  120|         return;
  121|     }
  122| 
  123|     vec3 samplePos = centre + N * (0.5 * uVoxelScale);
  124|     vec3 uvw = (samplePos - uChunkOrigin) / uChunkSize;
  125|     vec3 irradiance = textureLod(uLightVolume, clamp(uvw, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0).rgb;
  126|     vec3 roomAmbient = vec3(0.045, 0.040, 0.024);
  127|     irradiance = roomAmbient + irradiance * 0.12;
  128|     if (uOutdoor == 1) {
  129|         irradiance = max(irradiance, vec3(0.30, 0.32, 0.36));
  130|     }
  131| 
  132|     float faceResponse;
  133|     if (N.y > 0.5) {
  134|         faceResponse = 1.0;
  135|     } else if (N.y < -0.5) {
  136|         faceResponse = 0.35;
  137|     } else {
  138|         faceResponse = 0.65 + 0.1 * N.x + 0.05 * N.z;
  139|     }
  140| 
  141|     float ao = mix(1.0, 0.62, clamp(aSurfelFlags.x, 0.0, 1.0));
  142|     vec3 ambientUp = vec3(1.05, 1.0, 0.72) * irradiance;
  143|     vec3 ambientDown = vec3(0.58, 0.52, 0.30) * irradiance;
  144|     if (uOutdoor == 1) {
  145|         ambientUp = vec3(0.98, 1.02, 1.08) * irradiance;
  146|         ambientDown = vec3(0.56, 0.58, 0.55) * irradiance;
  147|     }
  148|     vec3 ambient = mix(ambientDown, ambientUp, N.y * 0.5 + 0.5)
  149|         * ao * faceResponse * uAmbientScale;
  150| 
  151|     vec3 directDiffuse = vec3(0.0);
  152|     for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
  153|         if (i >= uLightCount) break;
  154|         vec3 toLight = uLightPositions[i] - world;
  155|         float d2 = dot(toLight, toLight);
  156|         float range = uLightParams[i].x;
  157|         float range2 = range * range;
  158|         if (d2 >= range2) continue;
  159| 
  160|         float d = sqrt(d2);
  161|         vec3 L = toLight / max(d, 0.001);
  162|         float ndotl = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
  163|         float x = clamp(d2 / range2, 0.0, 1.0);
  164|         float falloff = (1.0 - x) * (1.0 - x);
  165|         float lightHash = hash3D(uLightPositions[i] * 10.0);
  166|         float directMod = 1.0 + 0.05 * (lightHash - 0.5);
  167|         vec3 lightColor = mix(uLightColors[i], vec3(1.0, 0.96, 0.85), 0.3);
  168|         directDiffuse += lightColor * uLightParams[i].y * falloff * ndotl * directMod;
  169|     }
  170| 
  171|     vec3 flashlight = vec3(0.0);
  172|     if (uFlashlightEnabled == 1) {
  173|         flashlight = spotBeam(uCameraPosition, uCamForward, centre, N);
  174|     }
  175| 
  176|     const float INV_PI = 0.3183098861837907;
  177|     vColor = albedo * ((ambient + directDiffuse) * INV_PI + flashlight);
  178| }

  269| /// Assembles the fragment shader (disc mask, finish, fog, encoding).
  270| pub fn fragment_source() -> String {

  272|         FRAGMENT_HEADER.len()

===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/supply_labels.rs (89 lines) =====
    1| //! Billboard pass for supply-item product labels.
    2| //!
    3| //! Each sprite is one camera-facing (cylindrical: yaw only, world-up locked)
    4| //! textured quad expanded entirely in the vertex shader from `gl_VertexID`,
    5| //! so the pass needs no vertex buffers at all. The atlas stacks one product
    6| //! logo per row; alpha cutout keeps the pass depth-tested and order-free.
    7| 
    8| use super::chunks;
    9| 
   10| /// Matches `application::ports::MAX_SUPPLY_SPRITES`.
   11| pub const MAX_SPRITES: usize = 16;
   12| /// Label quad half-extents in world units (matches the 4:3 label art).
   13| pub const HALF_WIDTH: f32 = 0.26;
   14| pub const HALF_HEIGHT: f32 = 0.195;
   15| /// Atlas rows available to `SupplySprite::atlas_row`.
   16| pub const ATLAS_ROWS: f32 = 2.0;
   17| 
   18| pub const VERTEX_SHADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
   19| precision highp float;
   20| 
   21| uniform mat4 uProjection;
   22| uniform mat4 uView;
   23| // xyz = world center of the label, w = atlas row.
   24| uniform vec4 uSprites[16];
   25| // Ground-plane camera right: the quad turns with the player's yaw and
   26| // never tilts, like a stand-up card.
   27| uniform vec3 uCamRight;
   28| uniform vec2 uHalfSize;
   29| 
   30| out vec2 vUv;
   31| flat out float vRow;
   32| out vec3 vWorld;
   33| 
   34| const vec2 CORNERS[6] = vec2[6](
   35|     vec2(-1.0, -1.0), vec2(1.0, -1.0), vec2(1.0, 1.0),
   36|     vec2(-1.0, -1.0), vec2(1.0, 1.0), vec2(-1.0, 1.0)
   37| );
   38| 
   39| void main() {
   40|     int sprite = gl_VertexID / 6;
   41|     vec2 corner = CORNERS[gl_VertexID % 6];
   42|     vec4 s = uSprites[sprite];
   43|     vec3 world = s.xyz
   44|         + uCamRight * (corner.x * uHalfSize.x)
   45|         + vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0) * (corner.y * uHalfSize.y);
   46|     vUv = vec2(corner.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - corner.y * 0.5);
   47|     vRow = s.w;
   48|     vWorld = world;
   49|     gl_Position = uProjection * uView * vec4(world, 1.0);
   50| }
   51| "#;
   52| 
   53| pub fn fragment_source() -> String {
   54|     let mut source = String::from(
   55|         r#"#version 300 es
   56| precision highp float;
   57| 
   58| in vec2 vUv;
   59| flat in float vRow;
   60| in vec3 vWorld;
   61| 
   62| uniform sampler2D uAtlas;
   63| uniform vec3 uCameraPosition;
   64| uniform vec3 uFogColor;
   65| uniform float uFogDensity;
   66| uniform float uFogStart;
   67| 
   68| out vec4 outColor;
   69| "#,
   70|     );
   71|     source.push_str(chunks::TONE_MAP_GLSL);
   72|     source.push_str(
   73|         r#"
   74| void main() {
   75|     vec2 uv = vec2(vUv.x, (vUv.y + vRow) / 2.0);
   76|     vec4 label = texture(uAtlas, uv);
   77|     if (label.a < 0.5) discard;
   78| 
   79|     // Printed matter under ambient interior light, then the shared fog.
   80|     vec3 color = label.rgb * 0.92;
   81|     float dist = length(vWorld - uCameraPosition);
   82|     float fog = 1.0 - exp(-uFogDensity * max(dist - uFogStart, 0.0));
   83|     color = mix(color, uFogColor, clamp(fog, 0.0, 1.0));
   84|     outColor = vec4(toneMap(color), 1.0);
   85| }
   86| "#,
   87|     );
   88|     source
   89| }
===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/apply_distance_fog.rs (24 lines) =====
    1| //! Homogeneous distance fog shared by every new GPU path.
    2| //!
    3| //! This is deliberately one equation, not an art-effect stack. For an
    4| //! extinction coefficient `sigma` and travelled distance `d`, Beer–Lambert
    5| //! transmittance is `T = exp(-sigma * d)`. Medium radiance fills exactly the
    6| //! energy removed from the surface term.
    7| 
    8| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
    9| float fogTransmittance(float distanceToCamera, float fogStart, float sigmaExtinction) {
   10|     float distanceInMedium = max(distanceToCamera - max(fogStart, 0.0), 0.0);
   11|     return exp(-max(sigmaExtinction, 0.0) * distanceInMedium);
   12| }
   13| 
   14| vec3 applyDistanceFog(
   15|     vec3 surfaceRadiance,
   16|     vec3 mediumRadiance,
   17|     float distanceToCamera,
   18|     float fogStart,
   19|     float sigmaExtinction
   20| ) {
   21|     float transmittance = fogTransmittance(distanceToCamera, fogStart, sigmaExtinction);
   22|     return surfaceRadiance * transmittance + mediumRadiance * (1.0 - transmittance);
   23| }
   24| "#;
===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/encode_display_color.rs (23 lines) =====
    1| //! One linear-HDR to canvas conversion for surfaces and raymarching.
    2| 
    3| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
    4| vec3 srgbToLinear(vec3 encoded) {
    5|     vec3 lowPart = encoded / 12.92;
    6|     vec3 highPart = pow((encoded + 0.055) / 1.055, vec3(2.4));
    7|     return mix(lowPart, highPart, step(vec3(0.04045), encoded));
    8| }
    9| 
   10| vec3 linearToSrgb(vec3 linearColor) {
   11|     linearColor = max(linearColor, vec3(0.0));
   12|     vec3 lowPart = linearColor * 12.92;
   13|     vec3 highPart = 1.055 * pow(linearColor, vec3(1.0 / 2.4)) - 0.055;
   14|     return mix(lowPart, highPart, step(vec3(0.0031308), linearColor));
   15| }
   16| 
   17| vec3 encodeDisplayColor(vec3 radiance) {
   18|     // A monotone, channel-independent Reinhard curve. Lighting and fog are
   19|     // composed before this point in linear space.
   20|     vec3 mapped = max(radiance, vec3(0.0)) / (vec3(1.0) + max(radiance, vec3(0.0)));
   21|     return linearToSrgb(mapped);
   22| }

===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/evaluate_scene_lighting.rs (102 lines) =====
    1| //! Direct-light equations shared by the surface and voxel-hit shaders.
    2| //!
    3| //! Rectangular emitters use deterministic 2×2 Gauss quadrature over their
    4| //! physical area. Point lights use the same finite-range inverse-square law
    5| //! without the area integral. This is intentionally compact and diagnosable;
    6| //! shadow visibility is an explicit input owned by the caller.
    7| 
    8| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
    9| const float PI = 3.14159265358979323846;
   10| const int LIGHT_POINT = 0;
   11| const int LIGHT_CEILING_PANEL = 1;
   12| const int LIGHT_STRIP = 2;
   13| const int LIGHT_EMERGENCY = 3;
   14| 
   15| float finiteRangeInverseSquare(float distanceSquared, float range) {
   16|     if (!(range > 0.0) || !(distanceSquared >= 0.0)) return 0.0;
   17|     float rangeSquared = range * range;
   18|     float normalizedSquared = distanceSquared / rangeSquared;
   19|     float window = max(1.0 - normalizedSquared * normalizedSquared, 0.0);
   20|     return (window * window) / max(distanceSquared, 0.04);
   21| }
   22| 
   23| float receiverCosine(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceToLight) {
   24|     return max(dot(normal, surfaceToLight), 0.0);
   25| }
   26| 
   27| float emitterCosine(int kind, vec3 surfaceToLight) {
   28|     if (kind == LIGHT_POINT) return 1.0;
   29|     // Rectangular fixtures lie in XZ and point down. `surfaceToLight.y` is
   30|     // positive exactly when the receiver is in their emitting hemisphere.
   31|     return max(surfaceToLight.y, 0.0);
   32| }
   33| 
   34| vec3 evaluatePointLight(
   35|     vec3 surfacePosition,
   36|     vec3 normal,
   37|     vec3 lightPosition,
   38|     vec3 lightColor,
   39|     float range,
   40|     float intensity
   41| ) {
   42|     vec3 delta = lightPosition - surfacePosition;
   43|     float distanceSquared = dot(delta, delta);
   44|     vec3 surfaceToLight = delta * inversesqrt(max(distanceSquared, 1e-8));
   45|     float geometry = receiverCosine(normal, surfaceToLight);
   46|     return max(lightColor, vec3(0.0)) * max(intensity, 0.0)
   47|         * finiteRangeInverseSquare(distanceSquared, range) * geometry;
   48| }
   49| 
   50| vec3 evaluateRectangleLight(
   51|     vec3 surfacePosition,
   52|     vec3 normal,
   53|     vec3 lightPosition,
   54|     vec2 halfSize,
   55|     vec3 lightColor,
   56|     float range,
   57|     float intensity,
   58|     int kind
   59| ) {
   60|     const float GAUSS = 0.5773502691896258;
   61|     vec2 offsets[4] = vec2[](
   62|         vec2(-GAUSS, -GAUSS), vec2(GAUSS, -GAUSS),
   63|         vec2(-GAUSS,  GAUSS), vec2(GAUSS,  GAUSS)
   64|     );
   65|     vec3 integral = vec3(0.0);
   66|     for (int sampleIndex = 0; sampleIndex < 4; ++sampleIndex) {
   67|         vec2 offset = offsets[sampleIndex] * halfSize;
   68|         vec3 samplePosition = lightPosition + vec3(offset.x, 0.0, offset.y);
   69|         vec3 delta = samplePosition - surfacePosition;
   70|         float distanceSquared = dot(delta, delta);
   71|         vec3 surfaceToLight = delta * inversesqrt(max(distanceSquared, 1e-8));
   72|         float geometry = receiverCosine(normal, surfaceToLight)
   73|             * emitterCosine(kind, surfaceToLight);
   74|         integral += finiteRangeInverseSquare(distanceSquared, range) * geometry;
   75|     }
   76|     float area = 4.0 * max(halfSize.x, 0.0) * max(halfSize.y, 0.0);
   77|     if (!(area > 0.0)) return vec3(0.0);
   78|     return max(lightColor, vec3(0.0)) * max(intensity, 0.0)
   79|         * area * (integral * 0.25);
   80| }
   81| 
   82| vec3 evaluateSceneLight(
   83|     vec3 surfacePosition,
   84|     vec3 normal,
   85|     vec3 lightPosition,
   86|     vec2 halfSize,
   87|     vec3 lightColor,
   88|     float range,
   89|     float intensity,
   90|     int kind
   91| ) {
   92|     if (kind == LIGHT_POINT) {
   93|         return evaluatePointLight(
   94|             surfacePosition, normal, lightPosition, lightColor, range, intensity
   95|         );
   96|     }
   97|     return evaluateRectangleLight(
   98|         surfacePosition, normal, lightPosition, halfSize,
   99|         lightColor, range, intensity, kind
  100|     );
  101| }
  102| "#;

  144|     /// 440/450/460, and even rewritten to those it rejects the combined
  145|     /// `sampler2D`/`usampler2D` types that are the *only* sampler form

  151|         let mut path = std::env::temp_dir();
  152|         path.push(format!("vackrooms-raymarch-{}.frag", std::process::id()));
  153|         if std::fs::write(&path, &source).is_err() {
  154|             return;
  155|         }
  156|         let compiled = std::process::Command::new("glslangValidator")
  157|             .arg("-S")
  158|             .arg("frag")
  159|             .arg(&path)
  160|             .output();
  161|         let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&path);
  162|         let Ok(output) = compiled else { return };
  163|         assert!(

===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/trace_voxel_scene/intersect_voxel_scene.rs (262 lines) =====
    1| //! Exact ray/box math, diagnostic DDA, and optional empty-leaf stepping.
    2| 
    3| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
    4| const float TRACE_INFINITY = 1e30;
    5| const float TRACE_MIN_TIE_EPSILON = 1e-7;
    6| 
    7| struct RayBoxHit {
    8|     bool hit;
    9|     float entry;
   10|     float exit;
   11|     vec3 entryNormal;
   12| };
   13| 
   14| struct ChunkInterval {
   15|     int chunkIndex;
   16|     float entry;
   17|     float exit;
   18|     vec3 entryNormal;
   19| };
   20| 
   21| struct VoxelHit {
   22|     bool hit;
   23|     float distance;
   24|     vec3 normal;
   25|     uint material;
   26|     uint color;
   27|     uint lightWord;
   28| };
   29| 
   30| float inverseDirection(float direction) {
   31|     if (abs(direction) < 1e-20) {
   32|         return direction < 0.0 ? -TRACE_INFINITY : TRACE_INFINITY;
   33|     }
   34|     return 1.0 / direction;
   35| }
   36| 
   37| float distanceTieTolerance(float distance) {
   38|     return max(abs(distance) * 1e-6, TRACE_MIN_TIE_EPSILON);
   39| }
   40| 
   41| float traversalSampleBias(float voxelSize) {
   42|     // This moves classification points off an exactly shared plane; it must
   43|     // remain smaller than nearby, genuinely distinct boundary crossings.
   44|     // At the 0.2 m reference grid, 1e-4 skipped a 13 micrometre
   45|     // interval between a wall and ceiling and changed the reported face.
   46|     return max(voxelSize * 1e-5, TRACE_MIN_TIE_EPSILON);
   47| }
   48| 
   49| RayBoxHit intersectBox(vec3 rayOrigin, vec3 rayDirection, vec3 boundsMin, vec3 boundsMax) {
   50|     // Parallel axes are handled explicitly so a boundary value never forms
   51|     // the undefined product 0 * infinity.
   52|     if ((abs(rayDirection.x) < 1e-20 && (rayOrigin.x < boundsMin.x || rayOrigin.x > boundsMax.x))
   53|         || (abs(rayDirection.y) < 1e-20 && (rayOrigin.y < boundsMin.y || rayOrigin.y > boundsMax.y))
   54|         || (abs(rayDirection.z) < 1e-20 && (rayOrigin.z < boundsMin.z || rayOrigin.z > boundsMax.z))) {
   55|         return RayBoxHit(false, 0.0, 0.0, vec3(0.0));
   56|     }
   57| 
   58|     vec3 inverseRay = vec3(
   59|         inverseDirection(rayDirection.x),
   60|         inverseDirection(rayDirection.y),
   61|         inverseDirection(rayDirection.z)
   62|     );
   63|     vec3 first = (boundsMin - rayOrigin) * inverseRay;
   64|     vec3 second = (boundsMax - rayOrigin) * inverseRay;
   65|     vec3 nearTimes = min(first, second);
   66|     vec3 farTimes = max(first, second);
   67|     if (abs(rayDirection.x) < 1e-20) { nearTimes.x = -TRACE_INFINITY; farTimes.x = TRACE_INFINITY; }
   68|     if (abs(rayDirection.y) < 1e-20) { nearTimes.y = -TRACE_INFINITY; farTimes.y = TRACE_INFINITY; }
   69|     if (abs(rayDirection.z) < 1e-20) { nearTimes.z = -TRACE_INFINITY; farTimes.z = TRACE_INFINITY; }
   70| 
   71|     float entry = max(nearTimes.x, max(nearTimes.y, nearTimes.z));
   72|     float exit = min(farTimes.x, min(farTimes.y, farTimes.z));
   73|     if (entry > exit || exit < 0.0) {
   74|         return RayBoxHit(false, entry, exit, vec3(0.0));
   75|     }
   76| 
   77|     vec3 normal;
   78|     if (entry <= 0.0) {
   79|         vec3 absoluteRay = abs(rayDirection);
   80|         if (absoluteRay.x >= absoluteRay.y && absoluteRay.x >= absoluteRay.z) normal = vec3(-sign(rayDirection.x), 0.0, 0.0);
   81|         else if (absoluteRay.y >= absoluteRay.z) normal = vec3(0.0, -sign(rayDirection.y), 0.0);
   82|         else normal = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -sign(rayDirection.z));
   83|     } else if (nearTimes.x >= nearTimes.y && nearTimes.x >= nearTimes.z) {
   84|         normal = vec3(rayDirection.x > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
   85|     } else if (nearTimes.y >= nearTimes.z) {
   86|         normal = vec3(0.0, rayDirection.y > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0, 0.0);
   87|     } else {
   88|         normal = vec3(0.0, 0.0, rayDirection.z > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0);
   89|     }
   90|     return RayBoxHit(true, max(entry, 0.0), exit, normal);
   91| }
   92| 
   93| float exitDistanceFromBox(
   94|     vec3 rayOrigin,
   95|     vec3 rayDirection,
   96|     vec3 boundsMin,
   97|     vec3 boundsMax,
   98|     out vec3 nextNormal
   99| ) {
  100|     vec3 exitTimes = vec3(TRACE_INFINITY);
  101|     if (abs(rayDirection.x) >= 1e-20) exitTimes.x = ((rayDirection.x > 0.0 ? boundsMax.x : boundsMin.x) - rayOrigin.x) / rayDirection.x;
  102|     if (abs(rayDirection.y) >= 1e-20) exitTimes.y = ((rayDirection.y > 0.0 ? boundsMax.y : boundsMin.y) - rayOrigin.y) / rayDirection.y;
  103|     if (abs(rayDirection.z) >= 1e-20) exitTimes.z = ((rayDirection.z > 0.0 ? boundsMax.z : boundsMin.z) - rayOrigin.z) / rayDirection.z;
  104| 
  105|     float nearest = min(exitTimes.x, min(exitTimes.y, exitTimes.z));
  106|     // Traversal bias and tie tolerance solve different problems. The former
  107|     // moves a sample into the next cell; using that comparatively large value
  108|     // here incorrectly merges distinct, very close wall/ceiling crossings.
  109|     float tolerance = distanceTieTolerance(nearest);
  110|     // Use the same tolerant X/Y/Z precedence as finest-cell DDA. Without
  111|     // this, a mathematically tied edge ray can acquire a different face
  112|     // normal solely because one path jumped across a larger empty leaf.
  113|     if (abs(exitTimes.x - nearest) <= tolerance) {
  114|         nextNormal = vec3(rayDirection.x > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
  115|         return nearest;
  116|     }
  117|     if (abs(exitTimes.y - nearest) <= tolerance) {
  118|         nextNormal = vec3(0.0, rayDirection.y > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0, 0.0);
  119|         return nearest;
  120|     }
  121|     nextNormal = vec3(0.0, 0.0, rayDirection.z > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0);
  122|     return nearest;
  123| }

  125| VoxelHit traceChunkDda(
  126|     vec3 rayOrigin,
  127|     vec3 rayDirection,
  128|     int rootIndex,
  129|     float worldSize,
  130|     float voxelSize,
  131|     int svoDepth,
  132|     RayBoxHit chunkBox
  133| );
  134| 
  135| VoxelHit traceChunkSkippingEmptyLeaves(
  136|     vec3 rayOrigin,
  137|     vec3 rayDirection,
  138|     int rootIndex,
  139|     float worldSize,
  140|     float voxelSize,
  141|     int svoDepth,
  142|     RayBoxHit chunkBox
  143| ) {
  144|     float distance = chunkBox.entry;
  145|     vec3 normal = chunkBox.entryNormal;
  146|     float sampleBias = traversalSampleBias(voxelSize);
  147|     float refinementEntry = chunkBox.entry;
  148|     vec3 refinementEntryNormal = chunkBox.entryNormal;
  149| 
  150|     for (int stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < 768; ++stepIndex) {
  151|         if (distance > chunkBox.exit) break;
  152|         vec3 samplePoint = rayOrigin + rayDirection * min(distance + sampleBias, chunkBox.exit);
  153|         VoxelLeaf leaf = lookupVoxelLeaf(samplePoint, rootIndex, worldSize, svoDepth);
  154|         if (leaf.material != 0u) {
  155|             // The coarse walk proves emptiness only. Resolve the final
  156|             // voxel-scale crossing with the diagnostic algorithm so both
  157|             // policies produce one canonical distance, material, and normal.
  158|             RayBoxHit refinementBox = RayBoxHit(
  159|                 true, refinementEntry, chunkBox.exit, refinementEntryNormal
  160|             );
  161|             return traceChunkDda(
  162|                 rayOrigin,
  163|                 rayDirection,
  164|                 rootIndex,
  165|                 worldSize,
  166|                 voxelSize,
  167|                 svoDepth,
  168|                 refinementBox
  169|             );
  170|         }
  171| 
  172|         vec3 crossedNormal;
  173|         float nextDistance = exitDistanceFromBox(
  174|             rayOrigin, rayDirection, leaf.boundsMin, leaf.boundsMax, crossedNormal
  175|         );
  176|         if (nextDistance <= distance + sampleBias * 0.25) {
  177|             nextDistance = distance + sampleBias;
  178|         }
  179|         // A normalized ray moves at most one voxel per axis over this short
  180|         // interval. Retaining it lets the exact resolver reconstruct every
  181|         // potentially competing face without replaying the skipped octant.
  182|         refinementEntry = max(distance, nextDistance - voxelSize);
  183|         refinementEntryNormal = normal;
  184|         distance = nextDistance;
  185|         normal = crossedNormal;
  186|     }
  187|     return VoxelHit(false, 0.0, vec3(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u);
  188| }
  189| 
  190| VoxelHit traceChunkDda(
  191|     vec3 rayOrigin,
  192|     vec3 rayDirection,
  193|     int rootIndex,
  194|     float worldSize,
  195|     float voxelSize,
  196|     int svoDepth,
  197|     RayBoxHit chunkBox
  198| ) {
  199|     float sampleBias = traversalSampleBias(voxelSize);
  200|     float distance = chunkBox.entry;
  201|     vec3 samplePoint = rayOrigin + rayDirection * min(distance + sampleBias, chunkBox.exit);
  202|     vec3 cell = floor(samplePoint / voxelSize);
  203|     vec3 directionStep = sign(rayDirection);
  204|     vec3 normal = chunkBox.entryNormal;
  205| 
  206|     for (int stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < 768; ++stepIndex) {
  207|         if (distance > chunkBox.exit) break;
  208|         samplePoint = rayOrigin + rayDirection * min(distance + sampleBias, chunkBox.exit);
  209|         VoxelLeaf leaf = lookupVoxelLeaf(samplePoint, rootIndex, worldSize, svoDepth);
  210|         if (leaf.material != 0u) {
  211|             return VoxelHit(true, distance, normal, leaf.material, leaf.color, leaf.lightWord);
  212|         }
  213| 
  214|         // Recompute boundary times from the canonical integer cell each step.
  215|         // Repeated `nextTime += deltaTime` accumulates enough rounding error
  216|         // to reverse two distinct wall/ceiling crossings near a long ray.
  217|         vec3 nextBoundary = (cell + max(directionStep, vec3(0.0))) * voxelSize;
  218|         vec3 nextTimes = vec3(TRACE_INFINITY);
  219|         if (abs(rayDirection.x) >= 1e-20) nextTimes.x = (nextBoundary.x - rayOrigin.x) / rayDirection.x;
  220|         if (abs(rayDirection.y) >= 1e-20) nextTimes.y = (nextBoundary.y - rayOrigin.y) / rayDirection.y;
  221|         if (abs(rayDirection.z) >= 1e-20) nextTimes.z = (nextBoundary.z - rayOrigin.z) / rayDirection.z;
  222| 
  223|         float nextDistance = min(nextTimes.x, min(nextTimes.y, nextTimes.z));
  224|         if (nextDistance > chunkBox.exit) break;
  225|         // Step every tied axis so a ray through an edge/corner cannot stall.
  226|         // This is a floating-point equality tolerance, not the sampling bias.
  227|         // Keeping them separate preserves the mathematically nearer face when
  228|         // two boundaries are close but not actually coincident.
  229|         float tieEpsilon = distanceTieTolerance(nextDistance);
  230|         bool crossX = abs(nextTimes.x - nextDistance) <= tieEpsilon;
  231|         bool crossY = abs(nextTimes.y - nextDistance) <= tieEpsilon;
  232|         bool crossZ = abs(nextTimes.z - nextDistance) <= tieEpsilon;
  233|         if (crossX) cell.x += directionStep.x;
  234|         if (crossY) cell.y += directionStep.y;
  235|         if (crossZ) cell.z += directionStep.z;
  236|         if (crossX) normal = vec3(-directionStep.x, 0.0, 0.0);
  237|         else if (crossY) normal = vec3(0.0, -directionStep.y, 0.0);
  238|         else normal = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -directionStep.z);
  239|         distance = nextDistance;
  240|     }
  241|     return VoxelHit(false, 0.0, vec3(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u);
  242| }

  257|     }
  258|     return traceChunkDda(

  261| }

===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/trace_voxel_scene/trace_direct_light_visibility.rs (112 lines) =====
    1| //! Occlusion queries from a visible voxel face to analytic emitter samples.
    2| //!
    3| //! The primary-ray hit and every shadow segment use the same chunk slabs,
    4| //! stateless SVO lookup, and selected stepping policy. Rectangle visibility
    5| //! is evaluated at the same four Gauss samples as its irradiance integral;
    6| //! a center-only visibility term would leak around partial blockers.
    7| 
    8| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
    9| bool directSampleIsVisible(
   10|     vec3 surfacePosition,
   11|     vec3 surfaceNormal,
   12|     vec3 samplePosition,
   13|     float receiverVoxelSize
   14| ) {
   15|     if (uDirectVisibilityEnabled == 0) return true;
   16| 
   17|     float bias = max(receiverVoxelSize * 1e-3, 1e-5);
   18|     vec3 segmentOrigin = surfacePosition + surfaceNormal * bias;
   19|     vec3 segment = samplePosition - segmentOrigin;
   20|     float segmentLength = length(segment);
   21|     if (!(segmentLength > bias * 2.0)) return true;
   22|     vec3 direction = segment / segmentLength;
   23|     float blockerLimit = segmentLength - bias * 2.0;
   24| 
   25|     for (int chunkIndex = 0; chunkIndex < uNumChunks; ++chunkIndex) {
   26|         vec3 localOrigin = segmentOrigin - uChunkOrigins[chunkIndex];
   27|         RayBoxHit box = intersectBox(
   28|             localOrigin,
   29|             direction,
   30|             vec3(0.0),
   31|             vec3(uChunkWorldSizes[chunkIndex])
   32|         );
   33|         if (!box.hit || box.entry >= blockerLimit) continue;
   34|         box.exit = min(box.exit, blockerLimit);
   35|         VoxelHit blocker = traceChunk(
   36|             localOrigin,
   37|             direction,
   38|             uChunkRootIndices[chunkIndex],
   39|             uChunkWorldSizes[chunkIndex],
   40|             uChunkVoxelSizes[chunkIndex],
   41|             uChunkDepths[chunkIndex],
   42|             box
   43|         );
   44|         if (blocker.hit && blocker.distance < blockerLimit) return false;
   45|     }
   46|     return true;
   47| }
   48| 
   49| vec3 evaluateVisiblePointLight(
   50|     vec3 surfacePosition,
   51|     vec3 normal,
   52|     vec3 lightPosition,
   53|     vec3 lightColor,
   54|     float range,
   55|     float intensity,
   56|     float receiverVoxelSize
   57| ) {
   58|     vec3 delta = lightPosition - surfacePosition;
   59|     float distanceSquared = dot(delta, delta);
   60|     vec3 surfaceToLight = delta * inversesqrt(max(distanceSquared, 1e-8));
   61|     float weight = finiteRangeInverseSquare(distanceSquared, range)
   62|         * receiverCosine(normal, surfaceToLight);
   63|     if (!(weight > 0.0)
   64|         || !directSampleIsVisible(
   65|             surfacePosition, normal, lightPosition, receiverVoxelSize
   66|         )) {
   67|         return vec3(0.0);
   68|     }
   69|     return max(lightColor, vec3(0.0)) * max(intensity, 0.0) * weight;
   70| }
   71| 
   72| vec3 evaluateVisibleSceneLight(
   73|     vec3 surfacePosition,
   74|     vec3 normal,
   75|     SceneLight light,
   76|     float receiverVoxelSize
   77| ) {
   78|     if (light.kind == LIGHT_POINT) {
   79|         return evaluateVisiblePointLight(
   80|             surfacePosition, normal, light.position, light.color,
   81|             light.range, light.intensity, receiverVoxelSize
   82|         );
   83|     }
   84| 
   85|     float area = 4.0 * max(light.halfSize.x, 0.0) * max(light.halfSize.y, 0.0);
   86|     if (!(area > 0.0)) return vec3(0.0);
   87|     const float GAUSS = 0.5773502691896258;
   88|     vec2 offsets[4] = vec2[](
   89|         vec2(-GAUSS, -GAUSS), vec2(GAUSS, -GAUSS),
   90|         vec2(-GAUSS,  GAUSS), vec2(GAUSS,  GAUSS)
   91|     );
   92|     float integral = 0.0;
   93|     for (int sampleIndex = 0; sampleIndex < 4; ++sampleIndex) {
   94|         vec2 offset = offsets[sampleIndex] * light.halfSize;
   95|         vec3 samplePosition = light.position + vec3(offset.x, 0.0, offset.y);
   96|         vec3 delta = samplePosition - surfacePosition;
   97|         float distanceSquared = dot(delta, delta);
   98|         vec3 surfaceToLight = delta * inversesqrt(max(distanceSquared, 1e-8));
   99|         float weight = finiteRangeInverseSquare(distanceSquared, light.range)
  100|             * receiverCosine(normal, surfaceToLight)
  101|             * emitterCosine(light.kind, surfaceToLight);
  102|         if (weight > 0.0
  103|             && directSampleIsVisible(
  104|                 surfacePosition, normal, samplePosition, receiverVoxelSize
  105|             )) {
  106|             integral += weight;
  107|         }
  108|     }
  109|     return max(light.color, vec3(0.0)) * max(light.intensity, 0.0)
  110|         * area * (integral * 0.25);
  111| }

===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/trace_voxel_scene/decode_brick_voxel.rs (61 lines) =====
    1| //! Dense brick lookup: one texel fetch instead of a dependent pointer chase.
    2| //!
    3| //! GLSL port of the WebGPU raymarcher's `read_brick_voxel`
    4| //! (`drivers/webgpu/shaders/raymarch.wgsl`). The two words `BrickPoolGpuData`
    5| //! packs per voxel land in one RG32UI texel (`BrickVoxelTexture` in
    6| //! `drivers/webgl/atlas.rs`), so this is exactly one `texelFetch` instead of
    7| //! `lookupVoxelLeaf`'s per-level dependent chase.
    8| 
    9| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
   10| /// Voxels along one brick edge. Must match `BRICK_EDGE` in the core's
   11| /// `build_brick_pool`.
   12| const uint BRICK_EDGE = 4u;
   13| /// Must match `BRICK_ATLAS_WIDTH` in `drivers/webgl/atlas.rs`.
   14| const int BRICK_TEXTURE_WIDTH = 512;
   15| 
   16| /// The returned bounds are the *individual voxel's* box, never the brick's:
   17| /// empty-space skipping advances to the far side of whatever bounds it is
   18| /// handed, so returning the brick would step over the solid voxels sharing it.
   19| VoxelLeaf readBrickVoxel(uint wordBase, vec3 point, vec3 boundsMin, vec3 boundsMax) {
   20|     vec3 extent = (boundsMax - boundsMin) / float(BRICK_EDGE);
   21|     float limit = float(BRICK_EDGE) - 1.0;
   22|     // The DDA samples a hair inside the cell it means, but rounding can
   23|     // still land a fraction outside the brick; clamping keeps the fetch in
   24|     // bounds without moving any sample that was already correct.
   25|     vec3 local = clamp(
   26|         floor((point - boundsMin) / extent),
   27|         vec3(0.0),
   28|         vec3(limit)
   29|     );
   30|     uvec3 cell = uvec3(local);
   31|     uint offset = cell.z * BRICK_EDGE * BRICK_EDGE + cell.y * BRICK_EDGE + cell.x;
   32|     // wordBase is a word offset into the two-words-per-voxel arena and is
   33|     // always voxel-aligned (a brick's own base is BRICK_EDGE^3 * 2 words in),
   34|     // so this recovers the voxel index the RG32UI texture is addressed by.
   35|     uint voxelIndex = wordBase / 2u + offset;
   36|     ivec2 texel = ivec2(int(voxelIndex) % BRICK_TEXTURE_WIDTH, int(voxelIndex) / BRICK_TEXTURE_WIDTH);
   37|     uvec4 packed = texelFetch(uBrickTexture, texel, 0);
   38|     uint packedVoxel = packed.x;
   39|     uint packedLight = packed.y;
   40| 
   41|     // Re-pack into the leaf light layout so every consumer above decodes
   42|     // one encoding: scalar level, then occlusion at bit 8, then r/g/b.
   43|     uint red = (packedLight >> 8u) & 0xFu;
   44|     uint green = (packedLight >> 12u) & 0xFu;
   45|     uint blue = (packedLight >> 16u) & 0xFu;
   46|     uint lightWord = max(red, max(green, blue))
   47|         | ((packedLight & 0xFFu) << 8u)
   48|         | (red << 16u)
   49|         | (green << 20u)
   50|         | (blue << 24u);
   51| 
   52|     vec3 voxelMin = boundsMin + local * extent;
   53|     return VoxelLeaf(
   54|         packedVoxel >> 24u,
   55|         packedVoxel & 0x00FFFFFFu,
   56|         lightWord,
   57|         voxelMin,
   58|         voxelMin + extent
   59|     );
   60| }
   61| "#;
===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/trace_voxel_scene/decode_voxel_atlas.rs (92 lines) =====
    1| //! Stateless point lookup in the packed SVO atlas.
    2| //!
    3| //! Restarting at the root for each step costs a few integer fetches but
    4| //! removes the fragile mutable stack/pop state that caused cracks and phantom
    5| //! boxes. A masked-out child returns its exact empty octant bounds without a
    6| //! texture fetch; the optimization can then jump over that whole region.
    7| //!
    8| //! The atlas may hold either the plain SVO encoding or the bricked one --
    9| //! they are bit-identical for internal and leaf nodes and differ only by an
   10| //! extra node kind, so `lookupVoxelLeaf` needs no mode switch: it recognizes
   11| //! a brick pointer when it meets one and every caller keeps seeing the same
   12| //! `VoxelLeaf` contract. `readBrickVoxel` (`decode_brick_voxel.rs`) is only
   13| //! prototyped here; concatenation order in `fragment_source` puts its
   14| //! definition after this file, mirroring `intersect_voxel_scene.rs`'s own
   15| //! forward-declared `traceChunkDda`/`traceChunkSkippingEmptyLeaves`.
   16| 
   17| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
   18| const uint NODE_KIND_INTERNAL = 0u;
   19| const uint NODE_KIND_LEAF = 1u;
   20| const uint NODE_KIND_BRICK = 2u;
   21| 
   22| struct AtlasNode {
   23|     uint kind;
   24|     uint payload;
   25|     uint colorOrMask;
   26|     uint lightWord;
   27| };
   28| 
   29| struct VoxelLeaf {
   30|     uint material;
   31|     uint color;
   32|     uint lightWord;
   33|     vec3 boundsMin;
   34|     vec3 boundsMax;
   35| };
   36| 
   37| VoxelLeaf readBrickVoxel(uint wordBase, vec3 point, vec3 boundsMin, vec3 boundsMax);
   38| 
   39| AtlasNode readAtlasNode(int nodeIndex) {
   40|     ivec2 texel = ivec2(nodeIndex % 1024, nodeIndex / 1024);
   41|     uvec4 packed = texelFetch(uNodeTexture, texel, 0);
   42|     return AtlasNode(packed.x, packed.y, packed.z, packed.w);
   43| }
   44| 
   45| VoxelLeaf lookupVoxelLeaf(
   46|     vec3 point,
   47|     int rootIndex,
   48|     float worldSize,
   49|     int svoDepth
   50| ) {
   51|     int nodeIndex = rootIndex;
   52|     vec3 boundsMin = vec3(0.0);
   53|     vec3 boundsMax = vec3(worldSize);
   54| 
   55|     // Generator validation bounds depth; the runtime value only shortens
   56|     // this statically bounded loop for ordinary 6/8-level chunks.
   57|     for (int level = 0; level <= 10; ++level) {
   58|         AtlasNode node = readAtlasNode(nodeIndex);
   59|         if (node.kind == NODE_KIND_LEAF || level >= svoDepth) {
   60|             return VoxelLeaf(node.payload, node.colorOrMask, node.lightWord, boundsMin, boundsMax);
   61|         }
   62|         if (node.kind == NODE_KIND_BRICK) {
   63|             return readBrickVoxel(node.payload, point, boundsMin, boundsMax);
   64|         }
   65| 
   66|         vec3 center = (boundsMin + boundsMax) * 0.5;
   67|         int childX = point.x >= center.x ? 1 : 0;
   68|         int childY = point.y >= center.y ? 1 : 0;
   69|         int childZ = point.z >= center.z ? 1 : 0;
   70|         int child = (childZ << 2) | (childY << 1) | childX;
   71| 
   72|         vec3 childMin = vec3(
   73|             childX == 1 ? center.x : boundsMin.x,
   74|             childY == 1 ? center.y : boundsMin.y,
   75|             childZ == 1 ? center.z : boundsMin.z
   76|         );
   77|         vec3 childMax = vec3(
   78|             childX == 1 ? boundsMax.x : center.x,
   79|             childY == 1 ? boundsMax.y : center.y,
   80|             childZ == 1 ? boundsMax.z : center.z
   81|         );
   82| 
   83|         if ((node.colorOrMask & (1u << uint(child))) == 0u) {
   84|             return VoxelLeaf(0u, 0u, 0u, childMin, childMax);
   85|         }
   86|         nodeIndex = int(node.payload) + child;
   87|         boundsMin = childMin;
   88|         boundsMax = childMax;
   89|     }
   90|     return VoxelLeaf(0u, 0u, 0u, boundsMin, boundsMax);
   91| }
   92| "#;
===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/trace_voxel_scene/shade_voxel_hit.rs (79 lines) =====
    1| //! Turn one selected voxel hit into linear scene radiance.
    2| 
    3| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
    4| bool isEmissiveVoxel(uint material) {
    5|     return material == 4u || material == 9u || material == 16u;
    6| }
    7| 
    8| vec3 decodePackedColor(uint packed) {
    9|     return vec3(
   10|         float((packed >> 16u) & 0xffu),
   11|         float((packed >> 8u) & 0xffu),
   12|         float(packed & 0xffu)
   13|     ) * (1.0 / 255.0);
   14| }
   15| 
   16| bool isDownwardEmittingFace(vec3 normal) {
   17|     return normal.y < -0.5;
   18| }
   19| 
   20| vec3 emittedVoxelRadiance(uint material, vec3 albedo, vec3 normal) {
   21|     if (!isDownwardEmittingFace(normal)) return vec3(0.0);
   22|     if (material == 4u) return albedo * 10.0;
   23|     if (material == 9u) return albedo * 8.0;
   24|     if (material == 16u) return albedo * 0.9;
   25|     return vec3(0.0);
   26| }
   27| 
   28| vec3 shadeVoxel(
   29|     VoxelHit hit,
   30|     vec3 worldPosition,
   31|     float receiverVoxelSize,
   32|     int receiverChunkIndex
   33| ) {
   34|     vec3 albedo = srgbToLinear(decodePackedColor(hit.color));
   35|     if (isEmissiveVoxel(hit.material) && isDownwardEmittingFace(hit.normal)) {
   36|         return emittedVoxelRadiance(hit.material, albedo, hit.normal);
   37|     }
   38| 
   39|     vec3 ambient = (uOutdoor == 1
   40|         ? vec3(0.32, 0.38, 0.48)
   41|         : vec3(0.045, 0.040, 0.024)) * uAmbientScale;
   42|     vec3 analyticDirect = vec3(0.0);
   43| 
   44|     // Analytic fixtures are the sole static-light authority. A single packed
   45|     // RGB value cannot describe the six incident face directions, so this
   46|     // correctness path deliberately does not consume the optional surface
   47|     // diffuse field.
   48|     int lightFirst = uChunkLightFirst[receiverChunkIndex];
   49|     int lightCount = uChunkLightCounts[receiverChunkIndex];
   50|     for (int lightIndex = 0; lightIndex < lightCount; ++lightIndex) {
   51|         SceneLight light = readSceneLight(lightFirst + lightIndex);
   52|         analyticDirect += evaluateVisibleSceneLight(
   53|             worldPosition, hit.normal, light, receiverVoxelSize
   54|         );
   55|     }
   56|     for (int lightIndex = 0; lightIndex < 4; ++lightIndex) {
   57|         if (lightIndex >= uDynamicLightCount) break;
   58|         analyticDirect += evaluateVisiblePointLight(
   59|             worldPosition,
   60|             hit.normal,
   61|             uDynamicPosRadius[lightIndex].xyz,
   62|             uDynamicColorIntensity[lightIndex].rgb,
   63|             uDynamicPosRadius[lightIndex].w,
   64|             uDynamicColorIntensity[lightIndex].a,
   65|             receiverVoxelSize
   66|         );
   67|     }
   68| 
   69|     vec3 radiance = albedo * (
   70|         ambient + analyticDirect
   71|     ) * (1.0 / PI);
   72|     if (uFlashlightEnabled == 1) {
   73|         radiance += albedo * spotBeam(
   74|             uCameraPosition, uCamForward, worldPosition, hit.normal
   75|         );
   76|     }
   77|     return radiance;
   78| }
   79| "#;
===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/trace_voxel_scene/select_nearest_voxel_hit.rs (42 lines) =====
    1| //! Trace every candidate chunk interval and retain the nearest solid voxel.
    2| 
    3| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
    4| VoxelHit selectNearestVoxelHit(
    5|     vec3 rayDirection,
    6|     ChunkInterval intervals[25],
    7|     int intervalCount,
    8|     out int closestChunkIndex
    9| ) {
   10|     VoxelHit closest = VoxelHit(
   11|         false, TRACE_INFINITY, vec3(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u
   12|     );
   13|     closestChunkIndex = -1;
   14|     for (int intervalIndex = 0; intervalIndex < intervalCount; ++intervalIndex) {
   15|         ChunkInterval interval = intervals[intervalIndex];
   16|         // Sorted traversal may stop only after every remaining AABB begins
   17|         // beyond the nearest solid hit. Breaking after the first hit is wrong
   18|         // because power-of-two padded chunk boxes overlap.
   19|         if (uFrontToBackEnabled == 1 && interval.entry >= closest.distance) break;
   20| 
   21|         int chunkIndex = interval.chunkIndex;
   22|         vec3 localOrigin = uCameraPosition - uChunkOrigins[chunkIndex];
   23|         RayBoxHit box = RayBoxHit(
   24|             true, interval.entry, interval.exit, interval.entryNormal
   25|         );
   26|         VoxelHit candidate = traceChunk(
   27|             localOrigin,
   28|             rayDirection,
   29|             uChunkRootIndices[chunkIndex],
   30|             uChunkWorldSizes[chunkIndex],
   31|             uChunkVoxelSizes[chunkIndex],
   32|             uChunkDepths[chunkIndex],
   33|             box
   34|         );
   35|         if (candidate.hit && candidate.distance < closest.distance) {
   36|             closest = candidate;
   37|             closestChunkIndex = chunkIndex;
   38|         }
   39|     }
   40|     return closest;
   41| }
   42| "#;
===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/trace_voxel_scene/present_voxel_frame.rs (35 lines) =====
    1| //! Resolve a miss or carry a shaded voxel through fog into display space.
    2| 
    3| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
    4| void main() {
    5|     vec3 rayDirection = constructCameraRay();
    6| 
    7|     ChunkInterval intervals[25];
    8|     int intervalCount = collectOrderedChunkIntervals(rayDirection, intervals);
    9| 
   10|     int closestChunkIndex;
   11|     VoxelHit closest = selectNearestVoxelHit(
   12|         rayDirection, intervals, intervalCount, closestChunkIndex
   13|     );
   14| 
   15|     if (!closest.hit) {
   16|         vec3 missRadiance = uOutdoor == 1 ? uSkyColor : uFogColor;
   17|         fragColor = vec4(encodeDisplayColor(missRadiance), 1.0);
   18|         return;
   19|     }
   20| 
   21|     vec3 worldPosition = uCameraPosition + rayDirection * closest.distance;
   22|     float receiverVoxelSize = uChunkVoxelSizes[closestChunkIndex];
   23|     vec3 radiance = shadeVoxel(
   24|         closest, worldPosition, receiverVoxelSize, closestChunkIndex
   25|     );
   26|     radiance = applyDistanceFog(
   27|         radiance, uFogColor, closest.distance, uFogStart, uFogDensity
   28|     );

   30|     if (uDitherEnabled == 1) {
   31|         displayColor += (ign(gl_FragCoord.xy) - 0.5) * (1.0 / 255.0);
   32|     }

===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/trace_voxel_scene/construct_camera_ray.rs (12 lines) =====
    1| //! Construct one normalized world-space camera ray from the fullscreen UV.
    2| 
    3| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
    4| vec3 constructCameraRay() {
    5|     vec2 ndc = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
    6|     return normalize(
    7|         uCamRight * (ndc.x * uAspect * uFovTan)
    8|         + uCamUp * (ndc.y * uFovTan)
    9|         + uCamForward
   10|     );
   11| }
   12| "#;

Big finding in the GLSL raymarcher: `shade_voxel_hit.rs` — for each hit, loops over `lightCount` lights of the receiver chunk and for each light calls `evaluateVisibleSceneLight` which for rectangle lights runs 4 Gauss samples, each calling `directSampleIsVisible` which loops over ALL `uNumChunks` chunks, and for each chunk runs a full `traceChunk` (up to 768 steps). So per-pixel worst case: 1 primary trace (768 steps) + L × 4 × C × 768 steps. With L up to maybe dozens and C=25: 25 chunks × 768 steps × 4 samples × L lights = massive per-pixel cost. That's the biggest algorithmic issue in the shader: O(P · C · L · S) per frame where P = pixels, C = chunk count (≤25), L = lights in receiver chunk, S = trace steps (≤768). Plus primary trace O(P · C · S).

Also `directSampleIsVisible` is called even for the 4 Gauss samples of a rectangle light — worst case 4× per light. And there's no early exit or caching of visibility per (surface, light). It also doesn't limit light count per chunk: `uChunkLightCounts[receiverChunkIndex]` — with the scene light texture, a chunk's light count could be large (e.g., 40+ in tests). For each of those it loops over all 25 chunks. That's the "nested loops over lights/chunks" the parent flagged.

Also `collectOrderedChunkIntervals` is insertion sort O(C²) but C=25, negligible.

`traceChunkDda` loop bound is 768 steps — worst case per chunk per ray; in `selectNearestVoxelHit` it traces every chunk interval (up to 25) without early exit on hit unless front-to-back. So worst case 25 × 768 = 19,200 steps per pixel primary. Plus shadow: L × 4 × 25 × 768.

Also `lookupVoxelLeaf` — restarts at root each step: depth up to 10 levels, each an atlas fetch. Fine (documented choice), O(depth) per lookup with 1 texel fetch per level.

Now, the render_world_surfaces shaders (surface GLSL).

===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/render_world_surfaces/compose_surface_lighting.rs (64 lines) =====
    1| //! Compose emission, ambient fill, cached fill, fixtures, and flashlight.
    2| 
    3| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
    4| vec3 ambientIrradiance() {
    5|     if (uOutdoor == 1) return vec3(0.32, 0.38, 0.48) * uAmbientScale;
    6|     return vec3(0.045, 0.040, 0.024) * uAmbientScale;
    7| }
    8| 
    9| vec3 composeSurfaceLighting(vec3 normal, vec3 albedo) {
   10|     if (isEmissiveMaterial(vMaterial) && isDownwardEmittingFace(normal)) {
   11|         return emittedRadiance(vMaterial, albedo, normal);
   12|     }
   13| 
   14|     float ambientOcclusion = mix(1.0, 0.62, clamp(vAo, 0.0, 1.0));
   15|     vec3 ambient = ambientIrradiance();
   16|     // The voxel field is deliberately a restrained diffuse-fill term.
   17|     // It never substitutes for the analytic fixtures below.
   18|     vec3 cachedStatic = sampleStaticIrradiance(vWorldPosition, normal) * 0.12;
   19|     vec3 analyticDirect = vec3(0.0);
   20| 
   21|     for (int lightIndex = 0; lightIndex < uLightCount; ++lightIndex) {
   22|         SceneLight light = readSceneLight(uLightFirst + lightIndex);
   23|         vec3 delta = light.position - vWorldPosition;
   24|         vec3 surfaceToLight = normalize(delta);
   25|         float visibility = lightIndex == uShadowedLightIndex
   26|             ? shadowVisibility(vWorldPosition, normal, surfaceToLight)
   27|             : 1.0;
   28|         analyticDirect += evaluateSceneLight(
   29|             vWorldPosition,
   30|             normal,
   31|             light.position,
   32|             light.halfSize,
   33|             light.color,
   34|             light.range,
   35|             light.intensity,
   36|             light.kind
   37|         ) * visibility;
   38|     }
   39|     for (int lightIndex = 0; lightIndex < 4; ++lightIndex) {
   40|         if (lightIndex >= uDynamicLightCount) break;
   41|         analyticDirect += evaluatePointLight(
   42|             vWorldPosition,
   43|             normal,
   44|             uDynamicPosRadius[lightIndex].xyz,
   45|             uDynamicColorIntensity[lightIndex].rgb,
   46|             uDynamicPosRadius[lightIndex].w,
   47|             uDynamicColorIntensity[lightIndex].a
   48|         );
   49|     }
   50| 
   51|     // Screen-space/voxel AO is only a model of indirect sky/room
   52|     // visibility. Applying it to analytic or already-occluded cached
   53|     // fixture light darkens corners twice and violates the light model.
   54|     vec3 radiance = albedo * (
   55|         ambient * ambientOcclusion + cachedStatic + analyticDirect
   56|     ) * (1.0 / PI);
   57|     if (uFlashlightEnabled == 1) {
   58|         radiance += albedo * spotBeam(
   59|             uCameraPosition, uCamForward, vWorldPosition, normal
   60|         );
   61|     }
   62|     return radiance;
   63| }

    1| //! Reconstruct chunk-local packed vertices as world-space surfaces.
    2| 
    3| pub const VERTEX_SHADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
    4| precision highp float;
    5| 
    6| layout(location = 0) in vec3 aPosition;
    7| in float aNormalAxis;
    8| in float aMaterial;
    9| in float aStaticIndirect;
   10| in float aAo;
   11| 
   12| uniform mat4 uProjection;
   13| uniform mat4 uView;
   14| uniform vec3 uChunkOrigin;
   15| 
   16| out vec3 vWorldPosition;
   17| out vec3 vNormal;
   18| flat out float vMaterial;
   19| flat out float vStaticIndirect;
   20| flat out float vAo;
   21| 
   22| vec3 normalForAxis(float axis) {
   23|     if (axis < 0.5) return vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
   24|     if (axis < 1.5) return vec3(0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
   25|     if (axis < 2.5) return vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
   26|     if (axis < 3.5) return vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
   27|     if (axis < 4.5) return vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
   28|     return vec3(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
   29| }
   30| 
   31| void main() {
   32|     vec3 worldPosition = uChunkOrigin + aPosition * (1.0 / 1024.0);
   33|     vWorldPosition = worldPosition;
   34|     vNormal = normalForAxis(aNormalAxis);
   35|     vMaterial = aMaterial;
   36|     vStaticIndirect = aStaticIndirect;
   37|     vAo = aAo;
   38|     gl_Position = uProjection * uView * vec4(worldPosition, 1.0);

===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/render_world_surfaces/sample_static_irradiance.rs (26 lines) =====
    1| //! Sample the baked field in the air cell adjacent to a visible face.
    2| //!
    3| //! Texture texels represent voxel centers. Sampling on the geometric face
    4| //! plane blends the solid receiver with air and was the source of false
    5| //! floor patches. A half-voxel normal offset lands exactly at the adjacent
    6| //! air-cell center for every axis-aligned face.
    7| 
    8| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
    9| vec3 sampleStaticIrradiance(vec3 worldPosition, vec3 normal) {
   10|     if (uBakedLightingEnabled == 0) return vec3(0.0);
   11| 
   12|     ivec3 dimensions = textureSize(uLightVolume, 0);
   13|     if (any(lessThanEqual(dimensions, ivec3(0)))) {
   14|         float scalarFallback = clamp(vStaticIndirect * (1.0 / 15.0), 0.0, 1.0);
   15|         return vec3(scalarFallback);
   16|     }
   17| 
   18|     vec3 worldExtent = vec3(dimensions) * uVoxelSize;
   19|     vec3 adjacentAirCenter = worldPosition + normal * (0.5 * uVoxelSize);
   20|     vec3 uvw = (adjacentAirCenter - uLightVolumeOrigin) / worldExtent;
   21|     if (any(lessThan(uvw, vec3(0.0))) || any(greaterThan(uvw, vec3(1.0)))) {
   22|         return vec3(0.0);
   23|     }
   24|     return texture(uLightVolume, uvw).rgb;
   25| }

===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/render_world_surfaces/hero_shadow_visibility.rs (27 lines) =====
    1| //! Sample the optional hero-light shadow map for one visible surface point.
    2| 
    3| pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
    4| float shadowVisibility(vec3 worldPosition, vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceToLight) {
    5|     vec4 clip = uLightViewProjection * vec4(worldPosition + normal * 0.02, 1.0);
    6|     vec3 projected = clip.xyz / max(abs(clip.w), 1e-8);
    7|     vec2 uv = projected.xy * 0.5 + 0.5;
    8|     float receiverDepth = projected.z * 0.5 + 0.5;
    9|     if (any(lessThan(uv, vec2(0.0))) || any(greaterThan(uv, vec2(1.0)))
   10|         || receiverDepth <= 0.0 || receiverDepth >= 1.0) {
   11|         return 1.0;
   12|     }
   13| 
   14|     vec2 texel = 1.0 / vec2(textureSize(uShadowMap, 0));
   15|     float bias = max(0.0015 * (1.0 - dot(normal, surfaceToLight)), 0.0005);
   16|     float visible = 0.0;
   17|     vec2 offsets[4] = vec2[](
   18|         vec2(-0.5, -0.5), vec2(0.5, -0.5),
   19|         vec2(-0.5, 0.5), vec2(0.5, 0.5)
   20|     );
   21|     for (int tap = 0; tap < 4; ++tap) {
   22|         float storedDepth = texture(uShadowMap, uv + offsets[tap] * texel).r;
   23|         visible += receiverDepth - bias <= storedDepth ? 1.0 : 0.0;
   24|     }
   25|     return visible * 0.25;
   26| }

    7|         || abs(material - 16.0) < 0.1;

   17|     if (abs(material - 9.0) < 0.1) return albedo * 8.0;

  134| fn render_frame(renderer: &mut SurfaceRenderer, frame: &FrameParams, toggles: RenderToggles) {
  135|     begin_main_frame(renderer, frame);
  136|     let (mut visible, clustered_lights) =
  137|         prepare_visible_draws(renderer, frame, toggles.distance_cull);
  138|     if renderer
  139|         .scene_lights
  140|         .upload(&renderer.gl, &clustered_lights)
  141|         .is_err()
  142|     {
  143|         for draw in &mut visible {
  144|             draw.lights.count = 0;
  145|             draw.hero_local_index = -1;
  146|         }
  147|     }
  148| 
  149|     let (shadow, shadow_casters, shadow_draw_calls) =
  150|         render_shadow_pass(renderer, frame, toggles.shadow_pass);
  151| 
  152|     bind_frame_uniforms(
  153|         renderer,
  154|         frame,
  155|         &shadow,
  156|         toggles.dither,
  157|         toggles.baked_lighting,
  158|     );
  159|     let (triangles_drawn, main_draw_calls) = draw_visible_meshes(renderer, &visible, &shadow);
  160|     draw_supply_labels(renderer, frame);
  161| 
  162|     renderer.stats = super::SurfaceFrameStats {
  163|         visible_chunks: visible.len(),
  164|         resident_chunks: renderer.meshes.len(),
  165|         draw_calls: shadow_draw_calls + main_draw_calls,
  166|         triangles_drawn,
  167|         shadow_casters,
  168|     };
  169| }
