===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/raymarch_reference_renderer.rs (329 lines) =====
    1| use crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::atlas::{decode_node, is_emissive};
    2| use crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::camera::Camera;
    3| use crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::settings::CpuRenderSettings;
    4| use crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::shading::{
    5|     FrameLighting, SplatSurface, shade_with_frame_lighting,
    6| };
    7| use crate::application::ports::{ChunkDraw, Environment, LightSource};
    8| use crate::application::rendering::encode_display_color;
    9| use crate::reference::renderer::{ReferenceRenderSettings, ReferenceRendererPort, RenderedImage};
   10| use crate::reference::scene::RenderSceneSnapshot;
   11| 
   12| pub struct RaymarchReferenceRenderer;
   13| 
   14| impl RaymarchReferenceRenderer {
   15|     pub fn new() -> Self {
   16|         Self
   17|     }
   18| }
   19| 
   20| fn raymarch_pixel(
   21|     cam: &Camera,
   22|     env: &Environment,
   23|     settings: &CpuRenderSettings,
   24|     atlas: &[u32],
   25|     chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
   26|     scene_lights: &[LightSource],
   27|     ro: [f32; 3],
   28|     rd: [f32; 3],
   29| ) -> Option<[u8; 3]> {
   30|     let safe = |v: f32| {
   31|         if v.abs() < 1e-4 {
   32|             1e-4f32.copysign(v)
   33|         } else {
   34|             v
   35|         }
   36|     };
   37|     let rd = [safe(rd[0]), safe(rd[1]), safe(rd[2])];
   38|     let inv = [1.0 / rd[0], 1.0 / rd[1], 1.0 / rd[2]];
   39| 
   40|     let mut hits: Vec<(usize, f32)> = Vec::new();
   41|     for (i, d) in chunks.iter().enumerate() {
   42|         let lro = [
   43|             ro[0] - d.origin[0],
   44|             ro[1] - d.origin[1],
   45|             ro[2] - d.origin[2],
   46|         ];
   47|         let mut t_entry = f32::MIN;
   48|         let mut t_exit = f32::MAX;
   49|         for a in 0..3 {
   50|             let t1 = (0.0 - lro[a]) * inv[a];
   51|             let t2 = (d.world_size - lro[a]) * inv[a];
   52|             t_entry = t_entry.max(t1.min(t2));
   53|             t_exit = t_exit.min(t1.max(t2));
   54|         }
   55|         if t_entry < t_exit && t_exit > 0.0 {
   56|             hits.push((i, t_entry.max(0.0)));
   57|         }
   58|     }
   59|     hits.sort_by(|a, b| a.1.total_cmp(&b.1));
   60| 
   61|     for (i, t_min) in hits {
   62|         let d = &chunks[i];
   63|         let lro = [
   64|             ro[0] - d.origin[0],
   65|             ro[1] - d.origin[1],
   66|             ro[2] - d.origin[2],
   67|         ];
   68|         if let Some((t, bmin, bmax, _vt, hit_leaf_node_idx)) =
   69|             raymarch_svo(atlas, lro, rd, d.root_index as usize, t_min, d.world_size)
   70|         {
   71|             let decoded = decode_node(atlas, hit_leaf_node_idx)?;
   72| 
   73|             let center = [
   74|                 (bmin[0] + bmax[0]) * 0.5 + d.origin[0],
   75|                 (bmin[1] + bmax[1]) * 0.5 + d.origin[1],
   76|                 (bmin[2] + bmax[2]) * 0.5 + d.origin[2],
   77|             ];
   78|             let world_size = bmax[0] - bmin[0];
   79| 
   80|             let surface = SplatSurface {
   81|                 center,
   82|                 world_size,
   83|                 dist: t,
   84|                 base_color: decoded.color,
   85|                 baked_irradiance: decoded.baked_rgb.map(f32::from),
   86|                 voxel_type: decoded.voxel_type,
   87|                 is_emissive: is_emissive(decoded.voxel_type),
   88|                 // The reference raymarcher already reached a real leaf but
   89|                 // does not yet carry its exact hit face through this legacy
   90|                 // tuple. Restricting the normal to the leaf's authored
   91|                 // material plus its possible AABB faces preserves behavior;
   92|                 // production splats pass topology-derived exposure instead.
   93|                 exposure: decoded.exposure,
   94|                 crowded_siblings: 1, // Default/fallback sibling density for raymarcher
   95|             };
   96| 
   97|             let rgb = shade_with_frame_lighting(
   98|                 cam,
   99|                 env,
  100|                 settings,
  101|                 atlas,
  102|                 chunks,
  103|                 FrameLighting::unshadowed(scene_lights),
  104|                 &surface,
  105|             );
  106|             return Some(rgb);
  107|         }
  108|     }
  109|     None
  110| }
  111| 
  112| fn raymarch_svo(
  113|     atlas: &[u32],
  114|     ro: [f32; 3],
  115|     rd: [f32; 3],
  116|     chunk_root_idx: usize,
  117|     t_entry: f32,
  118|     world_size: f32,
  119| ) -> Option<(f32, [f32; 3], [f32; 3], u32, usize)> {
  120|     let mut t = t_entry;
  121|     let mut p = [ro[0] + t * rd[0], ro[1] + t * rd[1], ro[2] + t * rd[2]];
  122| 
  123|     let mut stack: Vec<(usize, [f32; 3], [f32; 3])> = Vec::new();
  124|     let mut current_node = chunk_root_idx;
  125|     let mut cmin = [0.0f32; 3];
  126|     let mut cmax = [world_size; 3];
  127| 
  128|     for _ in 0..160 {
  129|         if current_node * 4 + 2 >= atlas.len() {
  130|             return None;
  131|         }
  132|         let tx = current_node * 4;
  133|         let (is_leaf, a, b) = (atlas[tx] == 1, atlas[tx + 1], atlas[tx + 2]);
  134| 
  135|         if is_leaf {
  136|             if a != 0 {
  137|                 return Some((t, cmin, cmax, a, current_node));
  138|             }
  139|             let exit = |lo: f32, hi: f32, o: f32, d: f32| (if d > 0.0 { hi } else { lo } - o) / d;
  140|             let tx = exit(cmin[0], cmax[0], ro[0], rd[0]);
  141|             let ty = exit(cmin[1], cmax[1], ro[1], rd[1]);
  142|             let tz = exit(cmin[2], cmax[2], ro[2], rd[2]);
  143|             let t_exit = tx.min(ty).min(tz);
  144|             t = t_exit;
  145|             p = [ro[0] + t * rd[0], ro[1] + t * rd[1], ro[2] + t * rd[2]];
  146|             if (t_exit - tx).abs() < 1e-4 {
  147|                 p[0] = (if rd[0] > 0.0 { cmax[0] } else { cmin[0] })
  148|                     + (if rd[0] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
  149|             }
  150|             if (t_exit - ty).abs() < 1e-4 {
  151|                 p[1] = (if rd[1] > 0.0 { cmax[1] } else { cmin[1] })
  152|                     + (if rd[1] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
  153|             }
  154|             if (t_exit - tz).abs() < 1e-4 {
  155|                 p[2] = (if rd[2] > 0.0 { cmax[2] } else { cmin[2] })
  156|                     + (if rd[2] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
  157|             }
  158|             while outside(p, cmin, cmax) {
  159|                 let Some(f) = stack.pop() else { return None };
  160|                 current_node = f.0;
  161|                 cmin = f.1;
  162|                 cmax = f.2;
  163|             }
  164|         } else {
  165|             let center = [
  166|                 (cmin[0] + cmax[0]) * 0.5,
  167|                 (cmin[1] + cmax[1]) * 0.5,
  168|                 (cmin[2] + cmax[2]) * 0.5,
  169|             ];
  170|             let ox = (p[0] >= center[0]) as usize;
  171|             let oy = (p[1] >= center[1]) as usize;
  172|             let oz = (p[2] >= center[2]) as usize;
  173|             let child_idx = (oz << 2) | (oy << 1) | ox;
  174| 
  175|             if b & (1 << child_idx) != 0 {
  176|                 if stack.len() < 8 {
  177|                     stack.push((current_node, cmin, cmax));
  178|                 }
  179|                 if ox == 1 {
  180|                     cmin[0] = center[0]
  181|                 } else {
  182|                     cmax[0] = center[0]
  183|                 }
  184|                 if oy == 1 {
  185|                     cmin[1] = center[1]
  186|                 } else {
  187|                     cmax[1] = center[1]
  188|                 }
  189|                 if oz == 1 {
  190|                     cmin[2] = center[2]
  191|                 } else {
  192|                     cmax[2] = center[2]
  193|                 }
  194|                 current_node = a as usize + child_idx;
  195|             } else {
  196|                 let omin = [
  197|                     if ox == 1 { center[0] } else { cmin[0] },
  198|                     if oy == 1 { center[1] } else { cmin[1] },
  199|                     if oz == 1 { center[2] } else { cmin[2] },
  200|                 ];
  201|                 let omax = [
  202|                     if ox == 1 { cmax[0] } else { center[0] },
  203|                     if oy == 1 { cmax[1] } else { center[1] },
  204|                     if oz == 1 { cmax[2] } else { center[2] },
  205|                 ];
  206|                 let exit =
  207|                     |lo: f32, hi: f32, o: f32, d: f32| (if d > 0.0 { hi } else { lo } - o) / d;
  208|                 let tx = exit(omin[0], omax[0], ro[0], rd[0]);
  209|                 let ty = exit(omin[1], omax[1], ro[1], rd[1]);
  210|                 let tz = exit(omin[2], omax[2], ro[2], rd[2]);
  211|                 let t_exit = tx.min(ty).min(tz);
  212|                 t = t_exit;
  213|                 p = [ro[0] + t * rd[0], ro[1] + t * rd[1], ro[2] + t * rd[2]];
  214|                 if (t_exit - tx).abs() < 1e-4 {
  215|                     p[0] = (if rd[0] > 0.0 { omax[0] } else { omin[0] })
  216|                         + (if rd[0] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
  217|                 }
  218|                 if (t_exit - ty).abs() < 1e-4 {
  219|                     p[1] = (if rd[1] > 0.0 { omax[1] } else { omin[1] })
  220|                         + (if rd[1] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
  221|                 }
  222|                 if (t_exit - tz).abs() < 1e-4 {
  223|                     p[2] = (if rd[2] > 0.0 { omax[2] } else { omin[2] })
  224|                         + (if rd[2] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
  225|                 }
  226|                 while outside(p, cmin, cmax) {
  227|                     let Some(f) = stack.pop() else { return None };
  228|                     current_node = f.0;
  229|                     cmin = f.1;
  230|                     cmax = f.2;
  231|                 }
  232|             }
  233|         }
  234|     }
  235|     None
  236| }
  237| 
  238| fn outside(p: [f32; 3], min: [f32; 3], max: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
  239|     p[0] < min[0]
  240|         || p[0] > max[0]
  241|         || p[1] < min[1]
  242|         || p[1] > max[1]
  243|         || p[2] < min[2]
  244|         || p[2] > max[2]
  245| }
  246| 
  247| impl ReferenceRendererPort for RaymarchReferenceRenderer {
  248|     fn render(
  249|         &mut self,
  250|         scene: &RenderSceneSnapshot,
  251|         settings: &ReferenceRenderSettings,
  252|     ) -> RenderedImage {
  253|         let mut rgba = vec![0u8; (settings.width * settings.height * 4) as usize];
  254|         let frame_params = settings.frame_params(&scene.scene_lights);
  255|         let cpu_settings = settings.effective_cpu_settings();
  256|         let background_radiance = if settings.environment.outdoor {
  257|             settings.environment.sky_color
  258|         } else {
  259|             settings.environment.fog_color
  260|         };
  261|         let clear_color = encode_display_color(background_radiance)
  262|             .map(|channel| (channel * 255.0).round().clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8);
  263| 
  264|         let camera = Camera::new(
  265|             &frame_params,
  266|             settings.width as usize,
  267|             settings.height as usize,
  268|             &cpu_settings,
  269|         );
  270| 
  271|         for y in 0..settings.height {
  272|             for x in 0..settings.width {
  273|                 let relative_x = x as f32 - camera.half_w;
  274|                 let relative_y = camera.half_h - y as f32;
  275| 
  276|                 let dir_camera_space = [
  277|                     relative_x / camera.focal_px,
  278|                     relative_y / camera.focal_px,
  279|                     1.0f32,
  280|                 ];
  281|                 let length = (dir_camera_space[0].powi(2)
  282|                     + dir_camera_space[1].powi(2)
  283|                     + dir_camera_space[2].powi(2))
  284|                 .sqrt();
  285|                 let dir_camera_space_normalized = [
  286|                     dir_camera_space[0] / length,
  287|                     dir_camera_space[1] / length,
  288|                     dir_camera_space[2] / length,
  289|                 ];
  290| 
  291|                 let rd = [
  292|                     dir_camera_space_normalized[0] * camera.right[0]
  293|                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[1] * camera.up[0]
  294|                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[2] * camera.forward[0],
  295|                     dir_camera_space_normalized[0] * camera.right[1]
  296|                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[1] * camera.up[1]
  297|                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[2] * camera.forward[1],
  298|                     dir_camera_space_normalized[0] * camera.right[2]
  299|                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[1] * camera.up[2]
  300|                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[2] * camera.forward[2],
  301|                 ];
  302| 
  303|                 let color = raymarch_pixel(
  304|                     &camera,
  305|                     &settings.environment,
  306|                     &cpu_settings,
  307|                     &scene.atlas,
  308|                     &scene.chunks,
  309|                     &scene.scene_lights,
  310|                     settings.camera.position,
  311|                     rd,
  312|                 )
  313|                 .unwrap_or(clear_color);
  314| 
  315|                 let idx = ((y * settings.width + x) * 4) as usize;
  316|                 rgba[idx] = color[0];
  317|                 rgba[idx + 1] = color[1];
  318|                 rgba[idx + 2] = color[2];
  319|                 rgba[idx + 3] = 255;
  320|             }
  321|         }
  322| 
  323|         RenderedImage {
  324|             width: settings.width,
  325|             height: settings.height,
  326|             rgba,
  327|         }
  328|     }
  329| }

RaymarchReferenceRenderer:
- Per-pixel: O(C) chunk intersection + sort O(C log C) (with tiny C), then per chunk `raymarch_svo` O(160) steps each with heap Vec push/pop (stack) — allocation per step (Vec push may realloc but bounded at 8; still, `stack.push` per descent and `pop` per exit — that's fine).
- `shade_with_frame_lighting` per hit — loops over lights? It's in adapters (out of scope). The reference renderer: per-pixel per-hit shading with scene_lights — that's from `adapters::cpu_splatter::shading`, out of scope but note.
- `raymarch_pixel` allocates `hits` Vec per pixel (heap alloc per pixel!) — a per-pixel allocation: Vec::new() → push up to C entries. That's a per-pixel heap allocation (two allocations: Vec growth). For a reference renderer only, so Low/Medium.

Note in raymarch_svo: `if stack.len() < 8 { stack.push(...) }` — silently drops pushes when stack is full (8). That's a correctness guard — when the stack overflows, it just doesn't push and later `pop` returns None → return None (miss). Slight correctness risk but reference only.

Now let's look at the webgpu renderer, browser_context, frame_resources, pipelines (raymarch is the big one), and the WGSL shaders. Also reference/ files, terminal.rs, main.rs, lib.rs atomics, generation_worker_policy.rs, input_bindings.rs, surfel_layout.rs, fs_artifact_sink.rs, console_telemetry.rs, drivers/mod.rs, cpu_reference_renderer.rs, and static/worker.js.

   36| /// Picks the strategy this adapter can certainly run well when the player
   37| /// has not chosen one. A fallback adapter (`isFallbackAdapter`, surfaced by
   38| /// wgpu as `DeviceType::Cpu`) or a software rasterizer means every
   39| /// GPU-heavy path would grind; the CPU splatter is built for exactly that
   40| /// case and asks the device for nothing but one texture blit per frame.
   41| /// Real GPUs take the default surface strategy.
   42| fn most_compatible_kind(info: &wgpu::AdapterInfo) -> RendererKind {
   43|     let name = info.name.to_ascii_lowercase();
   44|     let software = matches!(info.device_type, wgpu::DeviceType::Cpu)
   45|         || name.contains("swiftshader")
   46|         || name.contains("llvmpipe")
   47|         || name.contains("lavapipe");
   48|     if software {
   49|         RendererKind::Cpu
   50|     } else {
   51|         RendererKind::Surface
   52|     }
   53| }

  282|                 let mut settings = crate::get_cpu_settings();
  283|                 settings.fov_tan = super::camera_state::fov_tan();
  284|                 settings.toggles = toggles;
  285|                 pipeline.draw(
  286|                     &self.context.queue,
  287|                     &mut encoder,
  288|                     &view,
  289|                     frame,
  290|                     chunks,
  291|                     settings,
  292|                 );
  293|             }
  294|         }
  295|         if matches!(&self.strategy, Strategy::Surface(_) | Strategy::Splat(_)) {
  296|             self.supply_labels.draw(
  297|                 &self.context.queue,
  298|                 &mut encoder,
  299|                 &view,
  300|                 &self.depth_view,
  301|                 &self.frame_resources,
  302|                 frame,
  303|             );
  304|         }
  305|         self.context.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
  306|         self.context.queue.present(surface_texture);
  307|         if should_reconfigure {
  308|             self.context.reconfigure();
  309|         }
  310|     }

   13| pub struct BrowserGpuContext {
   14|     _instance: wgpu::Instance,
   15|     surface: wgpu::Surface<'static>,
   16|     pub adapter_info: wgpu::AdapterInfo,
   17|     pub device: wgpu::Device,

   22| 
   23| impl BrowserGpuContext {
   24|     pub async fn new(canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement) -> Result<Self, JsValue> {
   25|         let instance = wgpu::Instance::new(wgpu::InstanceDescriptor {
   26|             backends: wgpu::Backends::BROWSER_WEBGPU,
   27|             ..wgpu::InstanceDescriptor::new_without_display_handle()
   28|         });
   29|         let surface = instance
   30|             .create_surface(wgpu::SurfaceTarget::Canvas(canvas.clone()))
   31|             .map_err(js_error)?;
   32|         // Browser WebGPU does not expose wgpu's native forced-fallback flag.
   33|         // Make one standards-based request and let backend selection recover
   34|         // to WebGL when the browser reports no adapter.
   35|         let adapter = instance
   36|             .request_adapter(&wgpu::RequestAdapterOptions {
   37|                 power_preference: wgpu::PowerPreference::None,
   38|                 compatible_surface: Some(&surface),
   39|                 force_fallback_adapter: false,
   40|                 apply_limit_buckets: true,
   41|             })
   42|             .await
   43|             .map_err(|error| js_error(format!("no WebGPU adapter: {error}")))?;
   44|         let adapter_info = adapter.get_info();
   45|         // Never request more than the adapter reports: desktop-default
   46|         // limits make `requestDevice` reject outright on mobile GPUs. Any
   47|         // pipeline that truly needs more than the clamped budget fails with
   48|         // a specific validation error instead.
   49|         let required_limits = wgpu::Limits::default().or_worse_values_from(&adapter.limits());
   50|         let (device, queue) = adapter
   51|             .request_device(&wgpu::DeviceDescriptor {
   52|                 label: Some("vackrooms-webgpu-device"),
   53|                 required_features: wgpu::Features::empty(),
   54|                 required_limits,
   55|                 experimental_features: wgpu::ExperimentalFeatures::disabled(),
   56|                 memory_hints: wgpu::MemoryHints::MemoryUsage,
   57|                 trace: wgpu::Trace::Off,
   58|             })
   59|             .await
   60|             .map_err(js_error)?;
   61|         let device_lost = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
   62|         device.set_device_lost_callback({
   63|             let device_lost = Arc::clone(&device_lost);
   64|             move |reason, message| {
   65|                 device_lost.store(true, Ordering::Release);
   66|                 web_sys::console::error_1(
   67|                     &format!("WebGPU device lost ({reason:?}): {message}").into(),
   68|                 );
   69|             }
   70|         });
   71|         device.on_uncaptured_error(Arc::new(|error| {
   72|             web_sys::console::error_1(&format!("Uncaptured WebGPU error: {error}").into());
   73|         }));
   74| 
   75|         let capabilities = surface.get_capabilities(&adapter);
   76|         let format = capabilities
   77|             .formats
   78|             .iter()
   79|             .copied()
   80|             .find(|format| !format.is_srgb())
   81|             .ok_or_else(|| {
   82|                 JsValue::from_str(
   83|                     "WebGPU surface exposes no linear color format; Vackrooms encodes display color in WGSL",
   84|                 )
   85|             })?;
   86|         let present_mode = capabilities
   87|             .present_modes
   88|             .iter()
   89|             .copied()
   90|             .find(|mode| *mode == wgpu::PresentMode::AutoVsync)
   91|             .or_else(|| capabilities.present_modes.first().copied())
   92|             .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("WebGPU surface exposes no present modes"))?;
   93|         let config = wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration {
   94|             usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
   95|             format,
   96|             color_space: wgpu::SurfaceColorSpace::Auto,
   97|             width: canvas.width().max(1),
   98|             height: canvas.height().max(1),
   99|             desired_maximum_frame_latency: 2,
  100|             present_mode,
  101|             alpha_mode: wgpu::CompositeAlphaMode::Auto,
  102|             view_formats: vec![],
  103|         };
  104|         surface.configure(&device, &config);
  105| 
  106|         Ok(Self {
  107|             _instance: instance,
  108|             surface,
  109|             adapter_info,
  110|             device,
  111|             queue,
  112|             config,
  113|             device_lost,
  114|         })
  115|     }
  116| 
  117|     pub fn format(&self) -> wgpu::TextureFormat {
  118|         self.config.format
  119|     }
  120| 
  121|     pub fn width(&self) -> u32 {
  122|         self.config.width
  123|     }
  124|

    1| //! Bind group zero: one immutable layout and two streaming buffers shared by
    2| //! every GPU strategy.
    3| 
    4| use std::num::NonZeroU64;

    6| use bytemuck::Zeroable;

   11| pub struct FrameResources {
   12|     layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
   13|     frame_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
   14|     light_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
   15|     bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
   16|     light_capacity: usize,
   17| }
   18| 
   19| impl FrameResources {
   20|     pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
   21|         let layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
   22|             label: Some("webgpu.frame-layout"),
   23|             entries: &[
   24|                 wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
   25|                     binding: 0,
   26|                     visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX_FRAGMENT,
   27|                     ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
   28|                         ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
   29|                         has_dynamic_offset: false,
   30|                         min_binding_size: NonZeroU64::new(size_of::<GpuFrameUniforms>() as u64),
   31|                     },
   32|                     count: None,
   33|                 },
   34|                 wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
   35|                     binding: 1,
   36|                     visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX_FRAGMENT,
   37|                     ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
   38|                         ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
   39|                         has_dynamic_offset: false,
   40|                         min_binding_size: NonZeroU64::new(size_of::<GpuLight>() as u64),
   41|                     },
   42|                     count: None,
   43|                 },
   44|             ],
   45|         });
   46|         let frame_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
   47|             label: Some("webgpu.frame-uniforms"),
   48|             size: size_of::<GpuFrameUniforms>() as u64,
   49|             usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
   50|             mapped_at_creation: false,
   51|         });
   52|         let light_capacity = 1;
   53|         let light_buffer = create_light_buffer(device, light_capacity);
   54|         let bind_group = create_bind_group(device, &layout, &frame_buffer, &light_buffer);
   55|         Self {
   56|             layout,
   57|             frame_buffer,
   58|             light_buffer,
   59|             bind_group,
   60|             light_capacity,
   61|         }
   62|     }
   63| 
   64|     pub fn layout(&self) -> &wgpu::BindGroupLayout {
   65|         &self.layout
   66|     }
   67| 
   68|     pub fn bind_group(&self) -> &wgpu::BindGroup {
   69|         &self.bind_group
   70|     }
   71| 
   72|     pub fn write(
   73|         &mut self,
   74|         device: &wgpu::Device,
   75|         queue: &wgpu::Queue,
   76|         frame: &GpuFrameUniforms,
   77|         lights: &[GpuLight],
   78|     ) {
   79|         if lights.len().max(1) > self.light_capacity {
   80|             self.light_capacity = lights.len().max(1).next_power_of_two();
   81|             self.light_buffer = create_light_buffer(device, self.light_capacity);
   82|             self.bind_group =
   83|                 create_bind_group(device, &self.layout, &self.frame_buffer, &self.light_buffer);
   84|         }
   85|         queue.write_buffer(&self.frame_buffer, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(frame));
   86|         if lights.is_empty() {
   87|             queue.write_buffer(
   88|                 &self.light_buffer,
   89|                 0,
   90|                 bytemuck::bytes_of(&GpuLight::zeroed()),
   91|             );
   92|         } else {
   93|             queue.write_buffer(&self.light_buffer, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(lights));
   94|         }
   95|     }
   96| }
   97| 
   98| fn create_light_buffer(device: &wgpu::Device, capacity: usize) -> wgpu::Buffer {
   99|     device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
  100|         label: Some("webgpu.frame-lights"),
  101|         contents: &vec![0; capacity * size_of::<GpuLight>()],
  102|         usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
  103|     })
  104| }
  105| 
  106| fn create_bind_group(
  107|     device: &wgpu::Device,
  108|     layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
  109|     frame: &wgpu::Buffer,
  110|     lights: &wgpu::Buffer,
  111| ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
  112|     device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
  113|         label: Some("webgpu.frame-bind-group"),
  114|         layout,
  115|         entries: &[
  116|             wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
  117|                 binding: 0,
  118|                 resource: frame.as_entire_binding(),
  119|             },
  120|             wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
  121|                 binding: 1,
  122|                 resource: lights.as_entire_binding(),
  123|             },
  124|         ],
  125|     })

WebGPU renderer notes:
- device_lost: Arc<AtomicBool>, store Release / load Acquire — correct ordering (a lost device is a flag; AcqRel is appropriate for the callback→renderer thread handoff).
- FrameResources::write reallocates the light buffer when capacity exceeded (doubling), which also rebuilds the bind group mid-frame — happens rarely. OK.
- No frame-in-flight protection: queue.submit then queue.present; desired_maximum_frame_latency 2; single encoder per frame; wgpu handles this.

Now the big one: webgpu/pipelines/raymarch.rs and raymarch.wgsl. Also surface.rs, splat.rs, surfel.rs, raster_shadow.rs, supply_labels.rs, cpu_present.rs, visibility.rs pipelines. And gpu_types.rs, config.rs, shader.rs, camera_state.rs. Let me read raymarch pipeline + wgsl first.

  146|     pub fn configure(&mut self, options: RaymarchRuntimeOptions) {
  147|         self.runtime_options = options;
  148|     }
  149| 
  150|     pub fn upload_atlas(&mut self, device: &wgpu::Device, texels: &[u32]) {
  151|         let words: &[u32] = if texels.is_empty() {
  152|             &[0, 0, 0, 0]
  153|         } else {
  154|             texels
  155|         };
  156|         self.atlas = create_atlas_buffer(device, words);
  157|         self.atlas_word_capacity = words.len();
  158|         self.atlas_initialized = !texels.is_empty();
  159|         self.rebuild_bind_group(device);
  160|     }
  161| 
  162|     /// Replaces the dense voxel arena the brick nodes index into. An empty
  163|     /// upload keeps a minimal placeholder rather than dropping the binding.
  164|     pub fn upload_brick_voxels(&mut self, device: &wgpu::Device, words: &[u32]) {
  165|         self.bricks = create_brick_buffer(device, if words.is_empty() { &[0, 0] } else { words });
  166|         self.rebuild_bind_group(device);
  167|     }
  168| 
  169|     fn rebuild_bind_group(&mut self, device: &wgpu::Device) {
  170|         self.bind_group = create_bind_group(
  171|             device,
  172|             &self.scene_layout,
  173|             &self.atlas,
  174|             &self.chunks,
  175|             &self.scene,
  176|             &self.bricks,
  177|         );
  178|     }
  179| 
  180|     pub fn upload_atlas_rows(
  181|         &mut self,
  182|         queue: &wgpu::Queue,
  183|         first_row: u32,
  184|         texels: &[u32],
  185|     ) -> bool {
  186|         let row_words = (ATLAS_TEXELS_PER_ROW * WORDS_PER_NODE) as usize;
  187|         if !self.atlas_initialized || texels.is_empty() || texels.len() % row_words != 0 {
  188|             return false;
  189|         }
  190|         let first_word = first_row as usize * row_words;
  191|         let Some(end_word) = first_word.checked_add(texels.len()) else {
  192|             return false;
  193|         };
  194|         if end_word > self.atlas_word_capacity {
  195|             return false;
  196|         }
  197|         queue.write_buffer(
  198|             &self.atlas,
  199|             (first_word * size_of::<u32>()) as u64,
  200|             bytemuck::cast_slice(texels),
  201|         );
  202|         true
  203|     }
  204| 
  205|     #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
  206|     pub fn draw(
  207|         &self,
  208|         queue: &wgpu::Queue,
  209|         encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
  210|         target: &wgpu::TextureView,
  211|         frame_resources: &FrameResources,
  212|         frame: &FrameParams,
  213|         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
  214|         toggles: RenderToggles,
  215|     ) {
  216|         let chunks: Vec<_> = select_ray_chunks(
  217|             chunks,
  218|             frame.camera_pos,
  219|             self.max_chunks,
  220|             toggles.front_to_back,
  221|             toggles.distance_cull,
  222|             self.runtime_options.maximum_draw_distance,
  223|         )
  224|         .into_iter()
  225|         .map(|(source_index, chunk)| pack_ray_chunk(source_index, chunk))
  226|         .collect();
  227|         if !chunks.is_empty() {
  228|             queue.write_buffer(&self.chunks, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&chunks));
  229|         }
  230|         queue.write_buffer(
  231|             &self.scene,
  232|             0,
  233|             bytemuck::bytes_of(&GpuRayScene::from_policy(
  234|                 chunks.len() as u32,
  235|                 toggles.empty_space_skip,
  236|                 toggles.front_to_back,
  237|                 direct_light_visibility_enabled(
  238|                     self.runtime_options.direct_light_visibility,
  239|                     toggles.shadow_pass,
  240|                 ),
  241|                 self.runtime_options.area_light_visibility_samples,
  242|             )),
  243|         );
  244| 
  245|         let environment = frame.environment;
  246|         let clear_linear = if environment.outdoor {
  247|             environment.sky_color
  248|         } else {
  249|             environment.fog_color
  250|         };
  251|         let clear = encode_display_color(clear_linear);
  252|         let color_attachments = [Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
  253|             view: target,
  254|             resolve_target: None,
  255|             depth_slice: None,
  256|             ops: wgpu::Operations {
  257|                 load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color {
  258|                     r: clear[0] as f64,
  259|                     g: clear[1] as f64,
  260|                     b: clear[2] as f64,
  261|                     a: 1.0,
  262|                 }),
  263|                 store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
  264|             },
  265|         })];
  266|         let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
  267|             label: Some("webgpu.raymarch.pass"),
  268|             color_attachments: &color_attachments,
  269|             ..Default::default()
  270|         });
  271|         pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
  272|         pass.set_bind_group(0, frame_resources.bind_group(), &[]);
  273|         pass.set_bind_group(1, &self.bind_group, &[]);
  274|         pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
  275|     }
  276| }
  277| 
  278| const fn direct_light_visibility_enabled(profile_capability: bool, rt_shadows: bool) -> bool {
  279|     profile_capability && rt_shadows
  280| }
  281| 
  282| /// Selects the bounded resident set before packing it for the GPU. Disabled
  283| /// policy preserves exact source order; enabled policy uses stable distance
  284| /// to each complete chunk cube, so a large cube containing the camera wins
  285| /// over a smaller cube whose origin merely happens to be nearby.
  286| fn select_ray_chunks(
  287|     chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
  288|     camera_position: [f32; 3],
  289|     maximum: usize,
  290|     front_to_back: bool,
  291|     distance_cull: bool,
  292|     maximum_draw_distance: f32,
  293| ) -> Vec<(usize, &ChunkDraw)> {
  294|     let mut selected: Vec<_> = chunks.iter().enumerate().collect();
  295|     if distance_cull {
  296|         let maximum_distance_squared = maximum_draw_distance * maximum_draw_distance;
  297|         selected.retain(|(_, chunk)| {
  298|             let distance_squared = distance_squared_to_chunk(camera_position, chunk);
  299|             distance_squared.is_finite()
  300|                 && (maximum_distance_squared.is_infinite()
  301|                     || distance_squared <= maximum_distance_squared)
  302|         });
  303|     }
  304|     if front_to_back {
  305|         selected.sort_by(|(left_index, left), (right_index, right)| {
  306|             distance_squared_to_chunk(camera_position, left)
  307|                 .total_cmp(&distance_squared_to_chunk(camera_position, right))
  308|                 .then_with(|| left_index.cmp(right_index))
  309|         });
  310|     }
  311|     selected.truncate(maximum);
  312|     selected
  313| }
  314| 
  315| fn distance_squared_to_chunk(camera_position: [f32; 3], chunk: &ChunkDraw) -> f32 {
  316|     if camera_position.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite())
  317|         || chunk.origin.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite())
  318|         || !chunk.world_size.is_finite()
  319|         || chunk.world_size <= 0.0
  320|     {
  321|         return f32::INFINITY;
  322|     }
  323| 
  324|     let mut distance_squared = 0.0;
  325|     for axis in 0..3 {
  326|         let minimum = chunk.origin[axis];
  327|         let maximum = minimum + chunk.world_size;
  328|         if !maximum.is_finite() {
  329|             return f32::INFINITY;
  330|         }
  331|         let delta = if camera_position[axis] < minimum {
  332|             minimum - camera_position[axis]
  333|         } else if camera_position[axis] > maximum {
  334|             camera_position[axis] - maximum
  335|         } else {
  336|             0.0
  337|         };
  338|         distance_squared += delta * delta;
  339|     }
  340|     if distance_squared.is_finite() {
  341|         distance_squared
  342|     } else {
  343|         f32::INFINITY
  344|     }
  345| }
  346| 
  347| fn pack_ray_chunk(source_index: usize, chunk: &ChunkDraw) -> GpuRayChunk {
  348|     GpuRayChunk {
  349|         origin_world_size: [
  350|             chunk.origin[0],
  351|             chunk.origin[1],
  352|             chunk.origin[2],
  353|             chunk.world_size,
  354|         ],
  355|         voxel_depth: [chunk.voxel_size, f32::from(chunk.svo_depth), 0.0, 0.0],
  356|         // Keep the stable source ordinal so reordering cannot change which
  357|         // overlapping chunk wins an exactly equal-distance hit.
  358|         indices: [
  359|             chunk.root_index.max(0) as u32,
  360|             source_index.min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
  361|             0,
  362|             0,
  363|         ],
  364|     }
  365| }

  399|                 count: None,

  409|                 count: None,
  410|             },
  411|         ],
  412|     })

===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/webgpu/shaders/raymarch.wgsl (400 lines) =====
    1| // SVO raymarch strategy. Nodes remain in the canonical four-u32 encoding;
    2| // point lookup is stateless, and optional empty-leaf stepping changes only
    3| // how far an empty sample advances.
    4| //
    5| // The atlas may hold either the plain SVO encoding or the bricked one. The
    6| // two are bit-identical for internal and leaf nodes and differ only by an
    7| // extra node kind, so this file needs no mode switch: `lookup_leaf` simply
    8| // recognizes a brick pointer when it meets one, and every consumer above it
    9| // keeps seeing the same `VoxelLeaf` contract.
   10| 
   11| struct RayChunk {
   12|     origin_world_size: vec4<f32>,
   13|     voxel_depth: vec4<f32>,
   14|     // x: root node index in the merged atlas; y: stable source ordinal.
   15|     indices: vec4<u32>,
   16| };
   17| 
   18| struct RayScene {
   19|     chunk_count: u32,
   20|     policy_flags: u32,

   28| const TRACE_MIN_TIE_EPSILON: f32 = 1e-7;

   31| @group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read> atlas_words: array<u32>;

   41| const NODE_KIND_INTERNAL: u32 = 0u;
   42| const NODE_KIND_LEAF: u32 = 1u;

  107| fn box_intersection(
  108|     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
  109|     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
  110|     bounds_min: vec3<f32>,
  111|     bounds_max: vec3<f32>,
  112| ) -> BoxHit {
  113|     if (abs(ray_direction.x) < 1e-20 && (ray_origin.x < bounds_min.x || ray_origin.x > bounds_max.x))
  114|         || (abs(ray_direction.y) < 1e-20 && (ray_origin.y < bounds_min.y || ray_origin.y > bounds_max.y))
  115|         || (abs(ray_direction.z) < 1e-20 && (ray_origin.z < bounds_min.z || ray_origin.z > bounds_max.z)) {
  116|         return BoxHit(false, 0.0, 0.0, vec3<f32>(0.0));
  117|     }
  118|     let inverse = vec3<f32>(
  119|         safe_inverse(ray_direction.x),
  120|         safe_inverse(ray_direction.y),
  121|         safe_inverse(ray_direction.z)
  122|     );
  123|     var near_times = min((bounds_min - ray_origin) * inverse, (bounds_max - ray_origin) * inverse);
  124|     var far_times = max((bounds_min - ray_origin) * inverse, (bounds_max - ray_origin) * inverse);
  125|     if abs(ray_direction.x) < 1e-20 { near_times.x = -1e30; far_times.x = 1e30; }
  126|     if abs(ray_direction.y) < 1e-20 { near_times.y = -1e30; far_times.y = 1e30; }
  127|     if abs(ray_direction.z) < 1e-20 { near_times.z = -1e30; far_times.z = 1e30; }
  128|     let entry = max(near_times.x, max(near_times.y, near_times.z));
  129|     let exit = min(far_times.x, min(far_times.y, far_times.z));
  130|     if entry > exit || exit < 0.0 {
  131|         return BoxHit(false, entry, exit, vec3<f32>(0.0));
  132|     }
  133|     var normal = vec3<f32>(0.0);
  134|     if entry <= 0.0 {
  135|         let absolute = abs(ray_direction);
  136|         if absolute.x >= absolute.y && absolute.x >= absolute.z {
  137|             normal = vec3<f32>(-sign(ray_direction.x), 0.0, 0.0);
  138|         } else if absolute.y >= absolute.z {
  139|             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, -sign(ray_direction.y), 0.0);
  140|         } else {
  141|             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -sign(ray_direction.z));
  142|         }
  143|     } else if near_times.x >= near_times.y && near_times.x >= near_times.z {
  144|         normal = vec3<f32>(select(1.0, -1.0, ray_direction.x > 0.0), 0.0, 0.0);
  145|     } else if near_times.y >= near_times.z {
  146|         normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, select(1.0, -1.0, ray_direction.y > 0.0), 0.0);
  147|     } else {
  148|         normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, select(1.0, -1.0, ray_direction.z > 0.0));
  149|     }
  150|     return BoxHit(true, max(entry, 0.0), exit, normal);
  151| }
  152| 
  153| /// Indexes a dense brick. This is the whole point of bricking: the walk
  154| /// stops here and the voxel arrives from one contiguous fetch instead of
  155| /// two more dependent pointer chases.
  156| ///
  157| /// The returned bounds are the *individual voxel's* box, never the brick's.
  158| /// Empty-space skipping advances a ray to the far side of whatever bounds
  159| /// it is handed, so returning the brick would step straight over the solid
  160| /// voxels sharing it.
  161| fn read_brick_voxel(
  162|     word_base: u32,
  163|     point: vec3<f32>,
  164|     bounds_min: vec3<f32>,
  165|     bounds_max: vec3<f32>,
  166| ) -> VoxelLeaf {
  167|     let extent = (bounds_max - bounds_min) / f32(BRICK_EDGE);
  168|     let limit = f32(BRICK_EDGE) - 1.0;
  169|     // The DDA samples a hair inside the cell it means, but rounding can
  170|     // still land a fraction outside the brick; clamping keeps the fetch in
  171|     // bounds without moving any sample that was already correct.
  172|     let local = clamp(
  173|         floor((point - bounds_min) / extent),
  174|         vec3<f32>(0.0),
  175|         vec3<f32>(limit)
  176|     );
  177|     let cell = vec3<u32>(local);
  178|     let offset = cell.z * BRICK_EDGE * BRICK_EDGE + cell.y * BRICK_EDGE + cell.x;
  179|     let word = word_base + offset * 2u;
  180|     let packed_voxel = brick_words[word];
  181|     let packed_light = brick_words[word + 1u];
  182| 
  183|     // Re-pack into the leaf light layout so every consumer above decodes
  184|     // one encoding: scalar level, then occlusion at bit 8, then r/g/b.
  185|     let red = (packed_light >> 8u) & 0xFu;
  186|     let green = (packed_light >> 12u) & 0xFu;
  187|     let blue = (packed_light >> 16u) & 0xFu;
  188|     let light_word = max(red, max(green, blue))
  189|         | ((packed_light & 0xFFu) << 8u)
  190|         | (red << 16u)
  191|         | (green << 20u)
  192|         | (blue << 24u);
  193| 
  194|     let voxel_min = bounds_min + local * extent;
  195|     return VoxelLeaf(
  196|         packed_voxel >> 24u,
  197|         packed_voxel & 0x00FFFFFFu,
  198|         light_word,
  199|         voxel_min,
  200|         voxel_min + extent
  201|     );
  202| }
  203| 
  204| fn lookup_leaf(point: vec3<f32>, chunk: RayChunk) -> VoxelLeaf {
  205|     var node_index = chunk.indices.x;
  206|     var bounds_min = vec3<f32>(0.0);
  207|     var bounds_max = vec3<f32>(chunk.origin_world_size.w);
  208|     let depth = u32(chunk.voxel_depth.y);
  209|     for (var level = 0u; level <= 10u; level += 1u) {
  210|         let word = node_index * 4u;
  211|         let node_type = atlas_words[word];
  212|         let payload = atlas_words[word + 1u];
  213|         let color_or_mask = atlas_words[word + 2u];
  214|         let light_word = atlas_words[word + 3u];
  215|         if node_type == NODE_KIND_LEAF || level >= depth {
  216|             return VoxelLeaf(payload, color_or_mask, light_word, bounds_min, bounds_max);
  217|         }
  218|         if node_type == NODE_KIND_BRICK {
  219|             return read_brick_voxel(payload, point, bounds_min, bounds_max);
  220|         }
  221|         let center = (bounds_min + bounds_max) * 0.5;
  222|         let child_x = select(0u, 1u, point.x >= center.x);
  223|         let child_y = select(0u, 1u, point.y >= center.y);
  224|         let child_z = select(0u, 1u, point.z >= center.z);
  225|         let child = (child_z << 2u) | (child_y << 1u) | child_x;
  226|         let child_min = vec3<f32>(
  227|             select(bounds_min.x, center.x, child_x == 1u),
  228|             select(bounds_min.y, center.y, child_y == 1u),
  229|             select(bounds_min.z, center.z, child_z == 1u)
  230|         );
  231|         let child_max = vec3<f32>(
  232|             select(center.x, bounds_max.x, child_x == 1u),
  233|             select(center.y, bounds_max.y, child_y == 1u),
  234|             select(center.z, bounds_max.z, child_z == 1u)
  235|         );
  236|         if (color_or_mask & (1u << child)) == 0u {
  237|             return VoxelLeaf(0u, 0u, 0u, child_min, child_max);
  238|         }
  239|         node_index = payload + child;
  240|         bounds_min = child_min;
  241|         bounds_max = child_max;
  242|     }
  243|     return VoxelLeaf(0u, 0u, 0u, bounds_min, bounds_max);
  244| }
  245| 
  246| fn next_leaf_exit(
  247|     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
  248|     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
  249|     bounds_min: vec3<f32>,
  250|     bounds_max: vec3<f32>,
  251| ) -> vec4<f32> {
  252|     var times = vec3<f32>(TRACE_INFINITY);
  253|     if abs(ray_direction.x) >= 1e-20 {
  254|         times.x = (select(bounds_min.x, bounds_max.x, ray_direction.x > 0.0) - ray_origin.x) / ray_direction.x;
  255|     }
  256|     if abs(ray_direction.y) >= 1e-20 {
  257|         times.y = (select(bounds_min.y, bounds_max.y, ray_direction.y > 0.0) - ray_origin.y) / ray_direction.y;
  258|     }
  259|     if abs(ray_direction.z) >= 1e-20 {
  260|         times.z = (select(bounds_min.z, bounds_max.z, ray_direction.z > 0.0) - ray_origin.z) / ray_direction.z;
  261|     }
  262|     let nearest = min(times.x, min(times.y, times.z));
  263|     let tolerance = distance_tie_tolerance(nearest);
  264|     // Match finest-DDA X/Y/Z precedence for mathematically tied exits. The
  265|     // traversal bias is intentionally not reused as an equality tolerance.
  266|     if abs(times.x - nearest) <= tolerance {
  267|         return vec4<f32>(nearest, -sign(ray_direction.x), 0.0, 0.0);
  268|     }
  269|     if abs(times.y - nearest) <= tolerance {
  270|         return vec4<f32>(nearest, 0.0, -sign(ray_direction.y), 0.0);
  271|     }
  272|     return vec4<f32>(nearest, 0.0, 0.0, -sign(ray_direction.z));
  273| }
  274| 
  275| fn trace_chunk_dda(
  276|     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
  277|     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
  278|     chunk: RayChunk,
  279|     interval: BoxHit,
  280| ) -> VoxelHit {
  281|     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
  282|     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
  283|     var distance = interval.entry;
  284|     var normal = interval.normal;
  285|     var sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
  286|     var cell = floor(sample / voxel_size);
  287|     let direction_step = sign(ray_direction);
  288|     let budget = clamp(frame.render_options.w, 1u, 4096u);
  289|     for (var step = 0u; step < 4096u; step += 1u) {
  290|         if step >= budget || distance > interval.exit {
  291|             break;
  292|         }
  293|         sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
  294|         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
  295|         if leaf.material != 0u {
  296|             return VoxelHit(
  297|                 true,
  298|                 distance,
  299|                 normal,
  300|                 leaf.material,
  301|                 leaf.color,
  302|                 leaf.light_word,
  303|                 voxel_size
  304|             );
  305|         }
  306| 
  307|         let next_boundary = (cell + max(direction_step, vec3<f32>(0.0))) * voxel_size;
  308|         var next_times = vec3<f32>(TRACE_INFINITY);
  309|         if abs(ray_direction.x) >= 1e-20 { next_times.x = (next_boundary.x - ray_origin.x) / ray_direction.x; }
  310|         if abs(ray_direction.y) >= 1e-20 { next_times.y = (next_boundary.y - ray_origin.y) / ray_direction.y; }
  311|         if abs(ray_direction.z) >= 1e-20 { next_times.z = (next_boundary.z - ray_origin.z) / ray_direction.z; }
  312|         let next_distance = min(next_times.x, min(next_times.y, next_times.z));
  313|         if next_distance > interval.exit { break; }
  314|         let tolerance = distance_tie_tolerance(next_distance);
  315|         let cross_x = abs(next_times.x - next_distance) <= tolerance;
  316|         let cross_y = abs(next_times.y - next_distance) <= tolerance;
  317|         let cross_z = abs(next_times.z - next_distance) <= tolerance;
  318|         if cross_x { cell.x += direction_step.x; }
  319|         if cross_y { cell.y += direction_step.y; }
  320|         if cross_z { cell.z += direction_step.z; }
  321|         if cross_x {
  322|             normal = vec3<f32>(-direction_step.x, 0.0, 0.0);
  323|         } else if cross_y {
  324|             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, -direction_step.y, 0.0);
  325|         } else {
  326|             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -direction_step.z);
  327|         }
  328|         distance = next_distance;
  329|     }
  330|     return VoxelHit(false, 0.0, vec3<f32>(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u, 0.0);
  331| }
  332| 
  333| fn trace_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
  334|     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
  335|     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
  336|     chunk: RayChunk,
  337|     interval: BoxHit,
  338| ) -> VoxelHit {
  339|     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
  340|     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
  341|     var distance = interval.entry;
  342|     var normal = interval.normal;
  343|     var refinement_entry = interval.entry;
  344|     var refinement_entry_normal = interval.normal;
  345|     let budget = clamp(frame.render_options.w, 1u, 4096u);
  346| 
  347|     for (var step = 0u; step < 4096u; step += 1u) {
  348|         if step >= budget || distance > interval.exit {
  349|             break;
  350|         }
  351|         let sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
  352|         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
  353|         if leaf.material != 0u {
  354|             // The coarse walk proves emptiness only. Re-run the canonical
  355|             // finest-cell DDA over the final short interval so skip on/off
  356|             // returns one distance, material, and normal contract.
  357|             let refinement_interval = BoxHit(
  358|                 true,
  359|                 refinement_entry,
  360|                 interval.exit,
  361|                 refinement_entry_normal
  362|             );
  363|             return trace_chunk_dda(
  364|                 ray_origin,
  365|                 ray_direction,
  366|                 chunk,
  367|                 refinement_interval
  368|             );
  369|         }
  370| 
  371|         let exit = next_leaf_exit(
  372|             ray_origin,
  373|             ray_direction,
  374|             leaf.bounds_min,
  375|             leaf.bounds_max
  376|         );
  377|         var next_distance = exit.x;
  378|         if next_distance <= distance + bias * 0.25 {
  379|             next_distance = distance + bias;
  380|         }
  381|         // A normalized ray travels at most one finest voxel per axis over
  382|         // this retained interval, which is enough for DDA to reconstruct all
  383|         // potentially competing boundary crossings.
  384|         refinement_entry = max(distance, next_distance - voxel_size);
  385|         refinement_entry_normal = normal;
  386|         distance = next_distance;
  387|         normal = exit.yzw;
  388|     }
  389|     return VoxelHit(false, 0.0, vec3<f32>(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u, 0.0);
  390| }
  391| 
  392| fn trace_chunk(
  393|     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
  394|     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
  395|     chunk: RayChunk,
  396|     interval: BoxHit,
  397| ) -> VoxelHit {
  398|     if ray_policy_enabled(RAY_POLICY_EMPTY_SPACE_SKIP) {
  399|         return trace_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
  400|             ray_origin,

    1| // SVO raymarch strategy. Nodes remain in the canonical four-u32 encoding;
    2| // point lookup is stateless, and optional empty-leaf stepping changes only
    3| // how far an empty sample advances.
    4| //
    5| // The atlas may hold either the plain SVO encoding or the bricked one. The
    6| // two are bit-identical for internal and leaf nodes and differ only by an
    7| // extra node kind, so this file needs no mode switch: `lookup_leaf` simply
    8| // recognizes a brick pointer when it meets one, and every consumer above it
    9| // keeps seeing the same `VoxelLeaf` contract.
   10|

   12|     origin_world_size: vec4<f32>,
   13|     voxel_depth: vec4<f32>,
   14|     // x: root node index in the merged atlas; y: stable source ordinal.
   15|     indices: vec4<u32>,
   16| };
