  100|     return max(voxel_size * 1e-5, TRACE_MIN_TIE_EPSILON);
  101| }
  102| 
  103| fn ray_policy_enabled(flag: u32) -> bool {
  104|     return (ray_scene.policy_flags & flag) != 0u;
  105| }
  106| 
  107| fn box_intersection(
  108|     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
  109|     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
  110|     bounds_min: vec3<f32>,
  111|     bounds_max: vec3<f32>,
  112| ) -> BoxHit {
  113|     if (abs(ray_direction.x) < 1e-20 && (ray_origin.x < bounds_min.x || ray_origin.x > bounds_max.x))
  114|         || (abs(ray_direction.y) < 1e-20 && (ray_origin.y < bounds_min.y || ray_origin.y > bounds_max.y))
  115|         || (abs(ray_direction.z) < 1e-20 && (ray_origin.z < bounds_min.z || ray_origin.z > bounds_max.z)) {
  116|         return BoxHit(false, 0.0, 0.0, vec3<f32>(0.0));
  117|     }
  118|     let inverse = vec3<f32>(
  119|         safe_inverse(ray_direction.x),
  120|         safe_inverse(ray_direction.y),
  121|         safe_inverse(ray_direction.z)
  122|     );
  123|     var near_times = min((bounds_min - ray_origin) * inverse, (bounds_max - ray_origin) * inverse);
  124|     var far_times = max((bounds_min - ray_origin) * inverse, (bounds_max - ray_origin) * inverse);
  125|     if abs(ray_direction.x) < 1e-20 { near_times.x = -1e30; far_times.x = 1e30; }
  126|     if abs(ray_direction.y) < 1e-20 { near_times.y = -1e30; far_times.y = 1e30; }
  127|     if abs(ray_direction.z) < 1e-20 { near_times.z = -1e30; far_times.z = 1e30; }
  128|     let entry = max(near_times.x, max(near_times.y, near_times.z));
  129|     let exit = min(far_times.x, min(far_times.y, far_times.z));
  130|     if entry > exit || exit < 0.0 {
  131|         return BoxHit(false, entry, exit, vec3<f32>(0.0));
  132|     }
  133|     var normal = vec3<f32>(0.0);
  134|     if entry <= 0.0 {
  135|         let absolute = abs(ray_direction);
  136|         if absolute.x >= absolute.y && absolute.x >= absolute.z {
  137|             normal = vec3<f32>(-sign(ray_direction.x), 0.0, 0.0);
  138|         } else if absolute.y >= absolute.z {
  139|             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, -sign(ray_direction.y), 0.0);
  140|         } else {
  141|             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -sign(ray_direction.z));
  142|         }
  143|     } else if near_times.x >= near_times.y && near_times.x >= near_times.z {
  144|         normal = vec3<f32>(select(1.0, -1.0, ray_direction.x > 0.0), 0.0, 0.0);
  145|     } else if near_times.y >= near_times.z {
  146|         normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, select(1.0, -1.0, ray_direction.y > 0.0), 0.0);
  147|     } else {
  148|         normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, select(1.0, -1.0, ray_direction.z > 0.0));
  149|     }
  150|     return BoxHit(true, max(entry, 0.0), exit, normal);
  151| }
  152| 
  153| /// Indexes a dense brick. This is the whole point of bricking: the walk
  154| /// stops here and the voxel arrives from one contiguous fetch instead of
  155| /// two more dependent pointer chases.
  156| ///
  157| /// The returned bounds are the *individual voxel's* box, never the brick's.
  158| /// Empty-space skipping advances a ray to the far side of whatever bounds
  159| /// it is handed, so returning the brick would step straight over the solid
  160| /// voxels sharing it.
  161| fn read_brick_voxel(
  162|     word_base: u32,
  163|     point: vec3<f32>,
  164|     bounds_min: vec3<f32>,
  165|     bounds_max: vec3<f32>,
  166| ) -> VoxelLeaf {
  167|     let extent = (bounds_max - bounds_min) / f32(BRICK_EDGE);
  168|     let limit = f32(BRICK_EDGE) - 1.0;
  169|     // The DDA samples a hair inside the cell it means, but rounding can
  170|     // still land a fraction outside the brick; clamping keeps the fetch in
  171|     // bounds without moving any sample that was already correct.
  172|     let local = clamp(
  173|         floor((point - bounds_min) / extent),
  174|         vec3<f32>(0.0),
  175|         vec3<f32>(limit)
  176|     );
  177|     let cell = vec3<u32>(local);
  178|     let offset = cell.z * BRICK_EDGE * BRICK_EDGE + cell.y * BRICK_EDGE + cell.x;
  179|     let word = word_base + offset * 2u;
  180|     let packed_voxel = brick_words[word];
  181|     let packed_light = brick_words[word + 1u];
  182| 
  183|     // Re-pack into the leaf light layout so every consumer above decodes
  184|     // one encoding: scalar level, then occlusion at bit 8, then r/g/b.
  185|     let red = (packed_light >> 8u) & 0xFu;
  186|     let green = (packed_light >> 12u) & 0xFu;
  187|     let blue = (packed_light >> 16u) & 0xFu;
  188|     let light_word = max(red, max(green, blue))
  189|         | ((packed_light & 0xFFu) << 8u)
  190|         | (red << 16u)
  191|         | (green << 20u)
  192|         | (blue << 24u);
  193| 
  194|     let voxel_min = bounds_min + local * extent;
  195|     return VoxelLeaf(
  196|         packed_voxel >> 24u,
  197|         packed_voxel & 0x00FFFFFFu,
  198|         light_word,
  199|         voxel_min,
  200|         voxel_min + extent
  201|     );
  202| }
  203| 
  204| fn lookup_leaf(point: vec3<f32>, chunk: RayChunk) -> VoxelLeaf {
  205|     var node_index = chunk.indices.x;
  206|     var bounds_min = vec3<f32>(0.0);
  207|     var bounds_max = vec3<f32>(chunk.origin_world_size.w);
  208|     let depth = u32(chunk.voxel_depth.y);
  209|     for (var level = 0u; level <= 10u; level += 1u) {
  210|         let word = node_index * 4u;
  211|         let node_type = atlas_words[word];
  212|         let payload = atlas_words[word + 1u];
  213|         let color_or_mask = atlas_words[word + 2u];
  214|         let light_word = atlas_words[word + 3u];
  215|         if node_type == NODE_KIND_LEAF || level >= depth {
  216|             return VoxelLeaf(payload, color_or_mask, light_word, bounds_min, bounds_max);
  217|         }
  218|         if node_type == NODE_KIND_BRICK {
  219|             return read_brick_voxel(payload, point, bounds_min, bounds_max);
  220|         }
  221|         let center = (bounds_min + bounds_max) * 0.5;
  222|         let child_x = select(0u, 1u, point.x >= center.x);
  223|         let child_y = select(0u, 1u, point.y >= center.y);
  224|         let child_z = select(0u, 1u, point.z >= center.z);
  225|         let child = (child_z << 2u) | (child_y << 1u) | child_x;
  226|         let child_min = vec3<f32>(
  227|             select(bounds_min.x, center.x, child_x == 1u),
  228|             select(bounds_min.y, center.y, child_y == 1u),
  229|             select(bounds_min.z, center.z, child_z == 1u)
  230|         );
  231|         let child_max = vec3<f32>(
  232|             select(center.x, bounds_max.x, child_x == 1u),
  233|             select(center.y, bounds_max.y, child_y == 1u),
  234|             select(center.z, bounds_max.z, child_z == 1u)
  235|         );
  236|         if (color_or_mask & (1u << child)) == 0u {
  237|             return VoxelLeaf(0u, 0u, 0u, child_min, child_max);
  238|         }
  239|         node_index = payload + child;
  240|         bounds_min = child_min;
  241|         bounds_max = child_max;
  242|     }
  243|     return VoxelLeaf(0u, 0u, 0u, bounds_min, bounds_max);
  244| }
  245| 
  246| fn next_leaf_exit(
  247|     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
  248|     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
  249|     bounds_min: vec3<f32>,
  250|     bounds_max: vec3<f32>,
  251| ) -> vec4<f32> {
  252|     var times = vec3<f32>(TRACE_INFINITY);
  253|     if abs(ray_direction.x) >= 1e-20 {
  254|         times.x = (select(bounds_min.x, bounds_max.x, ray_direction.x > 0.0) - ray_origin.x) / ray_direction.x;
  255|     }
  256|     if abs(ray_direction.y) >= 1e-20 {
  257|         times.y = (select(bounds_min.y, bounds_max.y, ray_direction.y > 0.0) - ray_origin.y) / ray_direction.y;
  258|     }
  259|     if abs(ray_direction.z) >= 1e-20 {
  260|         times.z = (select(bounds_min.z, bounds_max.z, ray_direction.z > 0.0) - ray_origin.z) / ray_direction.z;
  261|     }
  262|     let nearest = min(times.x, min(times.y, times.z));
  263|     let tolerance = distance_tie_tolerance(nearest);
  264|     // Match finest-DDA X/Y/Z precedence for mathematically tied exits. The
  265|     // traversal bias is intentionally not reused as an equality tolerance.
  266|     if abs(times.x - nearest) <= tolerance {
  267|         return vec4<f32>(nearest, -sign(ray_direction.x), 0.0, 0.0);
  268|     }
  269|     if abs(times.y - nearest) <= tolerance {
  270|         return vec4<f32>(nearest, 0.0, -sign(ray_direction.y), 0.0);
  271|     }
  272|     return vec4<f32>(nearest, 0.0, 0.0, -sign(ray_direction.z));
  273| }
  274| 
  275| fn trace_chunk_dda(
  276|     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
  277|     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
  278|     chunk: RayChunk,
  279|     interval: BoxHit,
  280| ) -> VoxelHit {
  281|     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
  282|     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
  283|     var distance = interval.entry;
  284|     var normal = interval.normal;
  285|     var sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
  286|     var cell = floor(sample / voxel_size);
  287|     let direction_step = sign(ray_direction);
  288|     let budget = clamp(frame.render_options.w, 1u, 4096u);
  289|     for (var step = 0u; step < 4096u; step += 1u) {
  290|         if step >= budget || distance > interval.exit {
  291|             break;
  292|         }
  293|         sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
  294|         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
  295|         if leaf.material != 0u {
  296|             return VoxelHit(
  297|                 true,
  298|                 distance,
  299|                 normal,
  300|                 leaf.material,
  301|                 leaf.color,
  302|                 leaf.light_word,
  303|                 voxel_size
  304|             );
  305|         }
  306| 
  307|         let next_boundary = (cell + max(direction_step, vec3<f32>(0.0))) * voxel_size;
  308|         var next_times = vec3<f32>(TRACE_INFINITY);
  309|         if abs(ray_direction.x) >= 1e-20 { next_times.x = (next_boundary.x - ray_origin.x) / ray_direction.x; }
  310|         if abs(ray_direction.y) >= 1e-20 { next_times.y = (next_boundary.y - ray_origin.y) / ray_direction.y; }
  311|         if abs(ray_direction.z) >= 1e-20 { next_times.z = (next_boundary.z - ray_origin.z) / ray_direction.z; }
  312|         let next_distance = min(next_times.x, min(next_times.y, next_times.z));
  313|         if next_distance > interval.exit { break; }
  314|         let tolerance = distance_tie_tolerance(next_distance);
  315|         let cross_x = abs(next_times.x - next_distance) <= tolerance;
  316|         let cross_y = abs(next_times.y - next_distance) <= tolerance;
  317|         let cross_z = abs(next_times.z - next_distance) <= tolerance;
  318|         if cross_x { cell.x += direction_step.x; }
  319|         if cross_y { cell.y += direction_step.y; }
  320|         if cross_z { cell.z += direction_step.z; }
  321|         if cross_x {
  322|             normal = vec3<f32>(-direction_step.x, 0.0, 0.0);
  323|         } else if cross_y {
  324|             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, -direction_step.y, 0.0);
  325|         } else {
  326|             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -direction_step.z);
  327|         }
  328|         distance = next_distance;
  329|     }
  330|     return VoxelHit(false, 0.0, vec3<f32>(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u, 0.0);
  331| }
  332| 
  333| fn trace_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
  334|     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
  335|     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
  336|     chunk: RayChunk,
  337|     interval: BoxHit,
  338| ) -> VoxelHit {
  339|     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
  340|     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
  341|     var distance = interval.entry;
  342|     var normal = interval.normal;
  343|     var refinement_entry = interval.entry;
  344|     var refinement_entry_normal = interval.normal;
  345|     let budget = clamp(frame.render_options.w, 1u, 4096u);
  346| 
  347|     for (var step = 0u; step < 4096u; step += 1u) {
  348|         if step >= budget || distance > interval.exit {
  349|             break;
  350|         }
  351|         let sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
  352|         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
  353|         if leaf.material != 0u {
  354|             // The coarse walk proves emptiness only. Re-run the canonical
  355|             // finest-cell DDA over the final short interval so skip on/off
  356|             // returns one distance, material, and normal contract.
  357|             let refinement_interval = BoxHit(
  358|                 true,
  359|                 refinement_entry,
  360|                 interval.exit,
  361|                 refinement_entry_normal
  362|             );
  363|             return trace_chunk_dda(
  364|                 ray_origin,
  365|                 ray_direction,
  366|                 chunk,
  367|                 refinement_interval
  368|             );
  369|         }
  370| 
  371|         let exit = next_leaf_exit(
  372|             ray_origin,
  373|             ray_direction,
  374|             leaf.bounds_min,
  375|             leaf.bounds_max
  376|         );
  377|         var next_distance = exit.x;
  378|         if next_distance <= distance + bias * 0.25 {
  379|             next_distance = distance + bias;
  380|         }
  381|         // A normalized ray travels at most one finest voxel per axis over
  382|         // this retained interval, which is enough for DDA to reconstruct all
  383|         // potentially competing boundary crossings.
  384|         refinement_entry = max(distance, next_distance - voxel_size);
  385|         refinement_entry_normal = normal;
  386|         distance = next_distance;
  387|         normal = exit.yzw;
  388|     }
  389|     return VoxelHit(false, 0.0, vec3<f32>(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u, 0.0);
  390| }
  391| 
  392| fn trace_chunk(
  393|     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
  394|     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
  395|     chunk: RayChunk,
  396|     interval: BoxHit,
  397| ) -> VoxelHit {
  398|     if ray_policy_enabled(RAY_POLICY_EMPTY_SPACE_SKIP) {
  399|         return trace_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
  400|             ray_origin,
  401|             ray_direction,
  402|             chunk,
  403|             interval
  404|         );
  405|     }
  406|     return trace_chunk_dda(ray_origin, ray_direction, chunk, interval);
  407| }
  408| 
  409| fn direct_visibility_bias(voxel_size: f32) -> f32 {
  410|     return max(voxel_size * 1e-3, 1e-5);
  411| }
  412| 
  413| // Secondary visibility has its own hard budget. It deliberately does not
  414| // consult the primary-ray trace budget or empty-space policy toggle.
  415| fn trace_visibility_chunk_dda(
  416|     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
  417|     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
  418|     chunk: RayChunk,
  419|     interval: BoxHit,
  420|     step_budget: u32,
  421| ) -> VisibilityTrace {
  422|     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
  423|     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
  424|     var distance = interval.entry;
  425|     var sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
  426|     var cell = floor(sample / voxel_size);
  427|     let direction_step = sign(ray_direction);
  428|     var steps = 0u;
  429| 
  430|     for (var iteration = 0u; iteration < DIRECT_VISIBILITY_TRACE_BUDGET; iteration += 1u) {
  431|         if distance > interval.exit {
  432|             return VisibilityTrace(false, steps);
  433|         }
  434|         if steps >= step_budget {
  435|             // Exhaustion is conservatively opaque, avoiding a light leak.
  436|             return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
  437|         }
  438|         steps += 1u;
  439|         sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
  440|         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
  441|         if leaf.material != 0u {
  442|             return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
  443|         }
  444| 
  445|         let next_boundary = (cell + max(direction_step, vec3<f32>(0.0))) * voxel_size;
  446|         var next_times = vec3<f32>(TRACE_INFINITY);
  447|         if abs(ray_direction.x) >= 1e-20 { next_times.x = (next_boundary.x - ray_origin.x) / ray_direction.x; }
  448|         if abs(ray_direction.y) >= 1e-20 { next_times.y = (next_boundary.y - ray_origin.y) / ray_direction.y; }
  449|         if abs(ray_direction.z) >= 1e-20 { next_times.z = (next_boundary.z - ray_origin.z) / ray_direction.z; }
  450|         let next_distance = min(next_times.x, min(next_times.y, next_times.z));
  451|         if next_distance > interval.exit {
  452|             return VisibilityTrace(false, steps);
  453|         }
  454|         let tolerance = distance_tie_tolerance(next_distance);
  455|         let cross_x = abs(next_times.x - next_distance) <= tolerance;
  456|         let cross_y = abs(next_times.y - next_distance) <= tolerance;
  457|         let cross_z = abs(next_times.z - next_distance) <= tolerance;
  458|         if cross_x { cell.x += direction_step.x; }
  459|         if cross_y { cell.y += direction_step.y; }
  460|         if cross_z { cell.z += direction_step.z; }
  461|         distance = next_distance;
  462|     }
  463|     return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
  464| }
  465| 
  466| // Coarse leaves prove only that an interval is empty. A non-empty leaf is
  467| // resolved by the same finest-cell DDA contract as primary traversal, while
  468| // both phases share one caller-supplied secondary-ray budget.
  469| fn trace_visibility_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
  470|     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
  471|     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
  472|     chunk: RayChunk,
  473|     interval: BoxHit,
  474|     step_budget: u32,
  475| ) -> VisibilityTrace {
  476|     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
  477|     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
  478|     var distance = interval.entry;
  479|     var normal = interval.normal;
  480|     var refinement_entry = interval.entry;
  481|     var refinement_entry_normal = interval.normal;
  482|     var steps = 0u;
  483| 
  484|     for (var iteration = 0u; iteration < DIRECT_VISIBILITY_TRACE_BUDGET; iteration += 1u) {
  485|         if distance > interval.exit {
  486|             return VisibilityTrace(false, steps);
  487|         }
  488|         if steps >= step_budget {
  489|             return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
  490|         }
  491|         steps += 1u;
  492|         let sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
  493|         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
  494|         if leaf.material != 0u {
  495|             let refinement_interval = BoxHit(
  496|                 true,
  497|                 refinement_entry,
  498|                 interval.exit,
  499|                 refinement_entry_normal
  500|             );
  501|             let refined = trace_visibility_chunk_dda(
  502|                 ray_origin,
  503|                 ray_direction,
  504|                 chunk,
  505|                 refinement_interval,
  506|                 step_budget - steps
  507|             );
  508|             return VisibilityTrace(refined.blocked, steps + refined.steps);
  509|         }
  510| 
  511|         let exit = next_leaf_exit(
  512|             ray_origin,
  513|             ray_direction,
  514|             leaf.bounds_min,
  515|             leaf.bounds_max
  516|         );
  517|         var next_distance = exit.x;
  518|         if next_distance <= distance + bias * 0.25 {
  519|             next_distance = distance + bias;
  520|         }
  521|         refinement_entry = max(distance, next_distance - voxel_size);
  522|         refinement_entry_normal = normal;
  523|         distance = next_distance;
  524|         normal = exit.yzw;
  525|     }
  526|     return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
  527| }
  528| 
  529| fn finite_segment_visible(
  530|     receiver_world: vec3<f32>,
  531|     receiver_normal: vec3<f32>,
  532|     receiver_voxel_size: f32,
  533|     endpoint_world: vec3<f32>,
  534| ) -> bool {
  535|     let endpoint_bias = direct_visibility_bias(receiver_voxel_size);
  536|     let biased_origin = receiver_world + receiver_normal * endpoint_bias;
  537|     let segment = endpoint_world - biased_origin;
  538|     let endpoint_distance = length(segment);
  539|     if endpoint_distance <= endpoint_bias * 2.0 {
  540|         return true;
  541|     }
  542|     let ray_direction = segment / endpoint_distance;
  543|     // Do not classify the light fixture's own endpoint as an occluder.
  544|     let maximum_distance = endpoint_distance - endpoint_bias;
  545|     var remaining_steps = DIRECT_VISIBILITY_TRACE_BUDGET;
  546|     let chunk_count = min(ray_scene.chunk_count, 25u);
  547| 
  548|     for (var index = 0u; index < chunk_count; index += 1u) {
  549|         if remaining_steps == 0u {
  550|             return false;
  551|         }
  552|         let chunk = ray_chunks[index];
  553|         let local_origin = biased_origin - chunk.origin_world_size.xyz;
  554|         let slab = box_intersection(
  555|             local_origin,
  556|             ray_direction,
  557|             vec3<f32>(0.0),
  558|             vec3<f32>(chunk.origin_world_size.w)
  559|         );
  560|         let finite_exit = min(slab.exit, maximum_distance);
  561|         if !slab.hit || finite_exit <= slab.entry {
  562|             continue;
  563|         }
  564|         let interval = BoxHit(true, slab.entry, finite_exit, slab.normal);
  565|         let trace = trace_visibility_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
  566|             local_origin,
  567|             ray_direction,
  568|             chunk,
  569|             interval,
  570|             remaining_steps
  571|         );
  572|         remaining_steps -= min(trace.steps, remaining_steps);
  573|         if trace.blocked {
  574|             return false;
  575|         }
  576|     }
  577|     return true;
  578| }
  579| 
  580| fn has_positive_rgb(value: vec3<f32>) -> bool {
  581|     return max(value.x, max(value.y, value.z)) > 0.0;
  582| }
  583| 
  584| fn rectangle_visibility_sample_count() -> u32 {
  585|     return select(1u, 4u, ray_scene._reserved.x == 4u);
  586| }
  587| 
  588| fn evaluate_visible_scene_light(
  589|     world: vec3<f32>,
  590|     normal: vec3<f32>,
  591|     receiver_voxel_size: f32,
  592|     light: GpuLight,
  593| ) -> vec3<f32> {
  594|     let kind = u32(max(light.half_size_kind.z, 0.0) + 0.5);
  595|     if kind == LIGHT_POINT {
  596|         let endpoint = light.position_radius.xyz;
  597|         let unoccluded = point_light_sample_irradiance(world, normal, light, endpoint);
  598|         if !has_positive_rgb(unoccluded) {
  599|             return vec3<f32>(0.0);
  600|         }
  601|         if finite_segment_visible(world, normal, receiver_voxel_size, endpoint) {
  602|             return unoccluded;
  603|         }
  604|         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
  605|     }
  606| 
  607|     if rectangle_visibility_sample_count() == 4u {
  608|         var visible_integral = 0.0;
  609|         for (var sample_index = 0u; sample_index < 4u; sample_index += 1u) {
  610|             let endpoint = rectangle_gauss_sample_position(light, sample_index);
  611|             let sample_weight = rectangle_light_sample_weight(
  612|                 world,
  613|                 normal,
  614|                 light,
  615|                 kind,
  616|                 endpoint
  617|             );
  618|             let sample_irradiance = rectangle_light_irradiance_from_integral(
  619|                 light,
  620|                 sample_weight
  621|             );
  622|             if !has_positive_rgb(sample_irradiance) {
  623|                 continue;
  624|             }
  625|             if finite_segment_visible(world, normal, receiver_voxel_size, endpoint) {
  626|                 visible_integral += sample_weight;
  627|             }
  628|         }
  629|         return rectangle_light_irradiance_from_integral(light, visible_integral);
  630|     }
  631| 
  632|     // Low quality retains the existing four-point unoccluded quadrature and
  633|     // gates its integral with one finite segment to the rectangle center.
  634|     let unoccluded = evaluate_rectangle_light(world, normal, light, kind);
  635|     if !has_positive_rgb(unoccluded) {
  636|         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
  637|     }
  638|     if finite_segment_visible(
  639|         world,
  640|         normal,
  641|         receiver_voxel_size,
  642|         light.position_radius.xyz
  643|     ) {
  644|         return unoccluded;
  645|     }
  646|     return vec3<f32>(0.0);
  647| }
  648| 
  649| fn raymarch_analytic_direct(
  650|     world: vec3<f32>,
  651|     normal: vec3<f32>,
  652|     receiver_voxel_size: f32,
  653| ) -> vec3<f32> {
  654|     var analytic_direct = vec3<f32>(0.0);
  655|     for (var index = 0u; index < frame.render_options.x; index += 1u) {
  656|         let light = lights[index];
  657|         if light.half_size_kind.w < 0.5 {
  658|             continue;
  659|         }
  660|         analytic_direct += evaluate_visible_scene_light(
  661|             world,
  662|             normal,
  663|             receiver_voxel_size,
  664|             light
  665|         );
  666|     }
  667|     return analytic_direct;
  668| }
  669| 
  670| fn camera_ray(pixel: vec2<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
  671|     let viewport = max(frame.viewport_fov_start.xy, vec2<f32>(1.0));
  672|     let normalized = pixel / viewport;
  673|     let aspect = viewport.x / viewport.y;
  674|     let screen = vec2<f32>(
  675|         (normalized.x * 2.0 - 1.0) * aspect,
  676|         1.0 - normalized.y * 2.0
  677|     ) * frame.viewport_fov_start.z;
  678|     return normalize(
  679|         frame.camera_forward.xyz
  680|         + frame.camera_right.xyz * screen.x
  681|         + frame.camera_up.xyz * screen.y
  682|     );
  683| }
  684| 
  685| @fragment
  686| fn raymarch_fragment(@builtin(position) pixel: vec4<f32>) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
  687|     let direction = camera_ray(pixel.xy);
  688|     var nearest = VoxelHit(false, 1e30, vec3<f32>(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u, 0.0);
  689|     var nearest_source_index = 0xffffffffu;
  690|     let chunk_count = min(ray_scene.chunk_count, 25u);
  691|     for (var index = 0u; index < chunk_count; index += 1u) {
  692|         let chunk = ray_chunks[index];
  693|         let local_origin = frame.camera_position.xyz - chunk.origin_world_size.xyz;
  694|         let interval = box_intersection(
  695|             local_origin,
  696|             direction,
  697|             vec3<f32>(0.0),
  698|             vec3<f32>(chunk.origin_world_size.w)
  699|         );
  700|         if !interval.hit || interval.entry > nearest.distance { continue; }
  701|         // Never search past the closest candidate already found: a hit in
  702|         // this chunk beyond nearest.distance could not win the comparison
  703|         // below regardless, so there is nothing to gain by tracing that far.
  704|         // Mirrors finite_segment_visible's shadow-ray clip to a light's own
  705|         // distance (line ~490) — same reasoning, applied to primary rays.
  706|         let clipped_interval = BoxHit(
  707|             interval.hit,
  708|             interval.entry,
  709|             min(interval.exit, nearest.distance),
  710|             interval.normal
  711|         );
  712|         let hit = trace_chunk(local_origin, direction, chunk, clipped_interval);
  713|         let stable_tie = hit.distance == nearest.distance
  714|             && chunk.indices.y < nearest_source_index;
  715|         if hit.hit && (hit.distance < nearest.distance || stable_tie) {
  716|             nearest = hit;
  717|             nearest_source_index = chunk.indices.y;
  718|         }
  719|     }
  720| 
  721|     if !nearest.hit {
  722|         return vec4<f32>(display_color(frame.sky_color_ambient.xyz), 1.0);
  723|     }
  724|     let world = frame.camera_position.xyz + direction * nearest.distance;
  725|     let albedo = apply_material_pattern(
  726|         nearest.material,
  727|         packed_srgb_to_linear(nearest.color),
  728|         world,
  729|         nearest.normal,
  730|         nearest.voxel_size
  731|     );
  732|     let emission = authored_emission_strength(nearest.material);
  733|     let emits = emission > 0.0 && nearest.normal.y < -0.5;
  734|     var radiance = vec3<f32>(0.0);
  735|     if emits {
  736|         radiance = albedo * emission;
  737|     } else if ray_policy_enabled(RAY_POLICY_DIRECT_LIGHT_VISIBILITY) {
  738|         let analytic_direct = raymarch_analytic_direct(
  739|             world,
  740|             nearest.normal,
  741|             nearest.voxel_size
  742|         );
  743|         radiance = surface_radiance_from_analytic_direct(
  744|             world,
  745|             nearest.normal,
  746|             albedo,
  747|             0.0,
  748|             1.0,
  749|             analytic_direct
  750|         );
  751|     } else {
  752|         radiance = surface_radiance(
  753|             world,
  754|             nearest.normal,
  755|             albedo,
  756|             0.0,
  757|             1.0,
  758|             0u,
  759|             frame.render_options.x
  760|         );
  761|     }
  762|     return present_radiance(radiance, world, pixel.xy);
  763| }

Key WebGPU raymarch shader analysis:

1. `raymarch_analytic_direct` (lines 649-668): loops over `frame.render_options.x` = lights.len() — the full frame light count (all lights in the frame, from `collect_frame_lights`). For each light, `evaluate_visible_scene_light` → if direct visibility enabled (shadow_pass + profile) → `finite_segment_visible` → loop over up to 25 chunks, each with `trace_visibility_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves` up to 4096 steps each but with a global remaining budget of 4096 (DIRECT_VISIBILITY_TRACE_BUDGET). So per light per pixel: up to 4096 steps × per chunk loop. With L lights: worst case L × 4096 × (chunk count) steps per pixel — that's enormous: 60 lights × 4096 = 245k iterations per pixel. Actually the remaining_steps budget is per `finite_segment_visible` call, not per pixel: each light gets a fresh 4096 budget. So worst-case per pixel: L × 4096 lookup_leaf calls (each up to 11 atlas fetches). That's the worst algorithmic hotspot: O(P × L × B) with B = 4096, L = number of lights. There's an early-out: `if !has_positive_rgb(unoccluded) continue;` before the visibility trace — so only lights that actually contribute get traced. Still, in a lit corridor with dozens of lights this is the dominant cost.

Note also that light count is `frame.render_options.x` — the FULL frame light list (all resident lights, not just receiver chunk lights). In the GLSL version, shading loops only over the receiver chunk's light range (uChunkLightFirst/Counts); in the WGSL version it loops over ALL frame lights (no per-chunk light ranges). That's an important difference: the WGSL raymarcher loops over every light in the frame at each hit pixel, whereas the GLSL one loops only over the receiver chunk's clustered lights. So this is O(P·L) shading per pixel where L = total scene lights — significant. `frame.render_options.x` is `lights.len()` set in GpuFrameUniforms::from_frame. Let me confirm in gpu_types.rs.

2. `surface_radiance` (else branch, no direct visibility): loops over lights too (render_options.x).

3. Primary loop: `chunk_count` up to 25, each `trace_chunk` up to 4096 steps (budget from `frame.render_options.w` = maximum_trace_steps). With front-to-back and clipping to nearest distance. Worst case O(25 × 4096).

So overall per pixel worst case: primary O(C·S) + shading O(L·(C·B)) — the shading is the killer. GPU parallelization is inherent (fragment shader), so the "hot loop" concern is about per-fragment work.

Also `lookup_leaf` does an 11-level dependent fetch chain per step with no caching — each step re-walks from root (stateless, documented tradeoff). For DDA with 4096 steps... 4096 × 11 = 45k dependent storage loads per ray. That's the empty-space-skip mitigation; fine.

Now gpu_types.rs, config.rs, camera_state.rs, and remaining WGSL shaders + pipelines. Let me read gpu_types and the remaining WGSL shaders quickly.

   22| /// The high byte of a packed material visual stores authored emission over
   23| /// the current domain range of `0..=10`. The low 24 bits remain the canonical
   24| /// `0xRRGGBB` palette entry, so raster shaders never maintain a second palette.
   25| const PACKED_EMISSION_UNITS_PER_RADIANCE: f32 = u8::MAX as f32 / 10.0;
   26| 
   27| fn pack_material_visual(material: u8) -> u32 {
   28|     let color = material_visual(material).color & 0x00ff_ffff;
   29|     let emission = material_emission_strength(material).unwrap_or_default();
   30|     let quantized_emission = (emission * PACKED_EMISSION_UNITS_PER_RADIANCE)
   31|         .round()
   32|         .clamp(0.0, f32::from(u8::MAX)) as u32;
   33|     color | (quantized_emission << 24)
   34| }

  282| pub struct GpuRayScene {
  283|     pub chunk_count: u32,
  284|     /// Bit 0: empty-leaf skip; bit 1: CPU front-to-back selection;
  285|     /// bit 2: direct-light visibility rays.
  286|     pub policy_flags: u32,
  287|     /// x: validated rectangle-light visibility sample count (1 or 4);
  288|     /// y: reserved.
  289|     pub reserved: [u32; 2],
  290| }
  291| 
  292| pub const RAY_POLICY_EMPTY_SPACE_SKIP: u32 = 1 << 0;
  293| pub const RAY_POLICY_FRONT_TO_BACK: u32 = 1 << 1;
  294| pub const RAY_POLICY_DIRECT_LIGHT_VISIBILITY: u32 = 1 << 2;
  295| 
  296| impl GpuRayScene {
  297|     pub const fn from_policy(
  298|         chunk_count: u32,
  299|         empty_space_skip: bool,
  300|         front_to_back: bool,
  301|         direct_light_visibility: bool,
  302|         area_light_visibility_samples: u8,
  303|     ) -> Self {
  304|         let mut policy_flags = 0;
  305|         if empty_space_skip {
  306|             policy_flags |= RAY_POLICY_EMPTY_SPACE_SKIP;
  307|         }
  308|         if front_to_back {
  309|             policy_flags |= RAY_POLICY_FRONT_TO_BACK;
  310|         }
  311|         if direct_light_visibility {
  312|             policy_flags |= RAY_POLICY_DIRECT_LIGHT_VISIBILITY;
  313|         }
  314|         Self {
  315|             chunk_count,
  316|             policy_flags,
  317|             reserved: [
  318|                 validated_area_light_visibility_samples(area_light_visibility_samples),
  319|                 0,

Confirmed: `render_options.x = light_count` — the full frame light count (all enabled scene lights + dynamic). So `raymarch_analytic_direct` and `surface_radiance` loop over ALL lights per hit pixel, and each visibility check can cost up to 4096 steps × 25 chunks. This is the top algorithmic finding for the WebGPU path.

Also interesting: `collect_frame_lights` filters `light.enabled` and includes dynamic. The engine's `active_scene_lights()` — need to see size. Let me check ports.rs to see active_scene_lights and how many lights a frame has. That's application, not in scope, but I need to characterize L. Let me grep.

Also the remaining pipelines (surface, splat, surfel, raster_shadow, supply_labels, cpu_present, visibility) and WGSL files. Let me read the remaining WGSL shaders and pipelines quickly.

   31| fn normal_for_axis(axis: u32) -> vec3<f32> {

   42| fn srgb_channel_to_linear(encoded: f32) -> f32 {
   43|     if encoded <= 0.04045 {
   44|         return encoded / 12.92;
   45|     }
   46|     return pow((encoded + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
   47| }

   49| fn packed_srgb_to_linear(packed: u32) -> vec3<f32> {

   62| fn hash_screen(pixel: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
   63|     return fract(sin(dot(pixel, vec2<f32>(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);
   64| }

   66| fn material_hash(cell: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
   67|     return fract(sin(dot(cell, vec2<f32>(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);
   68| }
   69| 
   70| fn material_noise(point: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
   71|     let cell = floor(point);
   72|     let f = fract(point);
   73|     let u = f * f * (vec2<f32>(3.0) - 2.0 * f);
   74|     let a = material_hash(cell);
   75|     let b = material_hash(cell + vec2<f32>(1.0, 0.0));
   76|     let c = material_hash(cell + vec2<f32>(0.0, 1.0));
   77|     let d = material_hash(cell + vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0));
   78|     return mix(mix(a, b, u.x), mix(c, d, u.x), u.y);
   79| }
   80| 
   81| // Two octaves of value noise. Enough for damp blotches and grime drift
   82| // without paying for a full fbm in the inner shading loop.
   83| fn material_noise_2(point: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
   84|     return material_noise(point) * 0.65 + material_noise(point * 2.17 + 19.3) * 0.35;
   85| }
   86| 
   87| // Lay-in acoustic tile: 0.61 m (2 ft) module on a visible T-bar grid.
   88| const CEILING_TILE_MODULE: f32 = 0.61;
   89| 
   90| fn apply_material_pattern(
   91|     material: u32,
   92|     albedo: vec3<f32>,
   93|     world: vec3<f32>,
   94|     normal: vec3<f32>,
   95|     sample_footprint: f32,
   96| ) -> vec3<f32> {
   97|     // Distance fade: high-frequency detail is dropped as the sample footprint
   98|     // grows so far surfaces stay stable instead of aliasing into noise.
   99|     let detail = clamp(1.15 - sample_footprint * 0.32, 0.20, 1.0);
  100| 
  101|     let carpet = material == 2u || material == 12u || material == 13u
  102|         || material == 14u || material == 25u;
  103|     if carpet && normal.y > 0.5 {
  104|         // Frequencies are in cycles per world unit and a room is only ~10 u
  105|         // across, so anything below ~0.2 spans less than one noise cell over
  106|         // the whole visible floor and reads as flat.
  107|         let broad = material_noise(world.xz * 0.45);
  108|         let fibers = material_noise(world.xz * 2.2);
  109|         // Damp patches: mid-frequency blotches that darken and desaturate,
  110|         // the single most recognizable Level 0 floor cue.
  111|         let damp = smoothstep(0.48, 0.78, material_noise_2(world.xz * 0.30));
  112|         // Traffic lanes rubbed pale along the corridor run.
  113|         let lane = smoothstep(0.55, 0.85, material_noise(world.xz * vec2<f32>(0.16, 0.55)));
  114|         let wear = 0.80 + 0.28 * broad + (fibers - 0.5) * 0.17 * detail + lane * 0.09;
  115|         let damped = albedo * wear * mix(1.0, 0.62, damp * 0.85);
  116|         return mix(damped, vec3<f32>(dot(damped, vec3<f32>(0.33))), damp * 0.30);
  117|     }
  118| 
  119|     let ceiling = material == 3u;
  120|     if ceiling && normal.y < -0.5 {
  121|         let tile = world.xz / CEILING_TILE_MODULE;
  122|         let cell = floor(tile);
  123|         let within = abs(fract(tile) - 0.5);
  124|         // T-bar grid: thin darker seam framing every tile.
  125|         let seam = max(
  126|             smoothstep(0.40, 0.485, within.x),
  127|             smoothstep(0.40, 0.485, within.y)
  128|         );
  129|         // Each tile ages on its own: pinholes, yellowing, replacement panels.
  130|         let tile_age = material_hash(cell);
  131|         let panel = 0.90 + tile_age * 0.16;
  132|         // Water damage bleeding through a minority of tiles.
  133|         let stain_field = material_noise_2(world.xz * 0.09);
  134|         let stain = smoothstep(0.58, 0.88, stain_field) * step(0.45, tile_age);
  135|         let speckle = (material_noise(world.xz * 9.0) - 0.5) * 0.05 * detail;
  136|         let value = (panel + speckle) * mix(1.0, 0.48, seam * 0.75 * detail);
  137|         let stained = mix(albedo, vec3<f32>(0.46, 0.36, 0.20), stain * 0.55);
  138|         return stained * value;
  139|     }
  140| 
  141|     let wallpaper = material == 1u || material == 24u;
  142|     if wallpaper && abs(normal.y) < 0.5 {
  143|         let along = select(world.x, world.z, abs(normal.x) > 0.5);
  144|         let repeat = fract(along / 1.35);
  145|         let center = abs(repeat - 0.5);
  146|         let stem = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.035, 0.085, center);
  147|         let vine = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(world.y * 3.1 + sin(along * 2.4) * 0.8);
  148|         let medallion = pow(max(cos((repeat - 0.5) * 6.2831853), 0.0), 6.0)
  149|             * pow(max(cos((world.y - 0.35) * 3.1415926), 0.0), 4.0);
  150|         let age = select(0.0, 1.0, material == 24u);
  151|         let stain = material_noise(vec2<f32>(along * 0.09, world.y * 0.16));
  152|         let motif = stem * (0.45 + 0.55 * vine) + medallion * 0.55;
  153|         var factor = 1.05 - motif * (0.28 + age * 0.10) - age * stain * 0.16;
  154| 
  155|         // Butt seams every 0.53 m (21 in) where wallpaper strips meet.
  156|         let seam = smoothstep(0.955, 0.995, abs(sin(along * PI / 0.53)));
  157|         factor = factor * mix(1.0, 0.90, seam * detail);
  158| 
  159|         // Rising damp: grime creeping up from the floor, strongest at the base.
  160|         let rise = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.75, world.y);
  161|         let grime = material_noise_2(vec2<f32>(along * 0.22, world.y * 0.5));
  162|         factor = factor * mix(1.0, 0.74, rise * grime * 0.9);
  163| 
  164|         // Scuffing along the baseboard contact line.
  165|         let scuff = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.16, world.y)) * grime;
  166|         let tinted = mix(albedo, vec3<f32>(0.30, 0.26, 0.16), scuff * 0.45);
  167|         return tinted * factor;
  168|     }
  169|     return albedo;
  170| }
  171| 
  172| const PI: f32 = 3.14159265358979323846;
  173| const LIGHT_POINT: u32 = 0u;
  174| const MINIMUM_SCENE_LIGHT_DISTANCE: f32 = 0.2;
  175| const INDOOR_AMBIENT_IRRADIANCE: vec3<f32> = vec3<f32>(0.045, 0.040, 0.024);
  176| const OUTDOOR_AMBIENT_IRRADIANCE: vec3<f32> = vec3<f32>(0.32, 0.38, 0.48);
  177| const CACHED_DIFFUSE_FILL_GAIN: f32 = 0.12;
  178| 
  179| // Mirrors application::rendering::FLASHLIGHT_SPEC; a Rust source-contract
  180| // test prevents either side from changing independently.
  181| const FLASHLIGHT_INNER_COSINE: f32 = 0.981627166;
  182| const FLASHLIGHT_OUTER_COSINE: f32 = 0.913545430;
  183| const FLASHLIGHT_RANGE: f32 = 14.0;
  184| const FLASHLIGHT_INTENSITY: f32 = 32.0;
  185| const FLASHLIGHT_MINIMUM_DISTANCE: f32 = 0.25;
  186| const FLASHLIGHT_FORWARD_OFFSET: f32 = 0.18;
  187| const FLASHLIGHT_DOWNWARD_OFFSET: f32 = 0.10;
  188| const FLASHLIGHT_TINT: vec3<f32> = vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.91, 0.72);
  189| 
  190| fn flashlight_irradiance(world: vec3<f32>, normal: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
  191|     if frame.render_options.y == 0u {
  192|         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
  193|     }
  194|     let lamp_position = frame.camera_position.xyz
  195|         + frame.camera_forward.xyz * FLASHLIGHT_FORWARD_OFFSET
  196|         - vec3<f32>(0.0, FLASHLIGHT_DOWNWARD_OFFSET, 0.0);
  197|     let lamp_to_receiver = world - lamp_position;
  198|     let distance_squared = dot(lamp_to_receiver, lamp_to_receiver);
  199|     if distance_squared <= 1e-8 {
  200|         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
  201|     }
  202|     let direction = lamp_to_receiver / sqrt(distance_squared);
  203|     let cone = smoothstep(
  204|         FLASHLIGHT_OUTER_COSINE,
  205|         FLASHLIGHT_INNER_COSINE,
  206|         dot(direction, frame.camera_forward.xyz)
  207|     );
  208|     let receiver = receiver_cosine(normal, -direction);
  209|     let attenuation = finite_range_inverse_square(
  210|         distance_squared,
  211|         FLASHLIGHT_RANGE,
  212|         FLASHLIGHT_MINIMUM_DISTANCE
  213|     );
  214|     return FLASHLIGHT_TINT * FLASHLIGHT_INTENSITY * cone * receiver * attenuation;
  215| }
  216| 
  217| fn finite_range_inverse_square(
  218|     distance_squared: f32,
  219|     range: f32,
  220|     minimum_distance: f32,
  221| ) -> f32 {
  222|     if range <= 0.0 || minimum_distance <= 0.0 || distance_squared < 0.0 {
  223|         return 0.0;
  224|     }
  225|     let range_squared = range * range;
  226|     let normalized_squared = distance_squared / range_squared;
  227|     let window = max(1.0 - normalized_squared * normalized_squared, 0.0);
  228|     return (window * window)
  229|         / max(distance_squared, minimum_distance * minimum_distance);
  230| }
  231| 
  232| fn receiver_cosine(normal: vec3<f32>, surface_to_light: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
  233|     return max(dot(normal, surface_to_light), 0.0);
  234| }
  235| 
  236| fn emitter_cosine(kind: u32, surface_to_light: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
  237|     if kind == LIGHT_POINT {
  238|         return 1.0;
  239|     }
  240|     // Rectangle fixtures lie in XZ and point down. A receiver below the
  241|     // fixture has a positive receiver-to-emitter Y direction.
  242|     return max(surface_to_light.y, 0.0);
  243| }
  244| 
  245| /// Radiance contribution of one point-like endpoint before visibility.
  246| /// Ray visibility can multiply this result by an exact finite-segment test
  247| /// without reimplementing attenuation or receiver geometry.
  248| fn point_light_sample_irradiance(
  249|     world: vec3<f32>,
  250|     normal: vec3<f32>,
  251|     light: GpuLight,
  252|     sample_position: vec3<f32>,
  253| ) -> vec3<f32> {
  254|     let delta = sample_position - world;
  255|     let distance_squared = dot(delta, delta);
  256|     let surface_to_light = delta / sqrt(max(distance_squared, 1e-8));
  257|     let geometry = receiver_cosine(normal, surface_to_light);
  258|     return max(light.color_intensity.xyz, vec3<f32>(0.0))
  259|         * max(light.color_intensity.w, 0.0)
  260|         * finite_range_inverse_square(
  261|             distance_squared,
  262|             light.position_radius.w,
  263|             MINIMUM_SCENE_LIGHT_DISTANCE
  264|         )
  265|         * geometry;
  266| }
  267| 
  268| fn evaluate_point_light(
  269|     world: vec3<f32>,
  270|     normal: vec3<f32>,
  271|     light: GpuLight,
  272| ) -> vec3<f32> {
  273|     return point_light_sample_irradiance(
  274|         world,
  275|         normal,
  276|         light,
  277|         light.position_radius.xyz
  278|     );
  279| }

  281| /// Position of one deterministic 2x2 Gauss endpoint on an XZ emitter.
  282| fn rectangle_gauss_sample_position(light: GpuLight, sample_index: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
  283|     let gauss = 0.5773502691896258;
  284|     let offsets = array<vec2<f32>, 4>(
  285|         vec2<f32>(-gauss, -gauss),
  286|         vec2<f32>( gauss, -gauss),
  287|         vec2<f32>(-gauss,  gauss),
  288|         vec2<f32>( gauss,  gauss)
  289|     );
  290|     let offset = offsets[min(sample_index, 3u)]
  291|         * max(light.half_size_kind.xy, vec2<f32>(0.0));
  292|     return light.position_radius.xyz + vec3<f32>(offset.x, 0.0, offset.y);
  293| }
  294| 
  295| /// Scalar geometry/attenuation term for one rectangle quadrature endpoint.
  296| fn rectangle_light_sample_weight(
  297|     world: vec3<f32>,
  298|     normal: vec3<f32>,
  299|     light: GpuLight,
  300|     kind: u32,
  301|     sample_position: vec3<f32>,
  302| ) -> f32 {
  303|     let delta = sample_position - world;
  304|     let distance_squared = dot(delta, delta);
  305|     let surface_to_light = delta / sqrt(max(distance_squared, 1e-8));
  306|     return finite_range_inverse_square(
  307|         distance_squared,
  308|         light.position_radius.w,
  309|         MINIMUM_SCENE_LIGHT_DISTANCE
  310|     )
  311|         * receiver_cosine(normal, surface_to_light)
  312|         * emitter_cosine(kind, surface_to_light);
  313| }
  314| 
  315| /// Converts a (possibly visibility-weighted) quadrature integral into RGB.
  316| fn rectangle_light_irradiance_from_integral(
  317|     light: GpuLight,
  318|     integral: f32,
  319| ) -> vec3<f32> {
  320|     let half_size = max(light.half_size_kind.xy, vec2<f32>(0.0));
  321|     let area = 4.0 * half_size.x * half_size.y;
  322|     if area <= 0.0 {
  323|         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
  324|     }
  325|     return max(light.color_intensity.xyz, vec3<f32>(0.0))
  326|         * max(light.color_intensity.w, 0.0)
  327|         * area
  328|         * integral
  329|         * 0.25;
  330| }
  331| 
  332| fn evaluate_rectangle_light(
  333|     world: vec3<f32>,
  334|     normal: vec3<f32>,
  335|     light: GpuLight,
  336|     kind: u32,
  337| ) -> vec3<f32> {
  338|     let half_size = max(light.half_size_kind.xy, vec2<f32>(0.0));
  339|     let area = 4.0 * half_size.x * half_size.y;
  340|     if area <= 0.0 {
  341|         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
  342|     }
  343| 
  344|     var integral = 0.0;
  345|     for (var sample_index = 0u; sample_index < 4u; sample_index += 1u) {
  346|         let sample_position = rectangle_gauss_sample_position(light, sample_index);
  347|         integral += rectangle_light_sample_weight(
  348|             world,
  349|             normal,
  350|             light,
  351|             kind,
  352|             sample_position
  353|         );
  354|     }
  355|     return rectangle_light_irradiance_from_integral(light, integral);
  356| }
  357| 
  358| fn evaluate_scene_light(
  359|     world: vec3<f32>,
  360|     normal: vec3<f32>,
  361|     light: GpuLight,
  362| ) -> vec3<f32> {
  363|     let kind = u32(max(light.half_size_kind.z, 0.0) + 0.5);
  364|     if kind == LIGHT_POINT {
  365|         return evaluate_point_light(world, normal, light);
  366|     }
  367|     return evaluate_rectangle_light(world, normal, light, kind);
  368| }

  370| fn ambient_irradiance() -> vec3<f32> {
  371|     let base = select(
  372|         INDOOR_AMBIENT_IRRADIANCE,
  373|         OUTDOOR_AMBIENT_IRRADIANCE,
  374|         frame.lighting_options.x != 0u
  375|     );
  376|     return base * max(frame.sky_color_ambient.w, 0.0);
  377| }
  378| 
  379| fn cached_static_irradiance(baked: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
  380|     if frame.lighting_options.y == 0u {
  381|         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
  382|     }
  383|     return vec3<f32>(clamp(baked, 0.0, 1.0) * CACHED_DIFFUSE_FILL_GAIN);
  384| }
  385| 
  386| fn surface_radiance_from_analytic_direct(
  387|     world: vec3<f32>,
  388|     normal: vec3<f32>,
  389|     albedo: vec3<f32>,
  390|     baked: f32,
  391|     ao: f32,
  392|     analytic_direct: vec3<f32>,
  393| ) -> vec3<f32> {
  394|     let ambient_visibility = mix(0.62, 1.0, clamp(ao, 0.0, 1.0));
  395|     let ambient = ambient_irradiance() * ambient_visibility;
  396|     let cached_static = cached_static_irradiance(baked);
  397|     let flashlight = flashlight_irradiance(world, normal);
  398|     let irradiance = ambient + cached_static + analytic_direct + flashlight;
  399|     return albedo * irradiance * (1.0 / PI);
  400| }
  401| 
  402| fn surface_radiance(
  403|     world: vec3<f32>,
  404|     normal: vec3<f32>,
  405|     albedo: vec3<f32>,
  406|     baked: f32,
  407|     ao: f32,
  408|     light_first: u32,
  409|     light_count: u32,
  410| ) -> vec3<f32> {
  411|     var analytic_direct = vec3<f32>(0.0);
  412|     let safe_count = min(light_count, frame.render_options.x - min(light_first, frame.render_options.x));
  413|     for (var local = 0u; local < safe_count; local += 1u) {
  414|         let light = lights[light_first + local];
  415|         if light.half_size_kind.w < 0.5 {
  416|             continue;
  417|         }
  418|         analytic_direct += evaluate_scene_light(world, normal, light);
  419|     }
  420|     return surface_radiance_from_analytic_direct(
  421|         world,
  422|         normal,
  423|         albedo,
  424|         baked,
  425|         ao,
  426|         analytic_direct
  427|     );
  428| }
  429| 
  430| fn display_color(linear_radiance: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
  431|     let mapped = max(linear_radiance, vec3<f32>(0.0))
  432|         / (vec3<f32>(1.0) + max(linear_radiance, vec3<f32>(0.0)));
  433|     let low = mapped * 12.92;
  434|     let high = 1.055 * pow(mapped, vec3<f32>(1.0 / 2.4)) - vec3<f32>(0.055);
  435|     return select(high, low, mapped <= vec3<f32>(0.0031308));
  436| }
  437| 
  438| fn present_radiance(
  439|     linear_radiance: vec3<f32>,
  440|     world: vec3<f32>,
  441|     pixel: vec2<f32>,
  442| ) -> vec4<f32> {
  443|     let view_distance = length(world - frame.camera_position.xyz);
  444|     let fog_distance = max(view_distance - frame.viewport_fov_start.w, 0.0);
  445|     let transmittance = exp(-max(frame.fog_color_density.w, 0.0) * fog_distance);
  446|     var composed = mix(frame.fog_color_density.xyz, linear_radiance, transmittance);
  447|     var encoded = display_color(composed);
  448|     if frame.render_options.z != 0u {
  449|         encoded += vec3<f32>((hash_screen(pixel) - 0.5) / 128.0);
  450|     }
  451|     return vec4<f32>(clamp(encoded, vec3<f32>(0.0), vec3<f32>(1.0)), 1.0);
  452| }

    1| // Indexed greedy-surface strategy. Packed vertices are pulled from a storage
    2| // buffer and decoded on the GPU, avoiding a CPU-side expanded vertex copy.
    3| 
    4| struct SurfaceVertex {
    5|     @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
    6|     @location(0) world: vec3<f32>,
    7|     @location(1) normal: vec3<f32>,
    8|     @location(2) @interpolate(flat) visual: u32,
    9|     @location(3) @interpolate(flat) baked: f32,
   10|     @location(4) @interpolate(flat) ao: f32,
   11|     @location(5) @interpolate(flat) material: u32,
   12| };
   13| 
   14| @vertex
   15| fn surface_vertex(@builtin(vertex_index) vertex_index: u32) -> SurfaceVertex {
   16|     let packed = packed_vertices[vertex_index];
   17|     let normal_axis = (packed.z_normal_material >> 16u) & 255u;
   18|     let world = surface_world_position(packed);
   19| 
   20|     var output: SurfaceVertex;
   21|     output.clip_position = frame.view_projection * vec4<f32>(world, 1.0);
   22|     output.world = world;
   23|     output.normal = normal_for_axis(normal_axis);
   24|     output.visual = packed.visual;
   25|     output.material = (packed.z_normal_material >> 24u) & 255u;
   26|     output.baked = f32(packed.light_ao & 255u) / 15.0;
   27|     output.ao = 1.0 - f32((packed.light_ao >> 8u) & 1u);
   28|     return output;
   29| }
   30| 
   31| @fragment
   32| fn surface_fragment(input: SurfaceVertex) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
   33|     let albedo = apply_material_pattern(
   34|         input.material,
   35|         packed_srgb_to_linear(input.visual),
   36|         input.world,
   37|         input.normal,
   38|         chunk.bounds_voxel_size.w
   39|     );
   40|     let emission = f32(input.visual >> 24u) / 25.5;
   41|     let emits = emission > 0.0 && input.normal.y < -0.5;
   42|     let radiance = select(
   43|         raster_surface_radiance(
   44|             input.world,
   45|             input.normal,
   46|             albedo,
   47|             input.baked,
   48|             input.ao,
   49|             chunk.draw.x,
   50|             chunk.draw.y
   51|         ),
   52|         albedo * emission,
   53|         emits
   54|     );
   55|     return present_radiance(radiance, input.world, input.clip_position.xy);
   56| }

===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/webgpu/shaders/splat.wgsl (126 lines) =====
    1| // Instanced face-splat strategy. One compact 16-byte record becomes a quad
    2| // in the vertex stage; face geometry is generated entirely on the GPU.
    3| //
    4| // Splat is the native voxel path and deliberately borrows Minecraft's
    5| // visual grammar at a finer grain: a visible texel lattice, delineated
    6| // voxel cells, and light that arrives in discrete calculated steps rather
    7| // than as a smooth analytic falloff.
    8| //
    9| // The work is split to keep this the cheapest renderer:
   10| //
   11| //   vertex   -- irradiance, once per face, flat interpolated. This is the
   12| //               expensive part (it walks the clustered light list) and a
   13| //               face covering more than four pixels beats the surface
   14| //               path's per-fragment shading outright.
   15| //   fragment -- albedo on a quantized texel lattice plus cell outlines.
   16| //               A floor and a hash, with no light loop.
   17| 
   18| /// Texels per voxel edge. Minecraft is 16 texels across a 1 m block; at a
   19| /// 0.2 m voxel this is 20 texels per metre, so the grid reads as pixel art
   20| /// that is finer than Minecraft rather than coarser.
   21| const TEXELS_PER_VOXEL: f32 = 4.0;
   22| /// Discrete light steps. Matches the authored 0..=15 baked spectrum, so
   23| /// analytic and baked contributions quantize onto the same ladder.
   24| const LIGHT_LEVELS: f32 = 15.0;
   25| /// Fraction of a voxel cell darkened at its border.
   26| const OUTLINE_WIDTH: f32 = 0.055;
   27| const OUTLINE_DARKEN: f32 = 0.80;
   28| 
   29| /// Minecraft's per-face directional constants: which way a face points
   30| /// changes its brightness even under identical illumination. This is what
   31| /// keeps flat-shaded blocks legible as solids instead of silhouettes.
   32| fn face_direction_gain(axis: u32) -> f32 {
   33|     switch axis {
   34|         case 0u: { return 1.00; }  // up
   35|         case 1u: { return 0.52; }  // down
   36|         case 2u, 3u: { return 0.80; }  // north / south
   37|         default: { return 0.64; }  // east / west
   38|     }
   39| }
   40| 
   41| struct SplatVertex {
   42|     @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
   43|     @location(0) world: vec3<f32>,
   44|     /// Face-constant irradiance. `flat` is what makes a voxel a block.
   45|     @location(1) @interpolate(flat) irradiance: vec3<f32>,
   46|     @location(2) @interpolate(flat) visual: u32,
   47|     @location(3) @interpolate(flat) material: u32,
   48|     @location(4) @interpolate(flat) axis: u32,
   49| };
   50| 
   51| @vertex
   52| fn splat_vertex(
   53|     @builtin(vertex_index) corner_index: u32,
   54|     @builtin(instance_index) face_index: u32,
   55| ) -> SplatVertex {
   56|     let packed = packed_faces[face_index];
   57|     let axis = packed.surface & 255u;
   58|     let material = (packed.surface >> 8u) & 255u;
   59|     let baked = f32((packed.surface >> 16u) & 255u) / 15.0;
   60|     let ao = 1.0 - f32((packed.surface >> 24u) & 1u);
   61|     let normal = normal_for_axis(axis);
   62|     let world = splat_face_world_position(packed, corner_index);
   63| 
   64|     // Shade at the face centre, never at a corner: all four vertices must
   65|     // agree, or the flat-interpolated value would depend on which vertex
   66|     // the driver treats as provoking.
   67|     let centre = splat_face_center(packed);
   68| 
   69|     // Unit albedo yields pure irradiance, so the fragment stage can apply
   70|     // its own per-texel colour to a light term computed once per face.
   71|     var irradiance = raster_surface_radiance(
   72|         centre,
   73|         normal,
   74|         vec3<f32>(1.0),
   75|         baked,
   76|         ao,
   77|         chunk.draw.x,
   78|         chunk.draw.y
   79|     ) * face_direction_gain(axis);
   80|     // Light arrives in levels, not on a continuum -- but a level is a
   81|     // scalar, exactly as it is in Minecraft. Quantizing each channel
   82|     // independently snaps them onto different rungs and shifts hue: under
   83|     // the amber indoor ambient, dim faces round to red-only.
   84|     let level = max(irradiance.r, max(irradiance.g, irradiance.b));
   85|     let stepped = floor(level * LIGHT_LEVELS + 0.5) / LIGHT_LEVELS;
   86|     irradiance = irradiance * (stepped / max(level, 1e-5));
   87| 
   88|     var output: SplatVertex;
   89|     output.clip_position = frame.view_projection * vec4<f32>(world, 1.0);
   90|     output.world = world;
   91|     output.irradiance = irradiance;
   92|     output.visual = packed.visual;
   93|     output.material = material;
   94|     output.axis = axis;
   95|     return output;
   96| }
   97| 
   98| @fragment
   99| fn splat_fragment(input: SplatVertex) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
  100|     let voxel = chunk.bounds_voxel_size.w;
  101|     let normal = normal_for_axis(input.axis);
  102| 
  103|     // Snap the pattern sample to a texel centre so the material reads as
  104|     // hard pixel art instead of a gradient.
  105|     let texel = voxel / TEXELS_PER_VOXEL;
  106|     let sample = (floor(input.world / texel) + vec3<f32>(0.5)) * texel;
  107|     var albedo = apply_material_pattern(
  108|         input.material,
  109|         packed_srgb_to_linear(input.visual),
  110|         sample,
  111|         normal,
  112|         voxel
  113|     );
  114| 
  115|     // Delineate voxel cells. Adding `abs(normal)` lifts the face's own
  116|     // normal axis out of the minimum, leaving the two in-plane axes.
  117|     let to_border = vec3<f32>(0.5) - abs(fract(input.world / voxel) - vec3<f32>(0.5));
  118|     let masked = to_border + abs(normal);
  119|     let border = min(masked.x, min(masked.y, masked.z));
  120|     albedo = albedo * mix(OUTLINE_DARKEN, 1.0, smoothstep(0.0, OUTLINE_WIDTH, border));
  121| 
  122|     let emission = f32(input.visual >> 24u) / 25.5;
  123|     let emits = emission > 0.0 && normal.y < -0.5;
  124|     let radiance = select(albedo * input.irradiance, albedo * emission, emits);
  125|     return present_radiance(radiance, input.world, input.clip_position.xy);
  126| }
===== wasm_frontend/src/drivers/webgpu/shaders/splat_geometry.wgsl (100 lines) =====
    1| // Compact face expansion shared by visible and caster passes.
    2| 
    3| struct PackedFace {
    4|     xy: u32,
    5|     z_extents: u32,
    6|     surface: u32,
    7|     // low 24: domain sRGB color; high 8: authored emission over 0..=10.
    8|     visual: u32,
    9| };
   10| 
   11| @group(1) @binding(1) var<storage, read> packed_faces: array<PackedFace>;
   12| 
   13| fn face_u(axis: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
   14|     if axis <= 3u { return vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); }
   15|     return vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
   16| }
   17| 
   18| fn face_v(axis: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
   19|     switch axis {
   20|         case 0u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
   21|         case 1u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
   22|         case 2u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, -1.0, 0.0); }
   23|         case 3u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); }
   24|         case 4u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
   25|         default: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
   26|     }
   27| }
   28| 
   29| fn splat_face_center(packed: PackedFace) -> vec3<f32> {
   30|     let center_local = vec3<f32>(
   31|         f32(packed.xy & 65535u),
   32|         f32(packed.xy >> 16u),
   33|         f32(packed.z_extents & 65535u)
   34|     ) * (1.0 / 1024.0);
   35|     return chunk.origin_world_size.xyz + center_local;
   36| }
   37| 
   38| // Reality-unfold. `chunk.origin_world_size.w` is the chunk's resolve
   39| // progress: 0 is an unresolved lattice of voxel specks, 1 is settled
   40| // architecture. Faces grow about their own centre and slide into place
   41| // within their own plane, so a materializing chunk reads as its substrate
   42| // assembling rather than as geometry fading up from nothing.
   43| //
   44| // This lives in the vertex path deliberately: the fragment path is the
   45| // renderer's bottleneck, and this costs it nothing.
   46| 
   47| /// Fraction of the unfold window spent staggering face start times, so the
   48| /// lattice fills in unevenly instead of inflating as one rigid block.
   49| const UNFOLD_STAGGER: f32 = 0.45;
   50| /// How far, in voxels, an unresolved face slides *within its own plane*
   51| /// before settling. Deliberately tangential, never along the normal: a
   52| /// face that leaves its surface exposes the faces behind it, and the
   53| /// effect is meant to read as one surface assembling, not as the building
   54| /// coming apart.
   55| const UNFOLD_SCATTER: f32 = 2.4;
   56| /// Size an unresolved face keeps so the lattice stays visible as specks
   57| /// rather than collapsing to zero-area invisibility.
   58| const UNFOLD_MIN_SIZE: f32 = 0.16;
   59| 
   60| fn unfold_face_hash_at(packed: PackedFace, salt: u32) -> f32 {
   61|     var h = (packed.xy ^ salt) ^ (packed.z_extents * 2654435761u);
   62|     h = h ^ (h >> 15u);
   63|     h = h * 2246822519u;
   64|     h = h ^ (h >> 13u);
   65|     return f32(h & 65535u) * (1.0 / 65535.0);
   66| }
   67| 
   68| fn unfold_face_hash(packed: PackedFace) -> f32 {
   69|     return unfold_face_hash_at(packed, 0u);
   70| }
   71| 
   72| fn splat_face_world_position(packed: PackedFace, corner_index: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
   73|     let extent_u = f32((packed.z_extents >> 16u) & 255u);
   74|     let extent_v = f32(packed.z_extents >> 24u);
   75|     let axis = packed.surface & 255u;
   76|     let corner = vec2<f32>(
   77|         select(-1.0, 1.0, corner_index == 1u || corner_index == 3u),
   78|         select(-1.0, 1.0, corner_index >= 2u)
   79|     );
   80| 
   81|     let unfold = clamp(chunk.origin_world_size.w, 0.0, 1.0);
   82|     let stagger = unfold_face_hash(packed);
   83|     let local = clamp(
   84|         (unfold - stagger * UNFOLD_STAGGER) / (1.0 - UNFOLD_STAGGER),
   85|         0.0,
   86|         1.0
   87|     );
   88|     let grow = local * local * (3.0 - 2.0 * local);
   89|     let size = mix(UNFOLD_MIN_SIZE, 1.0, grow);
   90|     // A second decorrelated hash so the slide direction is not tied to the
   91|     // face's own start time.
   92|     let drift = unfold_face_hash_at(packed, 0x9E3779B9u);
   93|     let slide = (1.0 - grow) * chunk.bounds_voxel_size.w * UNFOLD_SCATTER;
   94| 
   95|     return splat_face_center(packed)
   96|         + face_u(axis) * (stagger - 0.5) * slide
   97|         + face_v(axis) * (drift - 0.5) * slide
   98|         + face_u(axis) * corner.x * extent_u * chunk.bounds_voxel_size.w * 0.5 * size
   99|         + face_v(axis) * corner.y * extent_v * chunk.bounds_voxel_size.w * 0.5 * size;
  100| }
